chapters.title: Chapter 751 The Bitch who cannot see Mount Tai
paragraphs: Vritra was truly speechless at that response, was this truly a member of the Divine Kage?
He had just killed one of them and he was still not believing? Wasn't this the top organization, set up by the gods themselves to catch the Divine?
"Haa" Vritra pointed at another, making the head of another Divine Kage explode.
BOOOOM
Then he looked at number 30, who just shook his head, there is no way as a veteran he would be fooled by a kid.
BOOOOM
Another was killed, then another. Now only one Divine Kage remained in the room, who still sat there confidently.
"Still no." he shook his head.
"Y- You are Vritra? You are the one who married my a- aunty?" on the other hand, Rich asked in shock.
Vritra was a good friend of his, but they hadn't met in such a long time.
Ignoring the last Divine Kage, Vritra looked at Sir Giant and Shen.
"How have you been?"
"O- Oh! V- Vritra?!! You were Vritra? Not Art?" Shen was so shocked, he didn't know what to think about it.
He looked at Teresa and asked: "Were you aware of this?"
"Yes, I indeed was." Teresa nodded, her tone showing no emotions.
"This place is kinda stuffy and starting to smell, how about we go out?"
With a snap of his fingers, all of them appeared outside the palace in the open space.
Sakshi was still screaming on the floor, clutching her leg.
"What is your name?" first Vritra decided to deal with the Divine Kage member.
"I am number 30, you are Art Yates? I have done some research-" right then, his arm exploded and pain shot through his body.
But number 30 didn't release any scream, though he finally knew this was reality and not some illusion.
Then... he had really just allowed this demon to kill four of his teammates?
He really is Vritra?
Number 30 stood up abruptly, his eyes wide, and jumped back. He looked at his arm which wasn't healing at all.
"Yea, go back and tell the members of Divine Kage that I am back, they can come find me." Vritra spoke.
He had almost forgotten about that fishing rod he had gotten before in the bank locker of Zihong.
'I think along with the skill he must also want that fishing rod, it is such a great treasure.' He thought.
At first number 30 wanted to start a fight right there, but suddenly an invisible Elegy Parasite climbed to the back of his head.
It quickly got control of his body.
"Yes sir!" number 30 nodded and flew away.
After he was gone, Vritra finally looked at the people around him, then frowned.
"So noisy, can you stay quiet for a minute?" he muttered, looking at the writhing Sakshi.
"Shen help me! T- This criminal, he is a demon, we have to kill him uwaaaaah I knew it, he isn't a good guy!" she screamed.
"Tess, go ahead, talk with whoever you want." Vritra said, giving her some time with this family of hers.
He took Yennefer's hand and decided to have a walk around.
'I have to kill these two, they dared to humiliate me again and again! But how can I?' Sakshi kept screaming Shen's name but knew he wouldn't help her.
She looked around, Sir Giant was so weak and clearly liked his granddaughter, he wouldn't help her.
Rich wouldn't help her either, there really was no one on her side.
Jean and Tiny stood silently at the back, trying to just disappear, they were just useless.
Jean was extremely frightened, he remembered how he wanted to beat Art up and that guy is Vritra?
This thought alone made him wet his pants as he fell on his butt and held onto his wife Tiny.
'I have to do something myself but how- oh!' suddenly a great idea popped into her mind, as she looked at Teresa.
Who was just talking with Sir Giant and Rich.
She silently wriggled towards Teresa, and once getting closer, she quickly held onto her leg.
"Hahahahaha I did it!!" she laughed maniacally, now Teresa was done for.
She would steal all her bad luck or might even die right away, how great is that?
Now there would only be fortune in her future, while Teresa would have a miserable end, even Vritra wouldn't be able to save her.
"..." few moments passed but she didn't sense any changes, after a moment she glanced up, only for her soul to almost leave her body.
Teresa's black eyes were focused on her, cold and murderous, the previous meekness was completely gone.
'W- What is... happening? Why didn't it work? Huh? What? Why?' Sakshi froze, her heart thumping as if it was about to explode.
Vritra paused in the distance, he had sensed her sneaky move, Teresa did too but they didn't act.
They both wanted to show if she really was scummy enough to even want to kill her, and this bitch had really no shame or principles.
"And you have done enough!" Vritra's voice full of anger rang out, even the sky was covered by dark clouds and cracks stretched all over the place.
Sakshi was so scared she screamed and began to cry, begging for forgiveness, calling out to Shen, Rich, Sir Giant repeatedly.
Vritra's pupils glowed with malice, as particles of dust began to form a long blade above her.
It was clear, Vritra planned to kill her.
"W- Wait, don't kill her!" Shen shouted, but he wasn't fast enough nor strong.
"Wait!" Sir Giant too called out, even if she was a bitch, she was still a member of the family, unfortunately so he had to protect her.
Rich wanted to call out too, after all this was his mother, but he knew Vritra wasn't going to stop now.
Teresa frowned, a little bit conflicted only because of her brother and Rich, she didn't have an ounce of feeling towards Sakshi.
Sakshi too realized that right now, only Teresa could make Vritra stop, no one else could, so she began to beg amidst her sobbing.
"Uwaaaaah P- Please spare me just once, I-"
BANG
But she wasn't given a chance to speak any further, as the large sword cut through her body, tearing her into two.
He had already spared her life before despite her treating his wife so badly, but this time she had crossed the line.
"Noooooooo!!" Shen screamed, as if he was kicked in the balls.
Of course, he wasn't really sad that his wife was killed but she had held onto a big secret of his.
If not for that, he would have killed her himself and that bitch Sakshi had set it up in such a way that if she were to die or disappear.
The evidence would be released itself to the whole world.
That was the only reason why Shen didn't want Sakshi to die.
Teresa was teleported to Vritra's side, as soon as the blade struck, cutting Sakshi in two.
In a few moments, life disappeared from her eyes, as she stared up blankly.
And right as she had died, a video began to play in the sky, a video in which Shen was clearly visible.
Not just in the Ford realm but even outside the Ford realm, all over the place, as most of the humans saw the spectacle in the sky.

chapters.title: Chapter 752 Returning to Home
paragraphs: All across the continent, a video started to play in the sky.
It was the scene of an orgy, where Shen was also present, he looked fairly young and too excited.
There were dozens of women and men in the orgy, and the whole scene was so wild that it had everyone's jaws hanging.
Most people recognized Shen, especially now that the Ford family was at the top.
Even in the Ford realm, Sir Giant, Rich, Jean, and Tiny, who were looking up, had kinda forgotten about the death of Sakshi and stared at the spectacle.
They were all frozen, even Vritra was shocked by the level of debauchery, Shen truly was a wild player when he was younger.
In an instant, the respect he had accumulated over nearly his entire life crumbled.
"Nooooo don't see it, this is fake!! It is not me!! Stoooopppppp it!!" Shen screamed in despair, this was the reason why he didn't say anything to that bitch.
She had his weakness in her palm all this time, Sakshi had recorded him in a party where he consumed some strange drug.
Or rather, it was mixed into his drink and then all of this happened.
"Well well brother-in-law, you aren't bad." Vritra said, he was handling several women at once and didn't get tired.
"Sigh Father, you should have informed me if mother had such a video of yours, I would have taken care of it secretly." Rich shook his head, as the richest person alive, that wouldn't have been hard.
His connections stretch all over the planet.
But it was all too late now, everyone had seen that shameful display.
Teresa and Yennefer had only glanced up when the video started, they didn't look up further, finding it disgusting.
Sighing to himself, Rich took out a few communication glyphs and gave a few orders.
After two minutes, the video that was playing in the sky disappeared, yet the damage had already been done.
Shen fell to his knees, looking lifeless.
"It's alright, it could have been worse." Vritra patted his shoulder, then walked away.
"I- I was drugged, I would never do that... g- grandfather, believe me!" Shen muttered.
"Sigh go back to your room, we will see what we can do." Sir Giant muttered.
Vritra was no longer in the mood to stay there, he created a portal and gestured towards his wives before entering.
Yennefer followed him right in while Teresa remained there for a moment longer, after nodding towards them, she too left.
In a few minutes, the condition of the Ford family had changed so much.
Their reputation was gone, Sakshi was dead, four Divine Kages were killed here...
The future seemed bleak.
The three of them arrived inside the dragon realm and found that everyone else was already present there.
"Wifey, are you done with things here?" Vritra asked, placing his arms on her waist and smiling.
"Yes, the condition is a little bad and needs more time, but they will be fine. The other races have already stolen a lot of resources though." She spoke.
"Well that is a simple matter, we can take care of it." Vritra said, glancing over his wives.
Now that all other things were done, he decided to go to the Yate realm and meet Gunter and Ava, they must have been very worried about him.
He even decided to place his house in that realm, Yasmine was pregnant so it would be better to have Ava around.
And maybe a few old dragon ladies who know about such stuff.
He talked about this with his wives and they agreed, Shitless and Onest were both already there.
Vritra directly teleported them all into the House of Darkness, and then teleported the house itself into the Yate realm.
Out of nowhere, a large house appeared in the sky of the Yate realm, startling all that saw it.
Then it slowly descended and in an open area, close to the palace where Gunter and Ava lived, it landed.
A lot of guards rapidly surrounded the House of Darkness, Gunter was informed too.
He appeared there along with the strongest guards.
Someone who could do something so drastic, was definitely not an ordinary person.
'Another problem? Why don't the problems ever end?' Gunter grimaced as he stared at the house, which seemed as if it was constantly burning with dark flames.
His beard had grown and he had been quite worried about his son during all this time, same was the case with his wife.
Even though he had already informed them that he would be gone for six months or more.
"Who are you?!" Gunter shouted, ready to launch an attack if the other party was hostile.
The doors to the house opened and then walked a person, whom he recognized very well.
The sight made him take a step back in shock, Gunter even rubbed his eyes to check he wasn't hallucinating.
"A- Art? Is that you?!!" he asked, and as Vritra stepped out of the house and was clearly visible.
Gunter threw all his worries and confusion away, instead extreme joy exploded in his heart, his son was back!
"ART!!" throwing his weapon away, Gunter flashed towards Vritra, hugging him.
"My son, where have you been? We were so worried." He turned and ordered one of the guards.
"Go quickly and inform- wait, never mind. It will be a great surprise for her haha" Gunter laughed happily, he didn't even see the group of women that walked out of the house after him.
Without giving Vritra any chance to speak, he pulled his arm and quickly ran towards the room where Ava is.
After getting close, he paused outside the room and said: "Art, stay here for a bit and come inside when I call you."
Vritra nodded, Gunter seemed so happy and enthusiastic, it truly felt like he was home.
KNOCK KNOCK
"Who is it?" from inside the room, Ava's voice came as Gunter knocked on the door.
"Ava, it is me." Gunter said as he stepped inside, making her roll her eyes.
"Since when did you need to knock? Anyway, which of the two dresses do you think will suit me for the party?" Ava asked.
This time, Gunter rolled his eyes, she had asked this question so many times.
Just after he told her that he would throw a party once their son returns.
She loved him too much, without getting annoyed he looked at the two dresses and said: "The red one."
"Right, I think Art will like it too. Oh right, did you want something?" she remembered and asked.
"Not really, I have come to give you a surprise, a really special one!" Gunter said in a mysterious tone.
"Surprise? What is it?" Ava picked up her dress and asked, she didn't really seem all that interested.
Instead it was more interesting to her to choose the dress she would wear in a party several months later.
"Haa bring in the surprise." Gunter said, a laugh suppressed in his voice.
Vritra walked inside, just to play along, he took out a necklace from his inventory, he had plenty of them from stealing- cough borrowing.
Ava looked up from the dress without much interest, she first saw the necklace which indeed looked quite beautiful.
"Ah that's beautiful, thank you." She said with a smile, not wanting to make her husband feel bad.
Her gaze then passed over the person who was holding the necklace before returning to the dress and she froze.

chapters.title: Chapter 753 The Back-to-Back Surprises
paragraphs: Ava froze upon seeing the person who was holding the necklace, her eyes widened in shock.
So the necklace wasn't the real surprise, but it was him! Her son had returned!!
"ART!" Ava threw the dress away hugging Vritra, a big smile on her face and eyes teary.
She even forgot about her husband upon seeing her son return, she took a step back to look over him and make sure he wasn't injured.
"I am back." Vritra said, smiling faintly.
It was a nice welcome.

"This is wonderful, I am so so happy! Husband, let's throw a party right away, no we need to prepare first, let's throw the party t- tomorrow night." Ava was so excited that her hands were shaking and she stuttered.
"Don't worry, I won't be going anywhere for now. So we will have a lot of time for such parties." Vritra said, as he held her hands.
"But first, I want you to meet so-" Vritra continued but was interrupted by Ava.
"But where is my daughter in law? Teresa? Didn't she go with you?" she asked.
Gunter slapped his forehead, in his hurry he had completely forgotten that his son is now married and has a wife.
He had dragged Art to this place as soon as he saw him, not even asking about that big house or anything else.
"She is outside-" right as Vritra answered, seven women entered the room.
The sight surprised both Gunter and Ava, they obviously recognized some of the faces.
Like the famous Dragon Empress, Yasmine, and other empresses such as Fiona, Yennefer, Diana and Vanessa.
Maeve too though she was not an empress, and at last their daughter in law, Teresa.
Gunter could not see her face, he only saw as if it was blurry but Ava for the first time saw her face.
And she was stunned, all of the seven of them were extremely beautiful, but Teresa stood out a little even among such beauties.
She knew right away it was her daughter in law.
But why were all the others here? They knew Art had good relations with all these influential ladies.
They had even showed their support towards Art in that marriage of the Ford family.
The questioning gaze of the couple moved to Vritra, not really speaking, but waiting for his explanation.
"Oh, as you might already know, this is Yasmine, Fiona, Diana, Maeve-" but before he could complete the basic intro, he was interrupted by Ava.
"Son, I do know them all, but uh..." she didn't know how to ask why they are here without sounding rude.
These women were all powerful and influential and unlike the stupid Sakshi who now lay dead in two pieces, Ava was well aware that she can't offend some people.
"Hello mother." Teresa greeted, even though Vritra is not exactly their son but he is in a way Art.
And she was already calling them that so she didn't find it strange.
"Welcome back Teresa, you look lovely." Ava said, she didn't get close to Teresa, remembering that because of some reason a touch could be fatal for her.
Seeing such considerations, Teresa smiled, this really felt like a family.
Vanessa who saw Ava calling Vritra her son, didn't really mind.
If she really wanted the role of the mother that badly then she can take it, Vanessa wanted to be the mother of his children anyway.
"COUGH These seven are all my wives." Clearing his throat, Vritra told them.
Wondering how the two would react.

"Ah your wives? How wonderful, someone, quickly bring something to dr-" Gunter clasped his hands and nodded, since they were his son's wives, they needed to be treated with respect and needed proper hospitality.
But there was something wrong here?
"Wait, all seven of them are your wives? Since when?!" Ava asked, as she received the second biggest surprise of the day.
"Uh... Actually, Tess is my seventh wife and Yasmine is my first wife." Vritra said, clearing his throat, it did sound very strange.
Gunter glanced at the seven daughters in law and wiped an imaginary tear, patting Vritra's shoulder as he muttered.
"My son, you have really grown up, I am proud of you. You have inherited the great taste in women from your father."
He really seemed very proud of his son, Art, these were all the top women on this planet.
Not just in power and influence but even in terms of beauty and his son had made them all his wives, how could he not be proud.
"Wait wait, it's not the time for that, you married all seven?! And you all are okay with it?" pulling her husband's hand, she pushed him back and questioned.
Then gazed at the seven women.
"Yes." All of them nodded at the same time.
"Son, are you really sure about this? Can you really take care of them all?" Ava asked seriously, she loved her son and trusted him but didn't want him to turn into a scumbag.
Who plays with others' feelings, especially such women who give themselves completely to their man, it would be really awful.
She really didn't want Art to turn out like that, even if she trusts him fully.
"Yes, I am sure. We have been together for quite some time and I love them a lot, we would never be separated." Vritra said looking at her seriously.
"..." Ava remained silent for a few moments, seeing the intense emotions towards his wives in his eyes and nodded.
So his son really was serious for them all, and since the seven didn't have a problem with it, then what can they do?
It's not like this was a forbidden thing, quite a few people marry many women.
"Well if that's how it is, then great, I will be getting a lot of grandchildren it seems." Ava said, all her worries were washed away and she was happy again.
But as she gazed at the seven women, Ava realized that most of them were older than even herself.
Won't this make their relationship strange?
"Ah now that you mention grandchildren, I have something else to add." Vritra remembered as he took Yasmine's hand and pulled her forward.
"My wifey is pregnant with my child, it has already been over a month." He announced.

And thus, Ava received yet another big surprise of the day, the 3rd already.
Her eyes widened again, as she looked at her son's face and then at Yasmine who had a beautiful smile on her face.
'M- My son is going to be a father? I am going to be a grandma already?!' Ava thought as she looked at her husband.

chapters.title: Chapter 754 The Daughters in law
paragraphs: Vritra smiled, at this place, Yasmine will be properly cared for.
He didn't have any knowledge of things he must do for her, with Ava and the other maids from the dragon race around, there won't be any problem.
Now he just needed to make sure that no outside danger can enter this realm.
The biggest problem now was that Zihong and even the gods who had been humiliated in front of everyone.
As soon as they are free, they will definitely try to harm them, so he had to do something.
But aside from reaching level 3 for now, there wasn't really anything Vritra could do.
"Actually, there are indeed some things you can do." Just then Divine spoke in his mind, his voice though sounded a bit weaker than usual.
'What things? And why do you sound so strange?' Vritra asked in his mind.
"I will explain everything once you have reached level 3 of Demi God, and this avatar of mine doesn't have much time, I will disappear very soon." The Divine answered.
'Oh, that sounds bad, will you be okay?' Vritra asked in worry.
"Yea, I have one more avatar, after I am gone it will help you." Divine said, then added: "Actually this avatar had remained quite close to you and your family all this time."
'Huh? What, who?' this time it was Vritra who was surprised and confused.
"You will know very soon, anyway for now just enjoy the momentary peace." Divine said and as always disappeared right after.
Vritra tried calling him a few times but he was just gone.
Sighing, he focused on the people around.
"Yes we will hold a big party, for our son's safe return and for this wonderful news and also a welcoming celebration for all our daughters in law." Gunter spoke.
Just then...
"PITIFUL ONEEEEEEEEE!! HELPPPPPP!!" A loud screaming sound came from outside.
Frowning, Vritra teleported directly outside wondering what danger arrived here out of nowhere.
And he saw a familiar sight, Monk Shitless was sitting on the back of Bullo who was charging forward at full speed.
The big Bullo was heading straight towards Vritra.
A little surprised, Vritra just raised his hand, pointing his palm forward as Bullo applied sudden brakes, as it skidded across the ground.
Dust rose in the air and marks formed over the ground.
Shitless was shot off like a rocket, flying right over the house and disappearing somewhere behind it.
Bullo stopped right in front of Vritra as he patted the happy Bullo's head, it seemed this dangerous looking beast was happier to meet Vritra than its owner, Shitless.
"How have you been?" Vritra chuckled at this comedic duo, it had been so long since they were together.
Bullo happily rubbed its huge head against him, nearly pushing him back.
Soon Shitless staggered back, he was covered by leaves, though he wasn't really hurt.
At the last moment, he had transformed his body into metallic form.
Divine's words reverberated through his mind as Vritra glanced at Shitless, could this be the avatar?
He is even capable of seeing fate and had helped them several times, could it really be him?
For now, he dismissed the thought, there was no way to check it.
"Where is Onest?" Vritra asked, taking out a large amount of meat from his inventory that had been kept there for quite some time.
And then gave it to Bullo.
Bullo instantly began eating with great joy.
"He uh, he went on a date." Shitless muttered, appearing confused.
"A date? Huh? When did he get a girl?" Vritra asked in surprise, Onest was good looking but Onest never mentioned any women in his life.
"Just while we were returning to this place, he saw her and fell for her. And they just went away together later on." Shitless shrugged.
That guy seemed strange, maybe that is how people in love act, how would he as a monk know it?
Vritra frowned, well he is a Demi God so unless that Zihong guy is pretending to be a woman, Onest shouldn't be in trouble, right?
He might as well be enjoying himself with a beautiful woman right now, eating tasty dishes.
'Knight, go make sure he is fine.' Since everyone is safe here, Vritra can send the level 3 Demi God away for now.
The armored Knight appeared for a brief moment, bowed, then vanished right away.
"Before anything, we need to start absorbing those cores and increase our strength." Vritra spoke, and all the women nodded solemnly.
The party can wait but if they aren't strong enough when danger arrives, they would only be left with regret.
"But I wonder, how long it will take." Diana spoke, tapping over her cheek.
It will be two levels, just getting to Demi Saint level 1 had taken quite some time, so this time it might even be a couple of months?
"It won't take that long, I have Null." Vritra said, but he preferred that Onest would return too and they all can level up at once.
The sun had already set and the sky was starting to darken.
A cool breeze moved across the land and the lights of the manor began to glow.
"I guess the party can wait then, let's eat dinner together for now." Ava said, still just as excited.
She had received too many good news in one day.
"Yes, I was feeling a little hungry after all the events, this day sure is long." Yasmine muttered, she needed a more nutritional diet.
Though she noticed that she had been craving different tastes, sometimes sweet, sometimes salty snacks and whatnot.
Was it because of her pregnancy? She didn't hate this feeling, as it only made this feel more real, it was special.
Vritra quietly moved beside her and held her hand, making Yasmine smile softly.
While chatting the group headed toward the dining area, where the maids had already arranged various delicious dishes.
The long table was filled with roasted meat, soups, fruits, breads, desserts and many shining drinks.
Even Shitless forgot his confusion for a moment and stared with shining eyes.
They shared various stories from the other planet, though it was hard for Gunter and Ava to believe at first.
But they had also seen those mutants, though they were quickly taken care of.
At times Ava gasped, and Gunter slammed the table in anger hearing how much danger they had faced and the treachery of the world.
At one point, it even seemed he wanted to rush there and kill those evil bastards who tortured poor innocent people.
Then seeing Vritra sitting there safely, both of them calmed down again and felt relieved.
No matter what had happened, their son had returned home safely.
After eating, ava and gunter retired for the day and returned to their room, even though the excited ava seemed she can chat all night long.
She was liking all her daughters in law, they were all good natured.
Vritra then strolled around the yate realm, chatting with his wives.
As he walked towards the front of the palace, many people from the yate family saw them and were shocked to see so many beautiful women walking with Art.
The young and older ones who had been beaten by him before felt quite angry and jealous.
Just then Vritra received a message from Knight.

chapters.title: Chapter 755 The Perverted Mole
paragraphs: "Master, Onest is currently dining with a lady."
Was the message that Vritra received from Knight. Vritra looked through his Soul Wraith's eyes and saw the scene himself.
Onest was sitting in a rather luxurious hotel, in front of him sat a mature woman looking older than him.
She looked beautiful and the milf type, at least his taste was not bad.
But Onest had a stupid expression on his face as he fed her food, looking completely lovestruck.
He was smiling like an idiot and didn't even notice anything around him.
Just to make sure, Vritra checked everything several times and knew for sure that this was a normal woman.
And there was no trap, so he left Onest alone to enjoy his life.
"Looks like Onest won't be coming back for a while." Vritra announced then, using Misty Essence Mythic Halo, he showed them exactly what he had seen.
"Oh, I never thought Onest would be a submissive type, he looks completely in love." Vanessa spoke, a bit surprised.
"Darling, did you make sure it wasn't any trap?" Fiona asked.
Vritra chuckled, speaking: "You think if a woman approaches Onest then it could only be a trap?"
"Uh T- That's not what I meant, I was just thinking it could be that Zihong." She muttered, her lips stretching into a thin line.
"Yeah, it is fine, that is a normal woman. As for the rest, Onest will have to take care of it himself." Vritra said then added:
"Since he isn't returning now, we will go first and absorb the cores, we can't delay it. He can start later once he has played love love."
The others nodded, anyway with Null skill it won't take too long as Vritra can quicken the time.
"I just wish to have some peaceful time for a while, let's hope no other problem arrives now." Yennefer muttered, as Vritra slapped his forehead.
Why did she have to say it?
Not adding to the jinx anymore, they headed towards the House of Darkness after chatting a bit longer.
Vritra informed some guards who would inform Gunter and Ava that they will be staying in the House of Darkness for a while.
"Goodbye, my friend. I will be back really soon." Shitless patted Bullo's head, looking sad.
Bullo also looked sad and rubbed its head against him.
Then he glanced on top of Vritra's head and real tears began to fall from his eyes, such bad luck, how can anyone be so pitiful.
Vritra ignored Shitless's gaze of pity and led them all into the house.
Instead of going into separate rooms, they all were seated in a big hall, which would be more efficient while using Null.
Everyone took out the two cores and sat cross-legged.
The atmosphere slowly turned serious.
"Are you all ready?" Vritra asked, looking at the other eight people in the hall.
"Yes." They all nodded, Knight was still away and it seemed Onest really was not going to return any time soon.
So...
[Null Activated!]
Instantly a big difference was created between the time of the hall and outside.
A day outside would be equivalent to several days inside, so the process will end quickly.
The air inside the hall trembled faintly as the skill took effect.
And so began the process of evolving to the level 3 of Demi Gods.
Far away in the universe, in a very very big hall that spanned over nearly a thousand kilometres.
Several people sat around a big round table, each from different race, all of them invited here by the host for a special reason.
The air was chilly here and for some reason the surroundings which should have been completely white were replaced by a strange canvas of animals doing copulation.
Of course these animals weren't the same ones from Earth, they were far too weird.
Some had six legs, some had wings, and some looked impossible to understand.
All of them frowned, it was some sort of technical glitch it seemed and now it won't go away.
"COUGH Anyway, we should focus on the important meeting, our time is very precious after all." The host spoke.
It was none other than Drino the level 3 Demi God, everyone here was a Demi God, all of them from level 1 to level 3.
Some were the ones that Drino knew personally but few were recommended by the administrators who worked under the gods.
"Yes, what could be a better use of our time than watching these beasts in heat." A female Demi God said as she stood up and left.
If even such an arrangement was not being handled properly then there was no point in discussing further.
Another Demi God, a male one or rather his gender couldn't be discerned, cleared his throat.
"I am Mole, a level 3 Demi God." Mole introduced himself proudly.
He gazed around at all the Demi Gods, there were around thirty or so Demi Gods but none of them were to his taste, maybe except the host itself.
Mole looked like a tree, his body seemed to be made of wood, he had two hands and several legs, and leaves of various colours as hair.
"I have two questions!" he announced in a loud voice, as everyone quieted down and did their best to ignore the surrounding scenery.
"Sure sure go ahead, oh right first let me introduce myself!" Drino said, it was the rule, whoever speaks first needs to give a basic introduction.
And he was quite happy that people were showing such enthusiasm towards this meeting, he needed their absolute support to kill Vritra.
That guy has support of the Divine, so it won't be easy even if his strength is pitifully weak right now.
The administrator even said that there would be one or two level 4 Demi Gods who would come to join him as a mission given directly by the gods.
But it seemed they were running late.
And Drino couldn't waste the time of others so he got started first.

"I am Drino, a level 3 Demi God and the host of this event. I will explain everything and clear all your doubts, but before we start let's hear the doubts of our dear friend, Mole." He spoke in a gentle manly manner.
His voice was rough and loud, he looked at what the distant walls were showing and it just kept getting worse.
"My first question is: If you don't mind, can I sit on the chair right next to you?"
Mole asked in all seriousness.
"Uh..." Drino and the others who were expecting a question related to this event were taken aback but he nodded, maybe this guy was too excited.
"Sure why not, we all have free will, there is no one above the other here. You are free to do as you wish, this is a mutual beneficial proposal after all."
Drino announced, even using this useless question to make himself look good in front of others.
His thick brain was of course not capable of this, so he was getting direct transmission from his smartest underling who was telling him what to do and what to say.
"Thank you!" Mole said as his tentacle-like feet moved strangely and he walked towards Drino, then he sat beside the lizard-like creature.

"I just wish to have some peaceful time for a while, let's hope no other problem arrives now." Yennefer muttered, as Vritra slapped his forehead.
Why did she have to say it?
Not adding to the jinx anymore, they headed towards the House of Darkness after chatting a bit longer.
Vritra informed some guards who would inform Gunter and Ava that they will be staying in the House of Darkness for a while.
"Goodbye, my friend.
I will be back really soon." Shitless patted Bullo's head, looking sad.
Bullo also looked sad and rubbed its head against him.
Then he glanced on top of Vritra's head and real tears began to fall from his eyes, such bad luck, how can anyone be so pitiful.
Vritra ignored Shitless's gaze of pity and led them all into the house.
Instead of going into separate rooms, they all were seated in a big hall, which would be more efficient while using Null.
Everyone took out the two cores and sat cross-legged.
The atmosphere slowly turned serious.
"Are you all ready?" Vritra asked, looking at the other eight people in the hall.
"Yes." They all nodded, Knight was still away and it seemed Onest really was not going to return any time soon.
So...
[Null Activated!]
Instantly a big difference was created between the time of the hall and outside.
A day outside would be equivalent to several days inside, so the process will end quickly.
The air inside the hall trembled faintly as the skill took effect.
And so began the process of evolving to the level 3 of Demi Gods.
Far away in the universe, in a very very big hall that spanned over nearly a thousand kilometres.
Several people sat around a big round table, each from different race, all of them invited here by the host for a special reason.
The air was chilly here and for some reason the surroundings which should have been completely white were replaced by a strange canvas of animals doing copulation.
Of course these animals weren't the same ones from Earth, they were far too weird.
Some had six legs, some had wings, and some looked impossible to understand.
All of them frowned, it was some sort of technical glitch it seemed and now it won't go away.
"COUGH Anyway, we should focus on the important meeting, our time is very precious after all." The host spoke.
It was none other than Drino the level 3 Demi God, everyone here was a Demi God, all of them from level 1 to level 3.
Some were the ones that Drino knew personally but few were recommended by the administrators who worked under the gods.
"Yes, what could be a better use of our time than watching these beasts in heat." A female Demi God said as she stood up and left.
If even such an arrangement was not being handled properly then there was no point in discussing further.
Another Demi God, a male one or rather his gender couldn't be discerned, cleared his throat.
"I am Mole, a level 3 Demi God." Mole introduced himself proudly.
He gazed around at all the Demi Gods, there were around thirty or so Demi Gods but none of them were to his taste, maybe except the host itself.
Mole looked like a tree, his body seemed to be made of wood, he had two hands and several legs, and leaves of various colours as hair.
"I have two questions!" he announced in a loud voice, as everyone quieted down and did their best to ignore the surrounding scenery.
"Sure sure go ahead, oh right first let me introduce myself!" Drino said, it was the rule, whoever speaks first needs to give a basic introduction.
And he was quite happy that people were showing such enthusiasm towards this meeting, he needed their absolute support to kill Vritra.
That guy has support of the Divine, so it won't be easy even if his strength is pitifully weak right now.
The administrator even said that there would be one or two level 4 Demi Gods who would come to join him as a mission given directly by the gods.
But it seemed they were running late.
And Drino couldn't waste the time of others so he got started first.
"I am Drino, a level 3 Demi God and the host of this event.
I will explain everything and clear all your doubts, but before we start let's hear the doubts of our dear friend, Mole." He spoke in a gentle manly manner.
His voice was rough and loud, he looked at what the distant walls were showing and it just kept getting worse.
"My first question is: If you don't mind, can I sit on the chair right next to you?"
Mole asked in all seriousness.
"Uh..." Drino and the others who were expecting a question related to this event were taken aback but he nodded, maybe this guy was too excited.
"Sure why not, we all have free will, there is no one above the other here.
You are free to do as you wish, this is a mutual beneficial proposal after all."
Drino announced, even using this useless question to make himself look good in front of others.
His thick brain was of course not capable of this, so he was getting direct transmission from his smartest underling who was telling him what to do and what to say.
"Thank you!" Mole said as his tentacle-like feet moved strangely and he walked towards Drino, then he sat beside the lizard-like creature.

chapters.title: Chapter 756 The Nose
paragraphs: After getting the confirmation Mole stood up and dragged his chair across the room, making the chair creak loudly.'
Then he put the chair down near drino, sitting right beside him, and gave a strange smile.
The chair was placed a bit too close for Drino's comfort, but Drino didn't want to offend the guy, so he simply sat there with a smile and endured it.
Mole had two eyes and a big mouth, there was no nose or none visible where his face was, making his appearance feel even stranger.

"My second question, which is just as important: Will I be allowed to participate in those special activities after this meeting ends?" he asked while pointing towards the walls with obvious interest.
The whole hall fell into silence for a moment.
There was complete silence in the hall after they heard this, they looked at the wall where various types of beasts were doing nasty things and then back at Mole.
Some of them even blinked twice in disbelief.
This guy was kinky and a bit too perverted.
"COUGH No, those scenes- fuck, stop that right away!" Drino shouted, he picked a glass from the table and threw it at the wall in irritation.
BOOOM!
The screen exploded and the whole space was engulfed by darkness for a few moments. Small fragments scattered across the floor.
Then light came back on.
"Alright, now let's start with the meeting." Drino was hoping the level 4 Demi Gods would come before he starts.
That is why he even gave some time to this Mole guy.
And it was a mistake from the very beginning.
"Lord, now speak exactly as I say..." a clear voice sounded in his ear, as Drino began.
"I am sure every one of you have heard of the Divine, yes that famous criminal. And you know about his sisters." He paused for a dramatic effect just as the Lizzi named guy on the call said.
All of them got serious after hearing about Divine, the mood completely changed in an instant. Even those who looked lazy earlier straightened their posture.
"As we all already know, Divine is still alive and he uh even beat up the gods some time ago. With our strength we are nothing in front of him."
"But I have found the location of one of his sisters, and I was tasked by one of the gods to bring her to him but sigh..."
Drino paused, taking a deep breath and lowering his head slightly.
"But what?!" one of the Demi Gods asked, looking very curious and leaning forward.
"But just when I was about to kidnap her, I was intercepted by a guy, he wasn't particularly strong, just a level 1 Demi God.
I could have killed him with a single strike but I got careless and he managed to destroy my body by a secret weapon."
"Oh my!! Are you alright?" Mole shook in shock, one of his branch-like arms caressed Drino's chest.
"Y- Yeah I am fine." Drino nodded, gently pushing the arm away while forcing a smile.
"Lord, he is just showing his support, if you act like you are uncomfortable you might lose the support of these Demi Gods."
Lizzi spoke, in a solemn tone.
Drino clicked his tongue and focused on the explaining.

"That guy is Vritra, the successor of the Divine, and we have to kill him! It won't be hard, honestly I can do it alone but one couldn't be any more careful and this way we all can be rewarded by the gods."
Drino said in a loud excited tone, trying to ignite their greed.
"Hmm that is a nice proposal, if he is related to Divine, then he is a big criminal too." Mole was the first to speak, showing great enthusiasm.
His strength was nothing to scoff at even if he is very kinky.
"Yes, but getting involved in a matter related to Divine is a bit... too dangerous." Another Demi God said, and without a word he stood up and left. His figure vanished quickly.
'Damnit, these cowardly bastards, if I didn't need their help I would have beaten them all to death!' Drino felt so angry.
Lizzi knew the mood swings of his lord so spoke: "Calm down lord, you can't get angry, we need them. There are still many of them."
'Yes, right. It's alright.'
"It could be dangerous but I have almost succeeded in kidnapping that woman before, it was only because of my carelessness that she was taken away.
This time, we will do it all secretly and have perfect plans." Drino said confidently.

"Hmm I feel more and more confident in your words, and want to join you." Mole muttered, then groaned: "Ughh this bad itch, if you don't mind can you scratch this part, it is a bit difficult to do it on my own."
Mole pointed to a slightly bumpy part on his side which had a single hole in it.
'Huh? This bastard, he wants me to-!!' Drino almost tore him apart but Lizzi's voice rang out quickly.
"Lord, it is fine, it might be just his nose, just scratch a bit. Several Demi Gods follow Mole, if we can get him on our team then that would be great!"
So swallowing his pride, he extended a finger and began to scratch slowly.
"Ahh Oooh R- Right there, ohohoho Mhmmmm haa ufff you are g- good at this..." Mole moaned in a low voice.
'Control, control.' Drino reminded himself repeatedly.
"So, how many of you would like to join me on this special mission, there would be a lot of benefits and if we are careful we won't even face any danger."
Drino continued to explain further and answered some questions one after another.
Telling more details about Vritra and the sister of Divine, or how they were going to proceed.
Of course he didn't disclose his real plan or exactly the identity of Divine's sister.
Few rejected and left but some were greedy enough to stay, some were close friends of Mole, so they stayed too after exchanging glances.
In the end, aside from himself and Mole, five other Demi Gods remained who were ready to go along with Drino.
A total of 7 level 3 Demi Gods, it should be enough to even destroy a few planets, so killing Vritra and the other women wouldn't be difficult right?
And maybe the second sister of Divine is also there.
"Ahhhhhh th- thanks, I will definitely join you, that was great, no one had ever quenched my thi- COUGH ache like you did just now." Mole thanked.
Drino finally pulled his arm away, he cursed internally but thankfully he got a small team of Demi Gods.
So scratching the side of his nose for getting a few Demi Gods was not a bad deal either, at least on the surface.
Just then another Demi God flew into the hall, he looked almost like a human except the pale colour of his skin that was too white. His arrival carried a chilling pressure.
All of them stood up at once, as it was a level 4 Demi God, someone who can kill them all in a minute.
That was the difference between each level. It was not something numbers alone could explain.
This was why Drino was so baffled that as a level 3 demi god he was beaten by level 1 demi god.
"Welcome, Demi God Xenos!" Drino shouted, even bowing slightly and the others did the same.
"Hmm I already know of your plan and I will help if things go wrong, otherwise I won't even appear." Xenos spoke, he clearly looked down on them all.
"T- Thank you Demi God Xenos!" Drino spoke, as soon as Xenos had appeared the temperature in the hall had dropped drastically.
"Ughh My nose, why is it so chilly here? My nose gets stuffed in cold, SNIFF anyway, when are we starting-?" Mole scratched the two holes on his forehead, which worked as its nose.
"Wait you have noses at two places?" Drino asked.
"Huh? Of course not, I only have one nose, just like you cutie pie." Mole replied happily.
"T- Then what the fuck was that? The thing I scratched earlier?" Drino asked in utter disbelief, a strange feeling rising in his heart.
"( ͡¬ ͜ʖ ͡¬)" he remained silent and only gave an evil, suggestive smile.

chapters.title: Chapter 757 The Planning of Torture
paragraphs: "..." Drino stared at Mole for a few seconds, then down at the place he thought was his nose and finally at his right arm.
As the reality sank in, a feeling of utter disgust crept into his heart, his face broke into a strange look.
He stood up calmly, then muttered: "Please give me a minute, I will be back right away-"
Even before his speech finished, he was already far away, his voice reverberating as he left the large space quickly.
Then large screams from outside rang out, Drino cut off his right arm and threw it away, then it exploded violently.
For a few minutes, screams continued to ring out from outside as all the Demi Gods looked at one another in confusion.
Some frowned while others quietly moved their chairs a little farther from Mole.
Only when the screams died down, did Drino finally return into the large hall.
He looked calm and composed, as if it was someone else outside screaming just now.
Clearing his throat again, he said: "Sorry for the disturbance, I had something important to do."
"Thank god, lord, you didn't overreact." Lizzi said, wiping the sweat away from his forehead.
"Uh about that arm of yours..." one of the Demi Gods asked, the arm was still growing, the regeneration had slowed down in this place because of the various protective measures.
"It is nothing, an insect bit me so I had to remove it. Anyway, back to the main topic, we will very soon be going to greet our friend Vritra, our main task is to kill him!"
Drino said, looking straight at the level 4 Demi God.
"I see, well you can call me Zihong and I will be leaving now, when things start, I will be there." Zihong spoke, then disappeared.
It wasn't his own body of course, just a trick of possession he had learnt from his new good friend.
Everyone stood up as Zihong left, bowing to him, all of them also hoped to quickly increase their strength.
But the games are far too dangerous, and might even take years or hundreds of years between each of them.
After Zihong was gone they sat back down, there were still seven Demi Gods and with this new addition, they would have nothing to fear.
Even the mood in the hall became much more confident after his brief appearance.
"First, I will try to kill Vritra and unlike before I won't go easy on him or play around, if he plays tricks, then you all can join."
The plan was pretty simple but the details would be explained by Lizzi.
The smile on Drino's face widened, these Demi Gods all had vast armies under them, and a lot of powerful people.
So they can first send some to test the waters, this time for sure, Drino will kill the guy who disrespected him so much.
Even destroyed his body.
'Vritra, very soon, I will be there to behead you and then make you watch as I kill everyone you care for!!'
In a room, a man with a short height lay over the bed, screaming in his sleep as if he was seeing some nightmare.
There were marks all over his skin, as if he was beaten very brutally.
The room was full of trophies, each bigger and more special than the other, there were so many trophies that a big ground of several kilometres radius could be covered with them.
The room itself wasn't as big of course but spatial ability was used to place all the trophies there.
Even the floor had trophies on it, here and there.
The man screamed louder and rolled, falling off the bed with a loud thud and hit his head against the floor.
"Aghhh my eye! Damnit someone come here!! Uwaaaaah!!" he screamed, having accidentally hit his eye against a trophy, which pierced through his eyeball.
This was clearly not the first time it had happened.
A couple of maids rushed into the room, pulled out the trophy, poured some sort of potion.
Put him back over the bed and then left.
But not before putting the trophy back at the right place.
The room was back to silence once again, but the sound of whipping was still ringing in his ears.
This was of course none other than Petophil, the lawyer who had fought against Vritra and got punished by Evelyn.
His father is an important figure and a really really busy person, since his childhood, even he himself had only seen his father not more than three times.
Including at his birth.
Just to prove that he is a worthy son, Petophil had done so much, he had won all sorts of awards.
Gone to far away places to get knowledge, and became the best lawyer there is, he had never lost a single case.
This was the first time he lost, and it was so bad that he can no longer enter a court.
He had been thoroughly destroyed by that guy Vritra, there was nothing he could do to Evelyn.
So all his anger surged for only one person, because of him, his father had to see such embarrassing moments of his life.
He even left him to get beaten in the prison for a few days.
And told Petophil to never call him father again, it was like everything had ended in a single day.
How can he just let Vritra live peacefully?
Petophil wanted to take revenge so badly, all the clients he had helped before, which were mostly Demi Gods or other important figures were called.
He even called the head of the Nine Pacts, whose leader is at the 7th level, he can obliterate someone like Vritra in a second.
Now that he was unable to sleep, Petophil decided to just go ahead and start the meeting already.
He sat up then jumped off the bed-
THUD
But the same trophy with a pointy head pierced through his feet, as Petophil screamed and fell.
Ten minutes later, Petophil sat inside a room.
There was no one else other than a few maids who were from different races, and were beauties according to him.
They served him some food, and finally he connected to several important figures.
Their silhouettes appeared on the chairs, all sitting silently and waited for the popular ex-lawyer Petophil to speak.
"As you all know, a man dared to challenge me and play dirty. The context is simple, I want him dead as quickly as possible."
Petophil announced as he glanced at the several figures, who were all heads of big organizations.
"Sir Petophil, that is a small matter, I alone can take care of this." The head of the Nine Pacts spoke confidently.
With his strength how can someone at just the 3rd level be of any difficulty, he would just need to send a few underlings to kill him.
"No no, I don't just want him to die." Petophil spoke, making others confused then he added with a grin.

"I want Vritra to suffer, so instead of just killing him, keep harassing him. Keep sending strong Demi Gods to make his life a living hell. I want you all to personally focus on this task, send your best and most troublesome guys to do it. And once I have had enough fun, we can kill him." Petophil spoke, his smile widening.
Just imagining that guy suffering made him so happy.
"Haha Sir Petophil, I didn't expect you to be so petty and sadistic, but that is doable, we all have enough time to bully that kid, don't worry and leave this to us."
The leader of Nine Pacts spoke and the others chimed in.
There were many other Demi Gods who all would do this to gain Petophil's favour, his father worked for a higher being.
And he himself was quite capable.
After giving a few more instructions, he dismissed them and decided to go and try to sleep again.
While walking back to his room, Petophil was grinning ear to ear and laughing strangely.
Very soon, he will get back his position and the respect he had lost, he will regain it all.
And prove to his father, that he is indeed his son.
While others were making plans to kill or torture him, Vritra was preparing for a peaceful life, hoping to enjoy this peace for some time.
He sat in the House of Darkness, absorbing the energy from the orbs.
In the end, it took them a bit longer than expected but after two and a half weeks, the nine of them were finally done.
All of them had reached the level 3 of Demi Gods, their strength increased exponentially.
Vritra felt he could destroy the entire continent with a couple of punches at most.
This feeling was really satisfying but of course, because of what Shitless had said, Vritra was nowhere near satisfied with this.
He needed to increase his strength quickly but the games could take a long time and even so, it would be very difficult.
So that path can't be chosen to quickly increase his strength.
Only Divine could help him with it for now, and even that guy will be gone soon.
Vritra sighed as he opened his eyes and glanced around, the auras of them all had gotten very strong.
Even the air in the hall felt heavier than before because of their growth.
But what surprised him was Shitless, there wasn't any energy emanating from him instead, his physique had improved instead.
The complete change was to his body, which was shining like some metal even in normal form, especially his bald head.

The room was full of trophies, each bigger and more special than the other, there were so many trophies that a big ground of several kilometres radius could be covered with them.
The room itself wasn't as big of course but spatial ability was used to place all the trophies there.
Even the floor had trophies on it, here and there.
The man screamed louder and rolled, falling off the bed with a loud thud and hit his head against the floor.
"Aghhh my eye!
Damnit someone come here!!
Uwaaaaah!!" he screamed, having accidentally hit his eye against a trophy, which pierced through his eyeball.
This was clearly not the first time it had happened.
A couple of maids rushed into the room, pulled out the trophy, poured some sort of potion.
Put him back over the bed and then left.
But not before putting the trophy back at the right place.
The room was back to silence once again, but the sound of whipping was still ringing in his ears.
This was of course none other than Petophil, the lawyer who had fought against Vritra and got punished by Evelyn.
His father is an important figure and a really really busy person, since his childhood, even he himself had only seen his father not more than three times.
Including at his birth.
Just to prove that he is a worthy son, Petophil had done so much, he had won all sorts of awards.
Gone to far away places to get knowledge, and became the best lawyer there is, he had never lost a single case.
This was the first time he lost, and it was so bad that he can no longer enter a court.
He had been thoroughly destroyed by that guy Vritra, there was nothing he could do to Evelyn.
So all his anger surged for only one person, because of him, his father had to see such embarrassing moments of his life.
He even left him to get beaten in the prison for a few days.
And told Petophil to never call him father again, it was like everything had ended in a single day.
How can he just let Vritra live peacefully?
Petophil wanted to take revenge so badly, all the clients he had helped before, which were mostly Demi Gods or other important figures were called.
He even called the head of the Nine Pacts, whose leader is at the 7th level, he can obliterate someone like Vritra in a second.
Now that he was unable to sleep, Petophil decided to just go ahead and start the meeting already.
He sat up then jumped off the bed-
THUD
But the same trophy with a pointy head pierced through his feet, as Petophil screamed and fell.
Ten minutes later, Petophil sat inside a room.
There was no one else other than a few maids who were from different races, and were beauties according to him.
They served him some food, and finally he connected to several important figures.
Their silhouettes appeared on the chairs, all sitting silently and waited for the popular ex-lawyer Petophil to speak.
"As you all know, a man dared to challenge me and play dirty.
The context is simple, I want him dead as quickly as possible."
Petophil announced as he glanced at the several figures, who were all heads of big organizations.
"Sir Petophil, that is a small matter, I alone can take care of this." The head of the Nine Pacts spoke confidently.
With his strength how can someone at just the 3rd level be of any difficulty, he would just need to send a few underlings to kill him.
"No no, I don't just want him to die." Petophil spoke, making others confused then he added with a grin.
"I want Vritra to suffer, so instead of just killing him, keep harassing him.
Keep sending strong Demi Gods to make his life a living hell.
I want you all to personally focus on this task, send your best and most troublesome guys to do it.
And once I have had enough fun, we can kill him." Petophil spoke, his smile widening.
Just imagining that guy suffering made him so happy.
"Haha Sir Petophil, I didn't expect you to be so petty and sadistic, but that is doable, we all have enough time to bully that kid, don't worry and leave this to us."
The leader of Nine Pacts spoke and the others chimed in.
There were many other Demi Gods who all would do this to gain Petophil's favour, his father worked for a higher being.
And he himself was quite capable.
After giving a few more instructions, he dismissed them and decided to go and try to sleep again.
While walking back to his room, Petophil was grinning ear to ear and laughing strangely.
Very soon, he will get back his position and the respect he had lost, he will regain it all.
And prove to his father, that he is indeed his son.
While others were making plans to kill or torture him, Vritra was preparing for a peaceful life, hoping to enjoy this peace for some time.
He sat in the House of Darkness, absorbing the energy from the orbs.
In the end, it took them a bit longer than expected but after two and a half weeks, the nine of them were finally done.
All of them had reached the level 3 of Demi Gods, their strength increased exponentially.
Vritra felt he could destroy the entire continent with a couple of punches at most.
This feeling was really satisfying but of course, because of what Shitless had said, Vritra was nowhere near satisfied with this.
He needed to increase his strength quickly but the games could take a long time and even so, it would be very difficult.
So that path can't be chosen to quickly increase his strength.
Only Divine could help him with it for now, and even that guy will be gone soon.
Vritra sighed as he opened his eyes and glanced around, the auras of them all had gotten very strong.
Even the air in the hall felt heavier than before because of their growth.
But what surprised him was Shitless, there wasn't any energy emanating from him instead, his physique had improved instead.
The complete change was to his body, which was shining like some metal even in normal form, especially his bald head.

chapters.title: Chapter 758 Big Babies
paragraphs: Shitless's strength was still at the 3rd level of Demigod, he also got compensated for the earlier level since he wasn't a Demi God earlier unlike the others.
Come to think of it, even Onest was not a Demi God yet.
Strangely, Shitless also finished around the same time as them, which was quite odd.
Was this guy a genius in disguise or something, who always acts useless and is secretly all-powerful?
Is he the Divine? Vritra wondered, but he didn't think too hard since Divine might tell him about it very soon anyway.
Although he didn't want to believe it, there was a high chance he just might be.
Then, will Vritra need to beat up Shitless for all the promised beatings to Divine?
Poor guy, he will be getting so many beatings, maybe having a strong body will help him survive it.
Shitless suddenly felt a shiver, sensing a chilling gaze as he looked around but there was no one nearby.
Did he just hallucinate? Whatever, now that his strength had increased, Shitless could finally be what he had always wanted to be.
The most evil monk, the one who is famous far and wide and children would be afraid of, his stories would ring in all the houses and kids would go to sleep after hearing his name alone.
He laughed strangely to himself.
Shaking his head, Vritra got up and looked at his wives and questioned:
"You all are alright, right?"
"Yes, it's like I am brimming with power, the jump in strength is too dramatic." Diana spoke, rising two whole levels was bigger than she expected.
"Should we try fighting?" Fiona wondered, she wanted to test out her strength and abilities right away.
"Not now, and we can't fight here or it will cause too much destruction." Yennefer said, rising to her feet calmly.
"You all can take some time to rest for now, we have been through a lot, it wouldn't be good for our minds or bodies." Vritra spoke, looking at everyone carefully.
"I wonder if the mugger has returned." Shitless mumbled, getting up he touched his head and found it very smooth again.
After getting up, the nine of them walked outside and found that it was around noon, the sun was high above their heads brightly.
The environment in the Yate Realm was as peaceful as ever, Vritra wondered if the Divine Kage group had made some move already.
He walked towards Gunter's office, but got greeted by an overly enthusiastic guard.
"H- Hello sir, it is a pleasure meeting you. I have been a guard here for five years and never thought one day I would meet you." He muttered nervously.
"...Yea." Vritra just glanced at him and continued walking.
"S- Sir, uh young lord, Lord Gunter had gone outside because of some matters and he left a message for you." The guard said quickly.
He was in his middle age and at the General rank, his strength wasn't bad, but it seemed his right hand was injured badly.
"What is it?" Vritra finally turned and looked at him.
"He asked you to go and meet him at the Hive Mountain." The guard replied in the same enthusiastic tone.
"Why? What is that place?" Vritra looked quizzically and doubtfully at the guard, was he lying to him?
He checked the system message but there was no message announcing that he was lied to.
Gunter didn't even know when Vritra was going to come out, so would he be waiting there all the time like a fool?

"It is a place right outside this continent, in the east, from the main gates, if you keep going forward, you will see the biggest mountain range. That is the Hive Mountains." The guard explained carefully.
Then he added with a shrug: "As for why he wanted you to go there, I am not sure myself."
Vritra just nodded, he wasn't in a hurry to go, he also first needed to meet with Onest.
If he was done with his love play, he could start absorbing the orbs too.
"Do you know where Onest is?" Vritra asked, while letting his senses spread in all directions around the palace.
He wasn't in the palace and a faint presence seemed to be around a house in the distance.
"Yes sir! He lives in house number 101 there, you can find it easily or if you want I can show it to you myself." The guard spoke hurriedly.
"There is no need, I can go there myself." Vritra turned and started walking towards the house with all the others.
His wives and Shitless followed, they were also curious about Onest's new love life, and wondered if he had progressed any further with his woman.
The illusory image that Vritra had shown before was actually pretty, and from her clothes she seemed to be from a good house.
At least Onest hadn't fallen for the wrong woman... or so they thought at first.
Just as the group of nine got closer to the said house, they heard loud sounds from inside.
"Daddy, buy me this glyph, I need it urgently."
"Dada, please buy me that outfit, I want to show off to my friends, don't you also want your son to be proud?"
"Dad, can you be quiet? Just hand me some money, I need to go out and drink with a few women, I might bring them home later so don't disturb us."
"Fadah, gib me maney aye I need it to get a present for ya!"
Hearing the four loud voices from inside, Vritra looked around and wondered if they had come to the wrong place somehow.
But he could clearly sense Onest's presence from this house, why would he be here?
KNOCK KNOCK
After some hesitation, Vritra knocked on the door and stepped back, waiting quietly.
There was yet another fight inside, maybe a quarrel over who would go to open the door first.
After a minute, finally the door opened and a guy in his early twenties appeared there.
"What ya want? I don't have-" this was the fourth voice, he spoke arrogantly and in a vulgar way but paused upon seeing the seven beautiful women.
His eyes widened, woah such women can exist? And why were they all together in front of his house?
"COUGH Ladiez, I am the man of this house and I am pretty rich, you would be shocked to knaw ma fadah." He spoke, trying to speak like a normal human being.
"Sigh. Can you call Onest out?" Vritra interrupted, taking a step forward to block his view completely.
"Who are ya? Donchu dare picka fight with me, leave before I snap!" he spoke in a rather strange manner.
It was like those thugs, even among the thugs, the lowest of the lowest would speak like that.
Vritra frowned, holding back from slapping this young guy but it seemed this guy wanted to get beat up too badly.
"So ladiez, any of ya want to be-"
SLAP
Vritra gave a light slap, but even a light slap was powerful enough to make the head of this guy hit the doorframe and bounce back loudly.
He was seeing stars, as blood trickled down slowly.
"Aghhhhhhh b- blood, I am going to kill ya, you basta how dare ya!!" he screamed, pouncing at Vritra wildly.
SLAP
This slap made him roll dramatically in the air a few times and then get tossed back into the house again.
"Brother! What is wrong? Who did this?" suddenly the three other brothers of this guy came to rescue him.
All three of them looked nearly the same, in fact all four of them, as if they were quadruplets.
"Did you hurt my brother?!" another guy asked, glaring at Vritra before running towards him in rage.
BANG
This time Shitless was the one to kick the guy in the chest, how can he just let Vritra have all the fun here.
But in his excitement he kicked a bit too hard, breaking several of his ribs and making him smash hard against the wall behind him.
"Ahhhhhh M- Murder, my brother was murdered by this Baldy uwaaaaah Mommyyyyy Daddddyyyyyyy, uwaaaaahh" the remaining two began to scream and cry loudly.
The one slapped by Vritra looked back in terror, shaking as he too began to call for his father, no his fadah.
Vritra rolled his eyes, these guys sure seemed confident of their father, as if he would come and solve everything for them.
"What the fuck happened now?" from inside a raging man with bloodshot eyes and dark circles under his eyes walked out angrily.
He looked tired and pitiful beyond words.
It was none other than Onest, the proud thief and their friend.
Vritra blinked his eyes in confusion, he looked at the four crying grown men and then at Onest.
Before he could ask anything, the same mature woman they had seen eating with Onest appeared from inside.
She looked in shock at her injured children then angrily at the Baldy she had seen kicking her son.
She thought it was Shitless who had hurt both her children.
"Honey! What are you doing just standing there, someone hurt our children, you need to beat the shit out of them!!" the woman urged Onest angrily.
This statement surprised the nine, as they looked at the woman then at Onest, then at the children and finally back at Onest again.
Our children?
What had happened in just two weeks, that Onest got such grown ass children.
The said children looked quite similar to his own age too.
"Pfftttt-" Shitless almost burst out laughing seeing the dead look on Onest's face but covered his mouth in time.
But his shoulders were still shaking badly, Vritra also couldn't help but laugh.
This guy got such big babies? He was definitely scammed.

chapters.title: Chapter 759 The Endless Contract
paragraphs: Onest looked very pitiful, surrounded by the five members of his new family. His mature-looking wife, who seemed nearly twice his age.
And the kids who were probably a similar age as his.
Shitless was the first to burst out laughing at his state, Vritra followed, while the women didn't want to be rude to the already pitiful Onest.
So they turned around and laughed quietly among themselves.
"Congratulations mugger, when did you get married?" Shitless asked.
"Great job my friend, you have won in life. A beautiful wife and several cute children, what more would one want, congrats." Vritra said, amidst his laugh.
Seeing him in such a tragedy, their first response as brotherly friends was to laugh.
"Y- You guys..." Onest wiped a tear, he seemed to have changed quite a bit in such a short span of time.
"Honey, even if they are your friends, how can you allow them to just hit your sons? You have to hold justice for them!! Right now!!" the woman shouted.
"Stay quiet." Vritra said, the smile disappeared from his face as he looked at the woman and she suddenly found herself unable to utter a word.
She kept trying to scream but no sound came, she was horrified badly.
Joking was fine among them, but who allowed this woman to speak between them?
"Uh... V- Vritra, can you not uhm hurt her?" Onest asked hurriedly, surprising them all.
Frowning, Vritra stopped using the ability Forbidden, and spoke playfully: "Looks like you love your wife too much, sigh guess you can't continue on this path anymore."
"HONEY!! I don't want these guys in my house ever! You hear me? These criminals, make them leave and we need to heal our children." The woman spoke quickly.
"O- Ok, let's talk outside." Onest said as he walked out of the house and before the woman could say anything more, he was gone.
Vritra shook his head, he could tell Onest was on the verge of crashing out, so he turned and disappeared as well.
After a moment, the woman and her children were left there standing in a daze.
"Damnit, once you return I will make you sleep on the floor!" she shouted.
After flying up into the sky, the ten of them stopped, Vritra waited for Onest to tell what had happened.
They didn't make any more fun of him, or he might go mad for real.
"I- I was scammed SOB." he sobbed quietly, wanted to cry at his fate but no tear would come.
"So, just what happened? Why are you even listening to her?" Vritra asked, he looked as if he had been doing house chores for days.
Onest took a deep breath and then began to tell the story slowly.
That woman is Zira, Onest fell for her after meeting her in the market.
She was falling and he caught her, their eyes met and sparks were created between them instantly.
She was beautiful, mature and voluptuous enough that she easily caught Onest's eyes.
He wanted to know more about her and she showed the same enthusiasm.
They ate together in a hotel, chatting for hours, getting to know a lot about each other. He even told her about the real profession he is so proud of.
At first Onest felt she would just leave but she actually didn't mind, saying that everyone could have a bad past.
It's not like that could be changed, some things are just out of their choices and control.
Onest just fell deeper for her, she was so understanding and smart, she really seemed the perfect one for him.
And seeing Vritra's family, he too wanted to experience a happy life so Onest decided to give love a chance.
After staying together, he dropped her at home after which he rushed to the Yate Realm.
And found that others had already started, so he would have to wait but it made him happy.
This way he could spend more time with Zira, and over the next few days they truly were together all the time.
They even had good chemistry in bed, seriously this seemed like the perfect relationship.
Onest just wanted a happy relation like Vritra, someone who cares so much for him, and she really had all good qualities.
Just like her, Onest was ready to not care about her past, and very soon she was the one to propose.
That was when the nightmare began, she made him sign something, making him swear over his respectful profession of thievery and his dead mother.
Onest had gone mad in love, he didn't really care and didn't know that the past he didn't care about had four children, nearly his age.
Only once they shifted to their house did he find out that he had been trapped into becoming their daddy, and would need to keep feeding the five of them.
He was completely trapped, that contract mentioned that he can't leave her or the kids, have to listen to her, protect her and whatnot.
Normally Onest wouldn't have cared much for it, but he had sworn over his dead mother and profession so he can't break it.
"And that's it, now I am stuck with them." Onest muttered, looking depressed and hollow.
"At least she doesn't have any other man, so it works." Shitless said, patting his friend's shoulder.
Finally, he got a chance to make fun of Onest and he wasn't going to let go of it easily.
"Hmm want me to get rid of the five of them? Or I can make them willingly break this marriage." Vritra asked, rolling his eyes at Shitless who kept laughing.
"Sigh we can't do that, she had made such a big contract and I believed her blindly, fuck I am so damn stupid!!" Onest felt like beating the shit out of himself.
But he can't even harm himself as recorded in the contract, so he can't blackmail Zira into ending the marriage.
Vritra too felt like slapping this guy, how can he be so stupid? Wasn't he a thief, aren't they supposed to be very smart to make a fool of others?
Yet here is this guy, just got fooled so badly by a woman. Was it because of love?
Vritra glanced back at his wives, thankfully all his women are good, he doesn't want to imagine having someone like Zira in his life.
"Do you have that contract on you?" Vritra asked, without seeing all the terms he can't do anything.
Onest was clearly trapped in this well-proof plan.
"S- She took it with herself..." Onest said, making Vritra sigh deeply.
"B- But I do remember it all, I can write quickly!" Onest knew only Vritra could help him now and he was so done with this love thing for now.
Vritra nodded and Onest took out a very long paper, he seemed prepared for it, and quickly began to write.
Thankfully at their level of strength, remembering such things was a piece of cake.
That Zira was smart enough to not even give a copy to Onest so he can't find any flaws, but thankfully he got to read it all.
And he really couldn't find any flaws at all.
The others waited as Onest finished writing a contract so long that it could fill a few textbooks, that woman really didn't miss anything.
Vritra held the thick bundle of papers, he looked at Onest, his image had fallen even further.
He used to think only Shitless is the slow one in their group but it seemed this guy was no better.
Vritra and all the women began to read the contract and gasped at how much thought Zira had put into it.
That woman is so sly, it's like she had thought of almost all possibilities and escape from this marriage is impossible.
Unless Onest breaks his oath.
"Bro, you are kinda fucked!" Shitless said after reading a few lines, he patted his shoulder again and nodded in sympathy.
It took a few minutes to complete the whole contract, finally the seven women looked at Onest pitifully.
No matter what Onest does, there is just no way he can get out of this marriage in this life.
Vritra remained silent for a few moments, then he looked at Onest and spoke: "There is only one way that you can be a free man again."
"There is a way?!!" Onest's eyes glowed with hope, he asked excitedly: "What is it?"
"Only if she very willingly wants to end this marriage and leave you, otherwise you can't do anything." Vritra replied.
Onest suddenly lost his energy, he knew that too, there is no way that bitc- wife of his will leave him willingly.
Damnit, he can't even curse her out.
And he can't even make her hate him or make her want to leave him in any way possible.
"That is of no use, is there really no other way?" Onest looked dejected and broken.
"Of course it can work, don't worry, let me handle this; I'd win." Vritra said, laughing lightly.
Still this whole situation was kinda funny.
"Really? T- Thank you, but I gotta leave now, I can't stay away from her for too long..." Onest said, looking so pitiful.
He had lost his freedom completely.
"Alright, I will start the plan soon, just do what you normally do." Vritra said as Onest left after saying goodbyes.
"Uwahahahahaha" Shitless hugged his belly and laughed like a madman.
Vritra didn't interrupt him for a few moments and then asked: "Sir Shitless, I have got a small task for you, would you mind doing it?"
And Shitless was scared shitless upon hearing that, he jumped back in fright and had a bad feeling in his heart.
