His mature-looking wife, who seemed nearly twice his age.
And the kids who were probably a similar age as his.
Shitless was the first to burst out laughing at his state, Vritra followed, while the women didn't want to be rude to the already pitiful Onest.
So they turned around and laughed quietly among themselves.
"Congratulations mugger, when did you get married?" Shitless asked.
"Great job my friend, you have won in life.
A beautiful wife and several cute children, what more would one want, congrats." Vritra said, amidst his laugh.
Seeing him in such a tragedy, their first response as brotherly friends was to laugh.
"Y- You guys..." Onest wiped a tear, he seemed to have changed quite a bit in such a short span of time.
"Honey, even if they are your friends, how can you allow them to just hit your sons?
You have to hold justice for them!!
Right now!!" the woman shouted.
"Stay quiet." Vritra said, the smile disappeared from his face as he looked at the woman and she suddenly found herself unable to utter a word.
She kept trying to scream but no sound came, she was horrified badly.
Joking was fine among them, but who allowed this woman to speak between them?
V- Vritra, can you not uhm hurt her?" Onest asked hurriedly, surprising them all.
Frowning, Vritra stopped using the ability Forbidden, and spoke playfully: "Looks like you love your wife too much, sigh guess you can't continue on this path anymore."
"HONEY!!
I don't want these guys in my house ever!
You hear me?
These criminals, make them leave and we need to heal our children." The woman spoke quickly.
"O- Ok, let's talk outside." Onest said as he walked out of the house and before the woman could say anything more, he was gone.
Vritra shook his head, he could tell Onest was on the verge of crashing out, so he turned and disappeared as well.
After a moment, the woman and her children were left there standing in a daze.
"Damnit, once you return I will make you sleep on the floor!" she shouted.
After flying up into the sky, the ten of them stopped, Vritra waited for Onest to tell what had happened.
They didn't make any more fun of him, or he might go mad for real.
"I- I was scammed SOB." he sobbed quietly, wanted to cry at his fate but no tear would come.
"So, just what happened?
Why are you even listening to her?" Vritra asked, he looked as if he had been doing house chores for days.

She was beautiful, mature and voluptuous enough that she easily caught Onest's eyes.
He wanted to know more about her and she showed the same enthusiasm.
They ate together in a hotel, chatting for hours, getting to know a lot about each other.
He even told her about the real profession he is so proud of.
At first Onest felt she would just leave but she actually didn't mind, saying that everyone could have a bad past.
It's not like that could be changed, some things are just out of their choices and control.
Onest just fell deeper for her, she was so understanding and smart, she really seemed the perfect one for him.
And seeing Vritra's family, he too wanted to experience a happy life so Onest decided to give love a chance.
After staying together, he dropped her at home after which he rushed to the Yate Realm.
And found that others had already started, so he would have to wait but it made him happy.
This way he could spend more time with Zira, and over the next few days they truly were together all the time.
They even had good chemistry in bed, seriously this seemed like the perfect relationship.
Onest just wanted a happy relation like Vritra, someone who cares so much for him, and she really had all good qualities.
Just like her, Onest was ready to not care about her past, and very soon she was the one to propose.
That was when the nightmare began, she made him sign something, making him swear over his respectful profession of thievery and his dead mother.

He was completely trapped, that contract mentioned that he can't leave her or the kids, have to listen to her, protect her and whatnot.
Normally Onest wouldn't have cared much for it, but he had sworn over his dead mother and profession so he can't break it.
"And that's it, now I am stuck with them." Onest muttered, looking depressed and hollow.
"At least she doesn't have any other man, so it works." Shitless said, patting his friend's shoulder.
Finally, he got a chance to make fun of Onest and he wasn't going to let go of it easily.

Or I can make them willingly break this marriage." Vritra asked, rolling his eyes at Shitless who kept laughing.
"Sigh we can't do that, she had made such a big contract and I believed her blindly, fuck I am so damn stupid!!" Onest felt like beating the shit out of himself.
But he can't even harm himself as recorded in the contract, so he can't blackmail Zira into ending the marriage.
Vritra too felt like slapping this guy, how can he be so stupid?
Wasn't he a thief, aren't they supposed to be very smart to make a fool of others?
Yet here is this guy, just got fooled so badly by a woman.
Was it because of love?
Vritra glanced back at his wives, thankfully all his women are good, he doesn't want to imagine having someone like Zira in his life.
"Do you have that contract on you?" Vritra asked, without seeing all the terms he can't do anything.
Onest was clearly trapped in this well-proof plan.

Vritra nodded and Onest took out a very long paper, he seemed prepared for it, and quickly began to write.

Unless Onest breaks his oath.

chapters.title: Chapter 760 The Fiance
paragraphs: KNOCK KNOCK
The quietness of the big palace was broken by a light knocking sound, the person who had just knocked seemed very nervous.
Gulping, he wiped the sweat from his forehead and knelt, pressing his forehead against the floor, waiting for the person inside to respond.
"What is it?" a melodious female voice sounded from the inside, lacking emotion yet still containing such pressure.
"Y- Your father has asked for you to b- be present in the Cloud Hall." The man replied in a shaky voice, appearing as if he had aged several hundred years in a few seconds.
"..." there was complete silence then the voice rang out again.
"Is he here again?" she asked, a hint of annoyance and anger could clearly be sensed, and that scared the guy outside even more.
His heart thumped so wildly, he was a level 10 Demi God, yet was being so fearful right now.
He couldn't understand how to answer that, a mistake might cost him too much.
"...Y- Yes, he is here." Finally, mustering every bit of his courage, the man answered.
Tsk!
There was another long silence and then she spoke: "Get lost!"
"Y- yes I will..." quickly getting up, he ran away hurriedly but careful enough to not make any sound.
Inside the room, Evelyn who was busy creating a strange looking ring, felt so annoyed.
She was creating this special present for her husband and her father had to disturb her just now?
Really so, so annoying, she hates them all.
'I wish I can just kill them all and go live with my husband.' A crazed look appeared in Evelyn's eyes as she thought about her man.
But then she put away the ring and sighed, she can't leave yet or be together with him.
There is still some time for that.
Taking a deep breath, she decided to go and see what her father had to say this time.
She looked around at her room which was pretty big, the walls were completely filled with images of Vritra she had created.
She even had various of his clothes.
The Sin Wheel that Vritra has, doesn't work to just give him something. It works like an exchange so most of the times Vritra obtained something, something of his own disappeared.
He got a lot of clothes and stuff so he wouldn't even notice such small things.
And it was mostly clothes he had already worn and Vritra never really cared about that.
Yet, all that was now adorning her room, the winter coat he used on the apocalyptic planet was lying over her bed, his scent still lingering.
After glancing around, she walked out of the room, her expression changing completely.
There was complete darkness surrounding her house, she didn't want others to go in there and touch anything.
So, she had put it in a separate realm.
After getting out of her room, she left the separate realm and came out. Looking up, she saw the sky which was full of stars.
Though the stars were the gods who had gone into eternal slumber, since those beings can't be killed they are put to sleep.
Few of them had even been put there by Evelyn.
There is an old saying among the higher beings, that people often recite when gazing up at those stars.
-When the night is clear, the humblest slaves shine the brightest-
Evelyn remembered it, she had to make more arrangements so Vritra continues on his path to godhood.
The whole thing will be tough, but she will be with him till the end; once he blossoms as a Titan, not even the higher beings or beings above could do anything to him.
With various thoughts about her love, she looked in the direction of the Cloud Hall, which was just a fancy meeting room of her father.
'I wonder if grandpa would be there too.' She wondered, her expressions were unreadable.
In the surroundings, all the guards instantly tilted their heads downward when Evelyn appeared, her beauty had made one of the Demi Gods go mad.
He was killed so brutally by her father and grandfather, it still makes them all shiver.
His flesh was fed to pet dogs right in front of everyone, after torture that continued for a long time.
Evelyn ignored them all, not wanting to waste any time here she teleported directly to the entrance of the Cloud Hall.
She paused outside the gates, sensing how many people were inside.
Her father is there, thankfully her grandfather wasn't here for now, and aside from her father there was only one other person.
His presence made her frown.
At the top of the gate of the Cloud Hall was a name written in big letters.
'Vaspera...' Evelyn wanted to quickly change it with Arclis, but it was taking so long despite everything.
Sighing, she pushed the gate open, there were no guards around it as her father didn't like having people around himself.
Evelyn walked inside, her gaze first met her father's as she gave a small nod.
Her father went by the title: Fader, it had been so long since anyone last saw his real appearance.
His body is always wrapped by pieces of cloth, not even a tiny bit of his skin was visible, he also doesn't allow anyone to get close to him.
Only his pupils could be seen, though his body was muscular and strong.
He half lay over his throne, his moon shaped eyes locking on his daughter.
"Here comes my good daughter, look who is here to meet you, your fiance." Fader spoke, he is normally quite friendly.
But gets so agitated if someone gets too close, breaks any rules, after all it was the Vespera family's duty to uphold the laws amongst the higher beings.
One of the most powerful families, she even got to be a judge in the world court.
"Hmm." Evelyn maintained the same look on her beautiful face when she greeted him.
The entirety of the Cloud Hall really seemed to be made of clouds, the chairs, the floor but there was no ceiling, the stars could be seen perfectly.
Finally her gaze shifted to the man sitting on a chair to her left, he wore a black robe which he felt she liked.
And there is a reason behind him thinking that.
While Evelyn was away, this wannabe fiance of hers bribed one of the Demi Gods, a cleaner there, to look into her room.
And even though she was afraid, she still gave in to her greed, and quickly went in and was only able to bring out a single robe which belonged to Vritra.
And since then, he had been wearing clothes like that to impress her.
This was Armin Garissa, the future ruler of the famous Garissa family, who are like the underworld among the higher beings.
If Vespera family controls the laws and punishments then the Garissa family controls the unlawful ones.
But both families are among the very top.
Which is exactly why, Fader and her grandfather had agreed to this marriage, letting Evelyn marry this guy will literally allow them to rule the higher beings.
Of course Evelyn never agreed to it, unfortunately despite being excellent at almost everything, her family put little importance on her refusals.
They still went ahead and gave him the title of Evelyn's fiance.
Armin looked like a guy in his thirties, mature and easygoing with handsome looks and long white hair.
He too is quite excellent and would take the seat of the next ruler instead of his elder brother, there doesn't seem to be any flaws in him.
"Hello Evelyn, you are looking gorgeous." Armin complimented, as he stepped forward and presented a gift he had brought.
It was a set of white flowers which were constantly releasing a good fragrance.
"This is Forever White Sanga, a flower which never withers and will forever be beautiful and fragrant just like you haha and the white colour will remind you of me, do you like it?"
Armin said, a big overly enthusiastic smile on his face.
"Yea very much, remember to throw it in the dustbin on your way out though." Evelyn said, taking two steps back.
As if both Armin and his flowers are plagued and contagious, her eyes were full of hate as she looked at him.
"Hahaha don't be so shy my daughter, Armin don't mind her.
You know she gets shy in front of you, leave the flower here, I am sure she will want to put it in her room soon." Fader laughed, his blue eyes shining.
"I sure hope she is just being shy, I wouldn't want this beautiful flower to break, right?" Armin said, a psychotic look flashing in his eyes.
But the look was gone as fast as it came, and he was all smiles again.
"My daughter, since your fiance is already here, why don't you treat him to some delicious food?
Your grandfather had gone to meet his grandpa, if you are wondering." Fader added, then he stood up and disappeared.
"So Evelyn, my dear fiance, shall we go?" Armin chuckled, clearly aware of the hate in her eyes but that only made him want to break her more.
'Sigh my love, get here quickly, I want you to protect me just like you do for your other women and put this pig in his place.' Evelyn thought, looking dazed out.
Just like how Vritra punished Jack and stole Fiona away.
Shaking her head she began walking out, she had to bring this pig to his feeding station after all.
Then she would get back to working on the ring.

chapters.title: Chapter 761 The Legendary Brothers
paragraphs: The market was full of talk, everyone there seemed to be muttering about something.
A brand new day brought along a lot of gossip, and a lot of people were walking around in the market.
Each had something more to add into the ongoing rumour.
All the people who had just come there for usual shopping or strolling all had curious looks as they asked around for what was going on.
Among them was also Zira who had come to do some shopping, and four of her children who were just strolling around.
They all looked at the bustling street which seemed far more lively than usual.
"Big brother, do you think something is happening?" the second brother asked.
"Big big brother, I think something is happening." The third brother said.
"Big bras, something already happened." The fourth and youngest one spoke.
"Stop it you idiots, we will just go and ask someone about it." The oldest spoke. After looking around, he saw a group of three men talking about something.
"Woah big brother, you are a genius!" the second brother, who was the slowest of all, said.
The three walked towards the group and it was the youngest who spoke first:
"What ya discussing, tell ma before I beat ya asses."
"What did you say, you bastard!" the three men were instantly enraged, ready to beat up the rowdy young guy.
"What? My fadah can beachu up, tell ma everythi-" before he could finish speaking, the oldest shut his mouth and spoke:
"Sorry for that, he is a little retarded. Anyway, can you tell us why the market is so lively now?"
While speaking he passed on a few silver coins and the three men calmed down instantly.
"Hmph, good that you know your place. It's better to not fight with adults or you might get your ass handed to you someday." One of the three spoke while taking the coins.
"I heard some big shots are coming to this place, one of them is the richest person in the world and the other is the strongest, the two brothers who control the world from the shadows."

"Yes, they have come this time just to find a bride for the older brother, they are looking for an excellent woman, the most beautiful and talented. Whoever marries him, will have hundreds of generations set for life."
The three men then enthusiastically spoke some very exaggerated rumours, adding some on their own.
In the rumours, the two foreigners who were coming were so powerful, influential, rich and handsome that there had never ever been someone like that.
It was so exaggerated that the four brothers wondered if the gods themselves had descended there.
They asked around, getting almost the same information from everyone, and the crowd kept increasing.
Everyone now wanted to see exactly who the two brothers were who could create such a ruckus.
Hearing about the marriage, many of the women began to get ready and hoped they were the lucky ones.
All of them had this feeling deep in their heart that the prince charming would see them and fall at first sight, they would be the chosen one.
Live like the queen of the world and have all the power, while such a handsome, rich and all powerful man would be soft and kind to them and listen to them.
Which woman wouldn't dream of such a thing, so even the women who were already happily married, had a little more makeup applied that day.
More than men, women could be seen in the market, all of them trying to act graceful, classy and rich.
Zira who was holding the bags full of vegetables looked around curiously, but she didn't pause to check around.
She had to return home quickly and spend more time with her husband, get some more money and find out more about him.
Although she had managed to fool him, she still knew very little about Onest.
She didn't even know about the people who came to see him earlier, so Zira was in a hurry to find out as much as possible.
One thing she was certain about was that he is very strong and if she plays her cards right then she will be able to live very very long.
Get a lot of money and he is plenty handsome, most men around are nowhere near that so she wouldn't want them anyway.

'I have brought the ingredients of his favourite dishes, then I will wear the sexy lingerie to entice him. But why doesn't he get drunk sigh, if he got drunk then getting the information would have been so easy.'
She wanted to use Onest and create a life of utter luxury for herself and her children.
Rushing hurriedly to her home, she spotted her children who were standing in front of a shop.
"What are you doing here?" Zira asked.
"Mother! You are here, have you heard about the rumours? We just came here to buy some things but there is something big happening here." The third brother spoke, looking enthusiastic.

"Hmm you can tell me about that later, but first let's return home, you have to make sure to put your best behaviour. We have to keep Onest happy as much as we can." Zira said, not really interested in the rumours.
Then she started walking back towards their house.
Only after marrying Onest was she able to shift into the Yate Realm, and get such a big house.
He is such a gold mine, with endless supplies.
Of course the house was given by Gunter, since he is a good friend of Art.
The four brothers were too excited, they followed along their mother and began to tell her about everything they had just heard.

"What? I feel these rumours are just fake, I haven't heard there is any exceptional beauty in the Yate Realm, why would they be coming here?" Zira said, glancing into her bucket to once again check things.
"But mother, I heard the two brothers will be here very soon, like by 9, we have to go see them!!" the oldest of the four said.
And the four began to urge her repeatedly, so Zira sighed and gave in, she was mostly doing it all for her children anyway.
Her old husband who gave her these four children was too poor, weak and good natured, she couldn't stand him at all.
"Fine fine, I will go. For now, make sure to behave in front of your father." She added.
Before long they were back at home.
Onest would need just a thought to kill the five of them, but he had some principles that he couldn't break.
He could not break the oath over his profession and his parents, who were long dead.
He didn't know exactly how they had died as he was too young at that time but it was probably some demon outbreak.
The only memory Onest had was being hidden under the floor in a secret compartment until he fell unconscious from hunger.
And was later taken out by some warrior who then left him at some church.
Though he never liked that place and left, accidentally stumbling over a bunch of goblins who almost managed to kill him.
Yet that was the moment where his journey actually started.
It was mostly his luck that he had managed to live.
He sat on a chair, head resting over his hands, as he stared at the wall in deep thoughts.
Soon the five entered the house, and Zira called out: "Honey, we are back, I am going to cook your favourite dishes right away."
TUK TUK TUK
Onest didn't reply nor did he look at them, he tapped over the table with his finger.
'What's wrong with him?' Zira wondered, without disturbing her gold mine she walked into the kitchen.
"Fadah, a boya hit me earlier, ya have to go and beat his ass up!" the fourth son spoke, anger written all over his face.
"...Sure, bring me there later in the day, I will see who it was." Onest replied after thinking, he wasn't sure what Vritra was planning.
But he could only put his faith in him.
It didn't take long for Zira to prepare everything, at least she wasn't bad at cooking.
Still, Onest barely ate anything and got up, he changed his clothes and was ready to go out.
It was already the time when he was supposed to go out.
"Fadah, ya ready?" Fourth brother asked, grinning ear to ear.
"I- I will go with you, I need to make sure you don't beat anyone up too bad." Zira said hurriedly.
Before she wasn't really interested but now, she wanted to see what exactly was happening.
And soon the six of them were all outside the house, walking towards the market.
Upon entering the market, they noticed how crowded it was everywhere.
"Huh? What is happening?" Onest asked, poor guy couldn't even leave his house much because of that contract.
"Daddy, I heard some big shots are coming here, so all these people have gathered to see them." One of the brothers answered.
'Big shots?' Onest paused, standing in the crowd as he looked at the empty road.
"I still think that's fake news, why would they even come her-" Zira was speaking when someone suddenly shouted.
"H- Here! They are finally here!"
All the gazes instantly moved towards the road, as thunderous sounds rang out.
It wasn't carriages or horses, something bigger, grander!
Everyone looked on with baited breath and soon they all took a step back in bafflement.
Two dragons soon became visible, majestic and dangerous, all of them had their breath stolen at the sight in the sky.

chapters.title: Chapter 762 The Arrogant Raldy
paragraphs: Unlike everyone's expectations, the people didn't really come from the ground, instead they flew there.
And all the people who had any doubts before, now were sure that they weren't just rumours.
The big shots were actually here.
ROAARRRRRRRRR!
The dragons roared in the air, releasing big clouds of flames as if announcing their entrance.
The first dragon was brown while the other was orange, the second one was a little bigger than the first.
Many fell onto their butts as they stared up in awe.
Most people didn't even get to see a dragon in its real form once in their life, and they got to see two such big dragons.
It was like they were all in a dream.
The ground shook as the dragons slowly descended towards the ground.
As they lowered, the people who were seated on top began to become visible.
The two legendary brothers, the one on orange seemed to be the elder brother and the one on the brown dragon was younger.
Only after the dragons were on the ground and the crowd had moved further and further back were they finally able to see them clearly.
The two brothers were wearing golden embroidered outfits, just the clothes looked so expensive.
The older brother had long black hair and a face so handsome that it made several women in the crowd faint.
His eyes looked sharp and a strange bad boy look was on his face, all in all he looked almost perfect.
On the other hand, his younger brother looked cute and handsome.
He looked to be in his teens, and cheerful, though he clearly seemed flustered by the crowd around them.
The hundreds of people were all looking at them with such gawking eyes.
Though the older brother didn't seem to be affected, like a true warrior he appeared fearless.
"Hello peasants! How does it feel to live in this hell you call your house?" the older brother spoke in a very very arrogant tone.
Many people were shocked, they expected him to be well mannered, but he was so rude.
Though many women were now even deeper in love with him, they needed just this type of bad boy.
"I am Raldy! Put that name deep into your minds, you all are bugs in front of me. COUGH anyway, today I have come to find a wife for myself."
After speaking, Raldy looked around, gazing over all the women.
"B- Big brother, you can't talk like that." The younger brother spoke, tugging his clothes.
"Oh right, this is my younger brother Itch, you can be disrespectful to him if you want, he doesn't mind." Raldy spoke, a look of complete arrogance on his face.
The people were now divided into two teams, one part liked Raldy which was smaller and mostly full of women.
While most were against him, they wanted to beat him up so badly.
But the two dragons which were now floating in the sky were a clear reminder of their pitiful statuses.
They truly were just bugs in front of him, sigh they didn't want to admit it but it was true.
'Raldy? Itch?' Onest looked at the two in surprise, he could tell that this was arranged by Vritra.
And from the way that Raldy guy was speaking, it was probably Baldy, the monk.
But who was this Itch guy and what exactly was their plan? But their entry sure was great, well Vritra's wife is the Dragon Empress so it was a small matter.
"You woman, yes you- no bitch, not you, the one behind you, you old hag, come forward." Raldy pointed at one of the women.
The woman seemed to be in her twenties and looked pretty.
"Tsk go back, not my type."
"B- Big brother, you can't be rude to a lady like that-" Itch spoke while in his mind wondering.
'What am I even doing here? Why am I being tortured like this? Sigh my reputation...'
This guy was none other than Rich, Tiny's brother.
He was kind of abducted by his friend and uncle, Vritra, and then got the plot and his outfit.
This was all too absurd.
More and more people were gathering there, from a few hundred the market was already flooded with a few thousand people.
From houses to even the sky, so many people were there to watch it.
Vritra was there too, though he had not joined the scene yet. Looking at the crowd which kept getting bigger and bigger he smiled.
He had taken Rich's help to spread this rumour, getting there as many people as possible.
It wasn't just to help Onest after all, he needed to earn sin points and make it reach 100 million.
Hoping to upgrade at least one thing.
'Sigh why is everything so costly now?' high in the sky he shook his head.
But Shitless was really doing great, as expected of the evil monk, he is great at doing evil things.
"Ewww you fatty pig, get back, don't you ever bathe? I bet water runs away after you get close to it kakaka!" Raldy laughed loudly, hitting his belly.
"B- Big brother-" Itch was just doing his part, but Raldy suddenly got angry.
"You little bastard, how dare you interrupt me! You aren't my mother's child, you are a damn illegitimate, the son of a commoner, a weak bastard!"
Then he slapped Rich so hard that the guy was thrown a few metres away, bouncing dramatically, as blood trickled down his chin.
Already 99% of the people in the area hated him, instead now most of the women were looking at Itch with kind and motherly eyes.
He looked to be the type they would want to protect, making them all want to go ahead and hug him.
Zira stared at this scene in surprise, just who were these two guys that they were acting so arrogantly here?
No one from the Yate family had come to stop them yet-
"You bastard, how dare you create a ruckus in the Yate Realm, don't you cherish your life!" just as Zira had thought that, a guard jumped out of the crowd.
Pointing a spear at Raldy.
"You dare to point it at me? The Greatest of All Time, Raldy? The one who taught his own father how to walk? The one who taught his maths teacher math? Me?"
Raldy's face literally turned red in rage, he glared at the guard.
He inhaled until his belly bulged, then he spat out breath.
It was like a storm, the guard flew away dramatically, wailing his arms and feet.
That guy seemed to be a general too, and a very powerful and well known one, yet he was blasted away just by a breath?
The people were left gasping.
"Oh woman, you! Yes you, step forward." Suddenly, Raldy who was laughing loudly looked at Zira and spoke hurriedly.
"Huh? Me?" Zira was so baffled, she looked around and there wasn't any other woman beside her.
She looked at Onest, feeling afraid of that Raldy guy, and according to the contract even if he dies, Onest would have to protect her.
"How dare you bastard, she is my wife, choose someone else!" Onest saw the look in Shitless's eyes and understood his part quickly.
He pushed through the crowd and stood proudly in front of the proud and arrogant man.
The public was so tensed.

chapters.title: Chapter 763 The Big Play
paragraphs: "If I make a choice then it can't be changed, just like the crack in a butt!" Raldy spoke firmly, glaring at the man who dared to refute him.
"B- Big brother, you mean the line in a stone?" Itch, who was lying pitifully some distance away, corrected him.
"I don't care who you are or what crack or line, she is my wife, choose someone else or I will kill you right here and now!" Onest shouted back, his fists clenched.
While Zira was feeling so afraid. What is this guy doing? Where is all this love coming from, didn't he hate her quite a bit because of the contract?
She looked at the dragons and was frightened, this stupid Onest might get them killed too.
She knew he is strong but not enough to kill those guys.
"L- Let's just leave, honey, you aren't their match." She muttered, pulling his arm.
"Hmph You think you can just leave now? I have already set my eyes on you, you are going to be my wife no matter what!!" Raldy announced.
The crowd which was rapidly growing were all angry at Raldy, such a pig, how dare he covet someone else's woman and be so arrogant about it.
They were hating him more and more.
"That arrogant bastard, I want to beat his ass up!" someone in their rage accidentally spoke.
"Who was that?!!" Raldy shouted, and he quickly found the target.
With a wave of his hand, the man was pulled forward, then Raldy slapped him away as he too spurted out a blood fountain.
"Someone stop this madman, he is going to kill everyone!"
"H- Help, someone kill this Raldy bastard!" people hid and shouted quickly, there were too many voices.
"Hmph Silence!!" Raldy shouted, and the sound was so loud that everyone shivered.
Nodding, he addressed Zira: "Beauty, I am far better than him, richer, handsome, stronger.
I can give you everything you might want and more, eternal life, unending money, and everything you have ever dreamed of. What can he even give you? Leave him and come to me, be my wife!"
Zira hid behind Onest, how can she just trust any man? She was a cunning woman and unless she is sure of everything she wouldn't make her move.
"Hah I am going to kill you!" Onest screamed, pushed Zira back and rushed forward.
Everyone looked at Onest in pity, that poor guy was fighting to protect his wife, he really loves her so much.
And then there is this shameless Raldy who is trying to steal someone's wife in bright daylight, nightlight?
In any case, they were all angry at him.
Onest launched a punch that struck Raldy's cheek, jerking his head back.
'W- Woah, he is so strong?! I knew I have chosen the best partner for myself!!' Zira was so happy to see the punch land.
She was thinking that Onest would be killed even before he gets any chance to do anything.
"Y- You dare to hurt me?!!" Raldy began to shake wildly, his eyes bloodshot.
He then glared at Onest and shouted: "Dragons, attack this bastard, today I am going to kill him and feed him to all my pets!!"
ROOAAAAARRRRRRRRR
Suddenly the sky brightened as over forty dragons appeared in the sky, they all released fire breath as big pillars of flames shot out into the sky.
The people were so terrified as large shadows loomed over them.
Forty dragons?!!
They couldn't believe that this bum can actually command them all, what is going on?
Has he become the new emperor of the dragons? Otherwise this scene can't be explained.
But wasn't the emperor someone else? They were sure his name was not Raldy, but right now they all were frightened.
Zira stared at the sky in just as much shock, so this guy really was not bluffing, he really is as powerful and capable.
But why would he fall for someone like her?
'Hmm maybe he is taking it as a challenge now that Onest stood up to him, now instead of his choice it is more of his pride?' Zira wondered and a strange feeling began to take shape in her heart.
"H- Hmph as if I would be afraid of a few p- pets GULP." Onest was slightly shaking as he spoke stutteringly.
But internally he was laughing, they really prepared well for this and he could somewhat guess now what they were planning.
From how greedy Zira is, she might really leave him.
But first he needed to be humiliated and act pathetic in front of this Raldy.
Seeing him afraid of the dragons, none in the crowd showed any contempt, instead they all pitied this guy even more.
And praised him that he was standing up for his wife.
"haha Is that not enough to make you feel afraid? Keep them coming, I need more!!" Raldy shouted and then forty more dragons appeared.
Now the sky was full of eighty dragons, many people instantly fainted.
This was an unprecedented event, many wondered if the entire Yate Realm was now going to be destroyed.
But why hadn't Gunter appeared yet?
"S- Sir, please wait." Just then a figure flew from the distance.
It was Gunter, the head of the Yate family, the powerful lord who despite all the hardships hadn't let the Yate family fall apart.
They all respected him, he was the protector of this realm after all.
"L- Lord Gunter is being so respectful to this guy? Why?"
"So he really is so powerful that even Lord Gunter has to show respect?"
They were all in awe but still hated that Raldy guy, they hoped Gunter would beat his ass up.
But it seemed that dream wouldn't be coming true.
"Oh, Gunter you are here? This bastard you are letting live in your realm had made me so angry, I was actually thinking of blowing up this realm." Raldy spoke arrogantly.
Gunter was in on the plan, since his son asked how could he not join.
And the sole reason Vritra wanted him to be a part of it? Of course so more people would come and he can get more sin points.
"S- Sorry sir, I- I will do whatever you want, please spare this realm, all these people are innocent." Gunter pleaded as he landed in front of Raldy.
They had talked about it all in advance and Shitless had apologized for all the insults he was going to throw at Gunter.
But he wanted to be the public enemy so he had to be very rude to Gunter.

"Hmph your apology is enough? I can kill you right now but you have helped me once before, so I will spare you and your land, but instead go and fly around this market ten times." Raldy gave him his punishment.
"Uh... Y- Yes sir." Gunter was surprised since this wasn't planned but he couldn't break the character, so he began to fly around the market.
Seeing him getting humiliated like this, everyone was angry, they began to curse at Raldy and almost throw out their slippers and shoes.
But were too afraid of the dragons in the sky.
"Do you see this? I am the strongest here, one word from me can decide the life and death of you all, you pig bastard I am going to steal your wife right here!!"

sentences.text: "If I make a choice then it can't be changed, just like the crack in a butt!" Raldy spoke firmly, glaring at the man who dared to refute him.
"B- Big brother, you mean the line in a stone?" Itch, who was lying pitifully some distance away, corrected him.
"I don't care who you are or what crack or line, she is my wife, choose someone else or I will kill you right here and now!" Onest shouted back, his fists clenched.
While Zira was feeling so afraid.
What is this guy doing?
Where is all this love coming from, didn't he hate her quite a bit because of the contract?
She looked at the dragons and was frightened, this stupid Onest might get them killed too.
She knew he is strong but not enough to kill those guys.
"L- Let's just leave, honey, you aren't their match." She muttered, pulling his arm.
"Hmph You think you can just leave now?
I have already set my eyes on you, you are going to be my wife no matter what!!" Raldy announced.
The crowd which was rapidly growing were all angry at Raldy, such a pig, how dare he covet someone else's woman and be so arrogant about it.
They were hating him more and more.
"That arrogant bastard, I want to beat his ass up!" someone in their rage accidentally spoke.
"Who was that?!!" Raldy shouted, and he quickly found the target.

"Someone stop this madman, he is going to kill everyone!"
"H- Help, someone kill this Raldy bastard!" people hid and shouted quickly, there were too many voices.
"Hmph Silence!!" Raldy shouted, and the sound was so loud that everyone shivered.
Nodding, he addressed Zira: "Beauty, I am far better than him, richer, handsome, stronger.
I can give you everything you might want and more, eternal life, unending money, and everything you have ever dreamed of.
What can he even give you?
Leave him and come to me, be my wife!"
Zira hid behind Onest, how can she just trust any man?
She was a cunning woman and unless she is sure of everything she wouldn't make her move.
"Hah I am going to kill you!" Onest screamed, pushed Zira back and rushed forward.
Everyone looked at Onest in pity, that poor guy was fighting to protect his wife, he really loves her so much.
And then there is this shameless Raldy who is trying to steal someone's wife in bright daylight, nightlight?
In any case, they were all angry at him.

'W- Woah, he is so strong?!
I knew I have chosen the best partner for myself!!' Zira was so happy to see the punch land.
She was thinking that Onest would be killed even before he gets any chance to do anything.

He then glared at Onest and shouted: "Dragons, attack this bastard, today I am going to kill him and feed him to all my pets!!"

Has he become the new emperor of the dragons?

They were sure his name was not Raldy, but right now they all were frightened.

But why would he fall for someone like her?
'Hmm maybe he is taking it as a challenge now that Onest stood up to him, now instead of his choice it is more of his pride?' Zira wondered and a strange feeling began to take shape in her heart.
"H- Hmph as if I would be afraid of a few p- pets GULP." Onest was slightly shaking as he spoke stutteringly.

From how greedy Zira is, she might really leave him.

And praised him that he was standing up for his wife.
"haha Is that not enough to make you feel afraid?

chapters.title: Chapter 764 Sin Farmer
paragraphs: 'W- What should I do?' Zira looked between Onest and Raldy.
To be honest, she had already wondered a couple of times by now whether she should just give in to Raldy's offer.
But she was still afraid of him and although Onest was not as capable, life with him would still be very great.
Though her greed made her want to leave Onest.
Raldy was too strong after all and too rich.
"I am not going to hand her over, even if you kill me, bastard!!" Onest screamed, making Zira wonder if he really loved her so much.

"Sigh some people just don't learn, then let me break your limbs and tear you apart, only then will you understand your place." Shitless was speaking everything that would make the public hate him the most.
All of them were looking at him as if he was their sworn enemy.
Finally it is time!!
"Stop right there!" just then a thunderous voice sounded that made even the dragons in the air tremble.
All the people were shocked and wondered who was going to make the guest entry now, this scene was becoming too bizarre.
The crowd there was already so big, over ten thousand people had gathered.
"How dare you humiliate my father like that!!" just then, Art Yate made his entry.
He appeared in the sky, body burning with a red flame, his presence so heavy that Raldy's knees bent slightly.
"I- Is that young master Art? He is back!!" one man exclaimed.
"Duh are you slow or something? Haven't you already heard that he had returned just recently?" another person added.
"Perfect, Young Lord Art's strength is even higher than Lord Gunter, even the Ford family was not able to do anything to him, with him here that pig won't be able to do anything."
Instantly a wave of happiness spread as they all began to cheer for Art Yate.
He was like a saviour, their beacon of light in complete darkness.
They felt so happy as if a kid who had finally gotten the most expensive toy and could now show off.
"Young Lord Art, beat that bastard up, kill him!! He is a bad person, he dared to humiliate Lord Gunter and wanted to steal someone's wife!"
"Kill that bastard, he is a pig!"
Everyone seemed to have gained a backbone and they all began to scream.
THUD
Vritra landed in front of Raldy, he raised his right hand as everyone quieted down, then his loud voice rang out.
"Don't worry, with me here now, he won't be able to do anything."
Vritra was looking at Shitless but all his focus was on the wave of sin points that were raining down.
It had been so long since he had seen so many pleasant messages flashing before him, it was just wonderful.
{Sin Point Gained: Watched +11,345}
{Sin Point Gained: Overjoyed +11,345}
{Sin Point Gained: Urged +11,232}
"Yes lord, kill him!!" Onest also shouted, he seemed the happiest.
Then he looked back at Zira and spoke with a smile: "Don't worry, now no one would be able to take you away from me."

"Even if we live a short life, a life of normalcy and poverty, but we will forever be together, even if we don't have much food to eat. We will be together, your son can earn for us, I knew you would choose me over that rich, powerful arrogant bastard!"
Onest seemed so happy, but hearing those words, Zira wasn't so sure anymore.
A frown appeared on her face as she stared at Raldy.
Wondering if she should really give in and marry him, but she still couldn't bring herself to agree.
"Hahaha You are going to defeat me? Kill me? With just you? Tsk tsk just a single one of my dragons will be enough to kill you!!"
'Hmm this is not enough, we need to blow this into something far bigger.' Vritra thought, but this was the Yates realm and there was a limit here.
So, they would have to shift it to the outside, where there would be hundreds of thousands of people.
But he also didn't want to lose all those who had gathered.
Then he decided to bring them all along to the outside, with his current strength it wouldn't be taxing to teleport them all.
But they needed to hate Shitless more, abhor him, hate him so much that they would be ready to sacrifice themselves to kill him.
And Vritra shared his thoughts with Raldy, the evil smirk on his face widened, what could he love more than spreading evil?
Isn't this exactly what he was born for?

"Hahahahaha you bastards, right in front of you all, no, in front of the world, I am going to kill this young master bastard then I will fuck all your wives, chop off your dicks and gift you green hats!!!"
Shitless screamed, bringing another wave of sin points for Vritra.
The more turbulent the emotions of the crowd were, the more sin points it brought for him.
Vritra had long noticed this, so for such an evil person he was going to be the most righteous.
'Huh? What are they even doing? W- Wasn't this whole play to save me from Zira?' Onest thought, he just stood there, wondering how this was going to solve things.
He looked at his soon to be ex wife's face and saw a very faint hint of doubt and greed.
'It's working!! Whatever they are doing, it is fucking working!!' Onest was overjoyed, as long as she left him on her own, then she would finally get her punishment.
And those bastard sons of hers who had made his life a literal hell, those demons.

"Yes young master Art, you are the only one who can kill this demon, this evil doer who wants to kill everything, he who cursed the gods and the ancestors of the people here. Kill him for us all, everyone, we stand with Young Lord Art!!" Onest screamed.
The crowd was a bit stunned at first, wondering when did this Raldy guy say all that? Wasn't he exaggerating this a bit too much?
But then they were still angry at Raldy, so they burst out with screams and cheers.
"See, everyone here wants you dead and for justice, for these lovely people who are my family, I am going to kill you!" Vritra shouted in a voice loud enough that everyone got to hear it.
{Sin Point Gained: Praised +11,634}
{Sin Point Gained: Adored +11,634}
{Sin Point Gained: Loved +11,634}
Every single person in the crowd praised Art, it was like he had become their messiah.
"Good good, I will let them all watch as I kill you and then chop the hands off them all, then throw them into prison!" Raldy shouted then he added:
"But this stage is too small for me, we will move outside and let the whole world witness what I do with you!!"
SNAP
Raldy raised his hand and snapped, as all the people who were present there disappeared.
They all were teleported outside and appeared inside the Quartz continent, the largest continent.
The people there were all shocked since they had all appeared up in the sky, even the people who could not fly were floating at this moment.

chapters.title: Chapter 765 The All powerful Lord
paragraphs: Thousands of people screamed at once, for a moment they were afraid that they would fall to their death.
But soon they began to notice that they were floating and then noticed that they were no longer in the Yate realm.
It was the Quartz continent?
They all stared at the surroundings in bafflement, this Raldy guy was so powerful that he had teleported them all.
They looked at Raldy, then at his brother who was lying some distance away and finally at Young Lord Art.
He who didn't seem afraid or surprised.
Yes, even if this Raldy bastard was strong, they had Lord Art, who would kill this Raldy in the most gruesome ways.
How dare he curse their ancestors and say such things about their wives.
The dragons were flying high above them, looming dangerously.
Soon the number of people watching this scene had crossed 20,000 and kept increasing rapidly.
The rumours about the powerful brothers coming to the Yate realm had spread outside too but most could not enter the Yate realm.
Now, there were some people hidden in the crowd who were giving out the context of what was happening.
Of course these people were arranged by Rich in advance.
"Now it is time for you all to die-" seeing the hateful gaze of so many people, Raldy laughed like a madman but paused:
"But don't worry my dear, I won't kill you, you are going to be my woman. Tell me if you want me to spare someone." Raldy asked, pausing his hand which was about to rise.
"Uh..." Zira trembled as he spoke to her, she looked at Onest and didn't know what to do.
If she asked him to spare her sons, wouldn't it mean she had agreed to marry Raldy and leave Onest?
But if she said nothing, what if four of her sons got killed?
She was so unsure, but right then Itch rose to his feet, his body shaking.
"B- Brother, these are all innocent people, no matter what I w- will protect them with my life, human life isn't cheap." Itch spoke, while trembling.
His weak yet determined voice touched the hearts of everyone in the crowd, that cute kind boy was standing up for them.
"How can the two brothers be so different? This boy is such a gem, we have to protect him at any cost!!" someone shouted.
"Yes, we can't let him be harmed, he is too pure for this world. I bet that Raldy's mother must have been a bitch too."
Instantly they all were in favour of Itch, who stood against his own brother for these people.

"Tsk tsk stupid to the very end, how did I end up with a brother like you? That's why I killed that pig of a father for breeding with that low class woman and giving birth to a bastard like you, now I am going to kill you."
As soon as Raldy spoke, the crowd burst out in rage.
But before any of them even had a chance to say anything, Raldy's fist burst out with flames, lava flowing down.
BOOOM
Then with a thunderous sound, he struck his younger brother's chest, the hand piercing through his chest and coming out from the back.
Itch coughed out blood, tears rolling down his cheeks, he looked to be in so much pain.
"S- Sorry everyone, COUGH e- even with my Aahhhhhh death, I HUFF HUFF couldn't p- protect you all, f- forgive m..." he couldn't complete his sentence as his body went limp.
The whole place was silent, all eyes fixed on the broken figure who even in his last moment was worried about them.
He was so weak yet for them he sacrificed himself, a flame burst out in the hearts of all the people watching.
They roared out in rage and remorse.
Raldy didn't stop there, he laughed maniacally and tore his brother's head, throwing it down and stepping on it.
Then he tossed the body upwards, as a dragon caught it and swallowed the body.

"This is what happens when you all bastards go against me, this is just the beginning. You know what, I like orphans, and soon I will start liking your kids. Hmm but I am going to kill all your women and keep them as my pets hahahaha"
His laugh reverberated, making them all so angry and upset, poor boy Itch even after his death received such humiliation.
Then Raldy kicked his brother's head and tossed it up, throwing it away into the oblivion.
This sort of disrespect filled them with such intense emotions that Vritra's status panel refreshed rapidly.
Messages kept flashing before his eyes.
This hate was directed towards Raldy but these people had put all their hopes on him.
'Haa So wonderful, I wonder which skill I should upgrade...' Vritra wondered.
Of course this was all set up by the mythic halo, all of this was an illusion.
Rich had already been teleported away by him.

"I am sorry, I couldn't save that boy, but believe in me!! I am going to kill this Raldy, deliver justice and let Itch's soul rest in peace! He will receive a hundred times the humiliation that Itch experienced!!"
"Hahaha with just you? Just a dragon will be enough to kill you." Raldy laughed as more and more people appeared and sin points kept increasing.
"Young Lord Art, we are ready to die with you, this demon bastard needs to be killed!" all the people roared in rage, giving more and more sin points.
"Dragons, attack this young master and tear him apart!" Raldy finally gave the order and the people despite their rage were frightened.
All of them would be killed by just a single breath from one dragon, what could they even do?
They were shaking but just then the symbol of their trust, Art Yates flew up.
His body again covered by red flames, the surroundings bursting with explosive sound.
This scene made the heartbeat of everyone quicken, they were suddenly excited.
Vritra flew towards the first target, making everything as dramatic as possible, people even several kilometres away were amazed.
A large cloud of flames rose as Vritra's punch collided with the huge dragon, in front of which he seemed so little.
BOOOOOOOOM!!
An earth shattering explosion sounded and in front of everyone a scene unfolded that none had expected.
With that single punch, all the other dragons were pushed back while the brown dragon that was hit was blown to pieces.
Blood splattered onto them like rain, as pieces of bones and flesh fell into the surrounding area.
The colossal dragon was torn apart with just a punch?
Just one punch?
There was complete silence for a few moments then people screamed in madness, roaring and feeling triumphant already.
But Vritra didn't stop there, his body twisted in the air as his leg formed a big curve and struck the head of another dragon.
BOOOOOOOOOM!!
An explosion no smaller than before sounded and shockwaves flew in all directions, the head of the dragon just disappeared completely.
Torn to such small pieces, while the remaining body of the dragon flew away.
This was their saviour, this person was going to kill that evil Raldy, they had complete faith in him now!!
{Sin Point Gained: Encouraged +42,345}
{Sin Point Gained: Revered +42,347}
{Sin Point Gained: Blown away +42,851}

That's why I killed that pig of a father for breeding with that low class woman and giving birth to a bastard like you, now I am going to kill you."
As soon as Raldy spoke, the crowd burst out in rage.
But before any of them even had a chance to say anything, Raldy's fist burst out with flames, lava flowing down.
BOOOM
Then with a thunderous sound, he struck his younger brother's chest, the hand piercing through his chest and coming out from the back.
Itch coughed out blood, tears rolling down his cheeks, he looked to be in so much pain.
"S- Sorry everyone, COUGH e- even with my Aahhhhhh death, I HUFF HUFF couldn't p- protect you all, f- forgive m..." he couldn't complete his sentence as his body went limp.
The whole place was silent, all eyes fixed on the broken figure who even in his last moment was worried about them.
He was so weak yet for them he sacrificed himself, a flame burst out in the hearts of all the people watching.
They roared out in rage and remorse.
Raldy didn't stop there, he laughed maniacally and tore his brother's head, throwing it down and stepping on it.
Then he tossed the body upwards, as a dragon caught it and swallowed the body.
"This is what happens when you all bastards go against me, this is just the beginning.
You know what, I like orphans, and soon I will start liking your kids.
Hmm but I am going to kill all your women and keep them as my pets hahahaha"
His laugh reverberated, making them all so angry and upset, poor boy Itch even after his death received such humiliation.
Then Raldy kicked his brother's head and tossed it up, throwing it away into the oblivion.
This sort of disrespect filled them with such intense emotions that Vritra's status panel refreshed rapidly.
Messages kept flashing before his eyes.
This hate was directed towards Raldy but these people had put all their hopes on him.
'Haa So wonderful, I wonder which skill I should upgrade...' Vritra wondered.
Of course this was all set up by the mythic halo, all of this was an illusion.
Rich had already been teleported away by him.
"I am sorry, I couldn't save that boy, but believe in me!!
I am going to kill this Raldy, deliver justice and let Itch's soul rest in peace!
He will receive a hundred times the humiliation that Itch experienced!!"
"Hahaha with just you?
Just a dragon will be enough to kill you." Raldy laughed as more and more people appeared and sin points kept increasing.
"Young Lord Art, we are ready to die with you, this demon bastard needs to be killed!" all the people roared in rage, giving more and more sin points.
"Dragons, attack this young master and tear him apart!" Raldy finally gave the order and the people despite their rage were frightened.
All of them would be killed by just a single breath from one dragon, what could they even do?
They were shaking but just then the symbol of their trust, Art Yates flew up.
His body again covered by red flames, the surroundings bursting with explosive sound.
This scene made the heartbeat of everyone quicken, they were suddenly excited.
Vritra flew towards the first target, making everything as dramatic as possible, people even several kilometres away were amazed.
A large cloud of flames rose as Vritra's punch collided with the huge dragon, in front of which he seemed so little.
BOOOOOOOOM!!
An earth shattering explosion sounded and in front of everyone a scene unfolded that none had expected.
With that single punch, all the other dragons were pushed back while the brown dragon that was hit was blown to pieces.
Blood splattered onto them like rain, as pieces of bones and flesh fell into the surrounding area.
The colossal dragon was torn apart with just a punch?
Just one punch?
There was complete silence for a few moments then people screamed in madness, roaring and feeling triumphant already.
But Vritra didn't stop there, his body twisted in the air as his leg formed a big curve and struck the head of another dragon.
BOOOOOOOOOM!!
An explosion no smaller than before sounded and shockwaves flew in all directions, the head of the dragon just disappeared completely.
Torn to such small pieces, while the remaining body of the dragon flew away.
This was their saviour, this person was going to kill that evil Raldy, they had complete faith in him now!!
{Sin Point Gained: Encouraged +42,345}
{Sin Point Gained: Revered +42,347}
{Sin Point Gained: Blown away +42,851}

chapters.title: Chapter 766 The Real Divine
paragraphs: All the people watched in awe and shock as Art Yate killed one dragon after another, one punch was all it took for him to kill them.
Explosive sounds continued to ring out in the sky, blood constantly raining down as even Raldy seemed shocked.
"Y- You... how are you so strong?" he muttered.
Zira's gaze moved towards Vritra and she recognized him finally, wasn't he the person who had come to meet Onest?
She wasn't from the Yate Realm originally so she didn't recognize the young lord, but now her eyes were wide open.
Her husband was friends with someone so strong? Maybe it was better to just stay with him?
Onest saw the look change in Zira's eyes and he panicked, he could tell Vritra was just gathering points as usual.
'Wasn't this all just to save me? Ughh at this rate, she won't leave me ever.' He thought, then urged:
"S- See that, you bastard Raldy, that is our lord, do you think you can defeat him?"
"Hmph, who do you think I am, that is nothing for me, I can kill him even half asleep!" Raldy spoke, fully confident.
"Hah jokes on you, he is fully awake, you are going to die bastard!" someone from the crowd shouted, before hiding back.
All of them looked at the sky and watched as Vritra continued to slaughter one dragon after another.
It was such a gruesome yet great sight, all of them could feel their hearts beating like war drums.
They were so excited.
'Not bad, but we need more people.' Vritra thought, flying towards another target.
In just a short time he had killed all eighty of the dragons, yet they could do nothing to him.
During the entirety of the fight he hadn't even received a single scratch, this was a one-sided victory.
Another wave of passive points poured in by the end of the fight, the crowd already way past 50,000.
Then Vritra appeared in front of Raldy, his body was covered in the blood of the dragons, his aura was so strong that everyone admired him.
"Now all your dragons are gone, do you have any other tricks? If not, I am going to give you the most painful death." Vritra muttered, yet his voice was loud enough to reach everyone.
And they all began to cheer him up.
{Sin Point Gained: Cheered +59,424}
{Sin Point Gained: Admired +59,422}

"With just that much strength? Did you think I would be scared or something? Hahaha. That is all you are capable of and you want to kill me?" Raldy laughed loudly as if he had heard the funniest joke.
"We will know that pretty soon, let's see if you have anything other than your arrogance." Vritra asked, as he took a fighting pose, appearing serious.
The crowd shifted back even further, seeing the seriousness they knew this fight was going to be very big.
There was a moment of silence and then both took a step forward, their fists flashed forward, as a strong storm engulfed everything.
BOOOOM
A sonic boom sounded as visible shockwaves travelled in all directions.
Their fists collided with such strong force, Vritra and Shitless weren't even using 1% of their strength.
And Vritra still didn't need to use the mythic halo to create illusion for special effects, all the people were shocked.
Raldy was really so strong? They thought Art would be able to defeat him quickly.
After the first punch, the two of them were pushed back, almost equally.
But Vritra knew, he would have to let Shitless win first after all they still needed to help Onest.
Zira again seemed confused, Onest felt so angry that he wanted to crack her skull open.
This dumb woman, why can't she just make up her mind, she keeps swinging to both sides.
'Raldy, w- what if he actually wins? I- I will just beg him to spare my sons in exchange for marrying me.'
But seeing how Raldy was so unscrupulous, Zira knew she can't trap him like she did with Onest so she would have to listen to him forever.
Yet it was fine, he can give her far more than Onest or anyone else.
While her decision was becoming firmer, she watched the fight, a part of her hoping that Raldy actually wins.
BOOOM
Vritra kicked Raldy's head but the other guy quickly blocked it with his arm and punched towards Vritra's chest.
Which he dodged by using the force from the kick, so far the two seemed almost equal.
But the battle was only getting more and more dangerous, only in the eyes of thousands of observers.
But for Vritra and Shitless they were completely relaxed.
"Vritra, it is finally time." Suddenly, Divine's voice sounded in his mind.
'Hmm? What time?' Vritra was a little surprised but he didn't pause fighting, while waiting for his reply.

"Time for this avatar of mine to finally disappear, I had fulfilled the cause for which I was created. I protected my sisters and am now leaving them in your care." Divine spoke in a strangely solemn tone.
'You are dying?' Vritra asked, no matter how much he wanted to beat him up, but it was Divine who had helped him so much.
Evelyn was also there just behind the scenes but Divine had helped him so much.

"No, that's not it. I will just be returning to my main body since my energy has run out, and the main body is still kind of stuck somewhere, which is why the real me can't be here himself." Divine replied.
But then he added: "Don't worry though, I had in advance left another avatar near you, which won't be leaving your side anytime soon."
Now that Divine had mentioned it, Vritra asked curiously:
'Is it Shitless? ...Although he is pretty useless most of the time, but he seems to be the biggest candidate.'
Vritra looked at Shitless who was seriously fighting against him, was this guy truly the Divine?
Shitless noticed the change in Vritra's gaze, wondering if there is some change in the plan?
"Why don't you try asking him first?" Divine spoke instead of giving the answer right away, and Vritra was pretty used to it.
Sigh...
"Shitless, are you the Divine?" Vritra asked, his voice only reaching the monk and none other.
And this question shocked Shitless greatly, he couldn't understand why Vritra was even asking such a question.

'Am I the Divine? Huh wait, i- is that why I am so special? I knew from the b- birth I wasn't a normal being, but I am the Divine pitiful one had told us about? I was the Divine all along?!!' Shitless thought in shock.
Then a confident smile appeared on his face and he asked: "What gave it away?"
Vritra: "..."
How can this be? This monk Shitless is the Divine? The wannabe evil demon?
No wonder he never died, no matter what sort of circumstance he is in, Shitless always survives.
Vritra almost lost faith in humanity and this world, especially the Divine, how can the Divine be... be this?
Then the Divine's pet that Bullo, was it also someone powerful?
"Hahahaha." Divine's laughter rang out suddenly in Vritra's mind.
"You are indeed right on one thing, the real me sent one avatar to be close with you along with his pet." The Divine finally confirmed it.
So Shitless really is the second avatar of the Divine, how unexpected but before Vritra could be more disappointed, Divine added:
"But you got the roles all reversed."
'What? Reversed? You mean...' Vritra again looked at Shitless and then in the far corner located Bullo.
"Yes, you are right. Bullo all along has been an avatar of mine who came along with a pet called Shitless.
You have seen how Shitless never dies in any situation but Bullo never did either, and how can Bullo let its pet die, that is why Shitless always survives." Divine finally explained properly.
Vritra was so baffled that he didn't dodge the punch from Shitless, letting it hit his shoulder.
It didn't contain any real power but to just show, he flew back and smashed into the ground, the crowd all getting worried.
Instead of getting up immediately, Vritra remained seated in the hole for a few moments and let the information sink in.
Bullo is Divine's avatar? So when it is not around them, it might be following in its insect form.
But most of the time Bullo's strength is locked as it is hidden and can't display it on the Zoratian planet.
So Shitless is not the Divine, hoo what a relief, Vritra almost lost faith in most things just now.
'But why did he agree to it so confidently then?' he wondered and looked up, only to notice that Shitless was acting even more arrogant now.
That monk has really started to think of himself as the Divine.
Heh...
Vritra shook his head, as he flew back up and punched him, hard enough to make him smash into the ground.
Then he landed into the big crater and spoke:
"You are not the Divine, get over it, I will explain things later." Vritra spoke, then he gripped Raldy's collar and threw him back into the sky.
"Oh..." Shitless was now feeling disappointed, he was already imagining turning gods into his pets.
The people watching the battle were experiencing all sorts of emotions, it wasn't yet certain who was going to win.
But Sin Points, they surely weren't going to stop pouring.
"Anyway, before I disappear completely, there are a couple of things I have to do." Divine said, he also needed to give him some information.
Vritra nodded, and remained silent to hear Divine's last words while a figure suddenly flashed not too far away.
