chapters.title: Chapter 767 The Biggest Truth
paragraphs: Drino, after making plans with all the others, had left to arrive at the Zoratian planet and turn Vritra's life into a living hell.
After doing everything he could, he was able to get a total of eight Demi Gods aside from himself.

One of which was the level 4 Demi God Zihong, who would only appear when he wished so if counting him out, there was still a total of 8 level 3 Demi Gods, including the tree-like Demi God Mole who quite liked Drino.
After making their plans they were going to set out to the Zoratian planet but Drino was too excited.
So he used a short-period teleportation treasure which would let him travel a vast amount of distance and arrive at the Zoratian planet.
Though only for a few minutes, which Drino felt would be enough to defeat Vritra or at least test his strength.
And so, he used the treasure and teleported directly to the Zoratian planet, finding Vritra wasn't going to be difficult.
Since he had brought yet another treasure just for that, and using it he quickly located Vritra's current location.
But was shocked to find him surrounded by so many people, though for Drino all these humans were nothing more than ants.
Without even trying he could end up killing them.

'There he is, that puny bug, this time I am not going to go easy on you, but you won't get an easy death. You will be harassed to no end and die in the most painful ways known to your kind.' Drino thought.
His lizard-like face twisted and a dreadful smile appeared on his face.
As a Demi God from another place, he cannot stay here for too long.
Still, it was fine, he would quickly defeat Vritra and start the long period of torture, let him know about his return.
Give him mental pressure before the others arrive, just thinking of all this made him so excited.
He had never felt this great, not even when he became a Demi God or when he killed all his brothers.
After staring at his nemesis for a few moments, he decided to attack him and beat him half to death right away.
He absolutely cannot make the same mistake.
Vritra punched Shitless away as he waited for Divine's words.
"Even after this avatar of mine is gone, you will still be able to use all the skills and use the Sin Wheel." Divine began, the original Divine created three avatars.
All three of them had their own responsibilities and roles.
He had sent two of the avatars to help his sisters, fully aware that one of the avatars would run out of energy at one point.
He had planned everything in advance.
As for the third avatar, it had disappeared before it could've completed its tasks, which was to help the Divine escape.
But that was not important right now, once Vritra's strength had risen enough, he could help Divine look for the 3rd avatar or even help him escape.
For now, Divine needed to give as much support as he could.
"Next, I have prepared a place for your family among the Higher Beings, you will be able to replace one of the families there." Divine then added and also told that he had made that family disappear.
While battling against Raldy and farming Sin Points, Vritra continued to listen to Divine seriously.

"But you can't go there before you have achieved Godhood, and your lover cannot wait for you to participate in all the games, so my other avatar will help you break into others' games and steal their rewards and level up as Demi Gods."
Vritra hummed, he was also a bit worried about it as playing and waiting for each game would take too long.
Not to mention, the gods might try something behind the scenes.
Breaking into others' games and stealing their rewards, that would be for the best and help them level up faster.
He just hoped that other levels wouldn't take so long each.
"I have even stolen the God Pearls, it is something that when one reaches Godhood obtains or rather takes from the other gods.
This is exactly what Demi God level 10 fights with the gods for, they take the God Pearl and put the gods into eternal sleep, turning them into stars. You all would need it too to progress further.
Once you reach level 10 of the Demi Gods, use the pearls which you would obtain through the Sin Wheel later on."
'Won't the gods be affected if you have stolen it and won't they come to look for it?' Vritra asked, blocking another strike and then kicking Shitless away.
"Not in a short time, they will be fine for a while, very panicked but they will try to hide this fact.
And yes they will try to look for it, which is exactly why I am not handing it to you right away, and you will only get it once you are level 10 Demi Gods." Divine answered calmly.
Vritra just nodded, even while disappearing he had made two such big arrangements for them.
A place to blend in and the path to Godhood.
But then he thought about the ten gods in the world court, although he couldn't see them clearly but they clearly seemed nervous.
So it wasn't because they were worried about the case itself, but they were worried because of the God Pearls, because of the Divine.
The video showed that they got beaten and not the parts where the pearls were stolen.
If it was found, they would have received even bigger punishments.
"Anyway, once you have reached Demi God level 5 and enter the next game, you have to look for the crying monk, he will help you with your physiques."
This line from Divine made various questions pop into Vritra's mind, he asked but Divine didn't answer further.
Physiques? What about it? The physiques of them all?
Vritra as a Titan knew he possessed some strange physiques and could absorb others' physiques and more, but aside from that he knew little about himself.
So for now, he decided to suppress his curiosity and find this crying monk when the time came.
But wasn't one monk already enough in their group? What tragedies or trouble would the second monk bring?
This too wasn't the time to worry about that, so Vritra now had three things to do.
Find the crying monk after he is level 5 Demi God and is in the next game, get the God Pearl and ascend to Godhood once he is level 10 Demi God.
And finally, go to the world of Higher Beings after becoming a god.
'Anything else?' Vritra asked, as he gazed at the Sin Points which were increasing so quickly.
{Sin Point Gained: Cheered On +99,535}
{Sin Point Gained: Revered +99,535}
{Sin Point Gained: Awestruck +100,042}
{Sin Point Gained: Overjoyed +100,078}
The number of people watching had already gone over one hundred thousand, and Rich's people were doing a great job at pulling more and more.
He needed to help Onest but he could not let the drama end just yet.
He had to upgrade at least one of his skills which needed 100 million Sin Points.
Divine was silent for a few moments, then he finally spoke:
"You have heard about the six truths right?"
'Yes I have, I... even know about a few like the truth of the Divine, the truth of the betrayal, the truth of gods... that's all.' Vritra said, unless one obtains information about these truths.
Even remembering the name is extremely difficult, and if one does obtain the information about these truths then the gods and other Higher Beings will find out about them.
It was only thanks to Divine and maybe Evelyn that Vritra despite finding out about these truths was still alive.
As for these truths, he got to know the true names of the gods, information about the Divine.
And that the 1st mythic halo, the Halo of Creation which had been with Divine for quite some time, letting him create such terrifying skills and objects.
The Divine's best friend, had betrayed him in the end.
Vritra never really asked for the reason behind it, he was also very curious but knew some things were better left unknown.
Maybe if he found out about this, he would be pulled into yet another conflict.
So it was better to stay away from the 1st mythic halo for now.
He already possessed two of the mythic halos, the Nihil Anima and Misty Essence, both being extremely terrifying.
Fiona also possessed one, the Undying Mythic Halo.

"Good that you remember, now it is time for you to find out about the biggest truth among the six truths. One that will change everything for you, maybe even change you, maybe break you or worse." Divine spoke in a grim tone.
'Uh... How about you don't tell me then?' Vritra asked, it's not like these truths were of any benefit other than bringing trouble, so why would he want to go through all that torture?

"No, you have to know it, only I can tell you about it and you would need it to survive and protect others later on. If I disappear without telling anything, then your situation would be far more fucked up." Divine said in a very serious tone.
'Sigh fine, not like I even have a choice-' Vritra was just replying when he suddenly sensed high killing intent from behind, he twisted his body in the air and dodged an attack.
Then looked back to find someone unexpected.

sentences.text: Drino, after making plans with all the others, had left to arrive at the Zoratian planet and turn Vritra's life into a living hell.
After doing everything he could, he was able to get a total of eight Demi Gods aside from himself.

One of which was the level 4 Demi God Zihong, who would only appear when he wished so if counting him out, there was still a total of 8 level 3 Demi Gods, including the tree-like Demi God Mole who quite liked Drino.
After making their plans they were going to set out to the Zoratian planet but Drino was too excited.
So he used a short-period teleportation treasure which would let him travel a vast amount of distance and arrive at the Zoratian planet.
Though only for a few minutes, which Drino felt would be enough to defeat Vritra or at least test his strength.
And so, he used the treasure and teleported directly to the Zoratian planet, finding Vritra wasn't going to be difficult.
Since he had brought yet another treasure just for that, and using it he quickly located Vritra's current location.
But was shocked to find him surrounded by so many people, though for Drino all these humans were nothing more than ants.
Without even trying he could end up killing them.
'There he is, that puny bug, this time I am not going to go easy on you, but you won't get an easy death.
You will be harassed to no end and die in the most painful ways known to your kind.' Drino thought.
His lizard-like face twisted and a dreadful smile appeared on his face.
As a Demi God from another place, he cannot stay here for too long.
Still, it was fine, he would quickly defeat Vritra and start the long period of torture, let him know about his return.
Give him mental pressure before the others arrive, just thinking of all this made him so excited.
He had never felt this great, not even when he became a Demi God or when he killed all his brothers.
After staring at his nemesis for a few moments, he decided to attack him and beat him half to death right away.
He absolutely cannot make the same mistake.
Vritra punched Shitless away as he waited for Divine's words.
"Even after this avatar of mine is gone, you will still be able to use all the skills and use the Sin Wheel." Divine began, the original Divine created three avatars.
All three of them had their own responsibilities and roles.
He had sent two of the avatars to help his sisters, fully aware that one of the avatars would run out of energy at one point.
He had planned everything in advance.
As for the third avatar, it had disappeared before it could've completed its tasks, which was to help the Divine escape.
But that was not important right now, once Vritra's strength had risen enough, he could help Divine look for the 3rd avatar or even help him escape.
For now, Divine needed to give as much support as he could.
"Next, I have prepared a place for your family among the Higher Beings, you will be able to replace one of the families there." Divine then added and also told that he had made that family disappear.
While battling against Raldy and farming Sin Points, Vritra continued to listen to Divine seriously.

"But you can't go there before you have achieved Godhood, and your lover cannot wait for you to participate in all the games, so my other avatar will help you break into others' games and steal their rewards and level up as Demi Gods."
Vritra hummed, he was also a bit worried about it as playing and waiting for each game would take too long.
Not to mention, the gods might try something behind the scenes.
Breaking into others' games and stealing their rewards, that would be for the best and help them level up faster.
He just hoped that other levels wouldn't take so long each.
"I have even stolen the God Pearls, it is something that when one reaches Godhood obtains or rather takes from the other gods.
This is exactly what Demi God level 10 fights with the gods for, they take the God Pearl and put the gods into eternal sleep, turning them into stars.
You all would need it too to progress further.
Once you reach level 10 of the Demi Gods, use the pearls which you would obtain through the Sin Wheel later on."
'Won't the gods be affected if you have stolen it and won't they come to look for it?' Vritra asked, blocking another strike and then kicking Shitless away.
"Not in a short time, they will be fine for a while, very panicked but they will try to hide this fact.
And yes they will try to look for it, which is exactly why I am not handing it to you right away, and you will only get it once you are level 10 Demi Gods." Divine answered calmly.
Vritra just nodded, even while disappearing he had made two such big arrangements for them.
A place to blend in and the path to Godhood.
But then he thought about the ten gods in the world court, although he couldn't see them clearly but they clearly seemed nervous.
So it wasn't because they were worried about the case itself, but they were worried because of the God Pearls, because of the Divine.
The video showed that they got beaten and not the parts where the pearls were stolen.
If it was found, they would have received even bigger punishments.
"Anyway, once you have reached Demi God level 5 and enter the next game, you have to look for the crying monk, he will help you with your physiques."
This line from Divine made various questions pop into Vritra's mind, he asked but Divine didn't answer further.
Physiques?
What about it?
The physiques of them all?
Vritra as a Titan knew he possessed some strange physiques and could absorb others' physiques and more, but aside from that he knew little about himself.
So for now, he decided to suppress his curiosity and find this crying monk when the time came.
But wasn't one monk already enough in their group?
What tragedies or trouble would the second monk bring?
This too wasn't the time to worry about that, so Vritra now had three things to do.
Find the crying monk after he is level 5 Demi God and is in the next game, get the God Pearl and ascend to Godhood once he is level 10 Demi God.
And finally, go to the world of Higher Beings after becoming a god.
'Anything else?' Vritra asked, as he gazed at the Sin Points which were increasing so quickly.
{Sin Point Gained: Cheered On +99,535}
{Sin Point Gained: Revered +99,535}
{Sin Point Gained: Awestruck +100,042}
{Sin Point Gained: Overjoyed +100,078}
The number of people watching had already gone over one hundred thousand, and Rich's people were doing a great job at pulling more and more.
He needed to help Onest but he could not let the drama end just yet.
He had to upgrade at least one of his skills which needed 100 million Sin Points.
Divine was silent for a few moments, then he finally spoke:
"You have heard about the six truths right?"
'Yes I have, I... even know about a few like the truth of the Divine, the truth of the betrayal, the truth of gods... that's all.' Vritra said, unless one obtains information about these truths.
Even remembering the name is extremely difficult, and if one does obtain the information about these truths then the gods and other Higher Beings will find out about them.
It was only thanks to Divine and maybe Evelyn that Vritra despite finding out about these truths was still alive.
As for these truths, he got to know the true names of the gods, information about the Divine.
And that the 1st mythic halo, the Halo of Creation which had been with Divine for quite some time, letting him create such terrifying skills and objects.
The Divine's best friend, had betrayed him in the end.
Vritra never really asked for the reason behind it, he was also very curious but knew some things were better left unknown.
Maybe if he found out about this, he would be pulled into yet another conflict.
So it was better to stay away from the 1st mythic halo for now.
He already possessed two of the mythic halos, the Nihil Anima and Misty Essence, both being extremely terrifying.
Fiona also possessed one, the Undying Mythic Halo.
"Good that you remember, now it is time for you to find out about the biggest truth among the six truths.
One that will change everything for you, maybe even change you, maybe break you or worse." Divine spoke in a grim tone.
How about you don't tell me then?' Vritra asked, it's not like these truths were of any benefit other than bringing trouble, so why would he want to go through all that torture?
"No, you have to know it, only I can tell you about it and you would need it to survive and protect others later on.
If I disappear without telling anything, then your situation would be far more fucked up." Divine said in a very serious tone.
'Sigh fine, not like I even have a choice-' Vritra was just replying when he suddenly sensed high killing intent from behind, he twisted his body in the air and dodged an attack.
Then looked back to find someone unexpected.

chapters.title: Chapter 768 A Very Good Guy
paragraphs: Vritra sensed a strong killing intent and then felt something rushing towards him.
He quickly dodged as something flew past him and into the sky, it was just a stone.
"Drino?" he looked back and saw a familiar but slightly different figure.
Wasn't he dead, he was surely the level 3 Demi God that wanted to kidnap Yasmine.
Vritra had barely survived against this guy back then, none of his attacks worked against Drino.
It was totally a one-sided battle, if not for external help, like from the Divine, Vritra might have really lost.
Or wait, could it be some twin brother of that lizard guy, or maybe everyone has similar faces in their race.
Vritra had many questions in his mind, how did this guy even come here out of nowhere?
'But he clearly holds hostility towards me and seems to be at the 3rd Demi God level, I should first check if it's really Drino or not.' Vritra thought.
He was waiting to hear about one of the truths from the Divine, but this guy had to pop out now.
Shitless didn't seem to have noticed anything as he jumped out of the crater and attacked Vritra again.
"Hahaha With that weak strength of yours I am going to tear you piece by piece right in front of these people-"
But before he could finish speaking, Vritra held his head, and threw him back into the same crater.
He turned to face Drino as the public exclaimed, some screaming in fright upon seeing the big lizard-faced creature.
Who this sudden entry was now?
"I- It must be someone from that bastard Raldy's side!! That pig now called out creatures from outside of our planet." Someone exclaimed and all others understood.
"Yes it must be him, Lord Art, kill this lizard bastard and then kill that Raldy, you have to avenge the poor Itch!"
All the people began to shout, they were already enraged so they began to curse seven generations of Drino.
Even if these were all ants, hearing them ridicule him fearlessly made Drino irritated and angry.
Finally, Vritra addressed him, trying to get some answers.
"Did someone leave your coffin's lid open- oh wait, there wasn't even a body left to be buried.
Wait, could you be the inbred brother Drino was so proud of? Hmm but I sure respect you, to have the courage to come back here.
Your courage inspires me. Most people would feel shame after losing like that."
Vritra praised, but Drino's lips twitched, failing to understand if it was praise or insult.
"You damned ant, it is me, Drino!! You might have won by playing tricks last time, but this time I am going to make you feel hell!" Drino shouted, he cooled off his head and lost all anger.
Right, he can't repeat the same mistake, this time he won't let this brat play him by the ear.
He would beat Vritra up and then be teleported back, there were still two minutes left before he would be teleported.
Then he would come here with full force to make Vritra suffer each and every day.
"I see, Drino." Vritra nodded, so it was the foolish lizard man.
"But weren't you dead? How come you came back here- oh wait!" Vritra suddenly exclaimed, he had gotten it all wrong.
How could he be so stupid? Drino was never his enemy, this was such a sweet and good guy.
There might not be a second guy as good as Drino, and to think Vritra doubted him, thought of him as an enemy.
The last time Drino came, he left his body and let Knight absorb it, giving the Soul Wraith power almost equivalent to level 3 Demi God.
And this guy was back here again, to deliver this brand new body and soul which was not any weaker than before.
In fact Drino seemed even stronger than the last time, he had come with full preparation.
And here he was, just to deliver this new body and soul to his other Soul Wraith, the Hellmancer.
How could this be considered a bad guy?
Drino for some reason felt a chill run through his body, as he sensed Vritra's greedy look, like Vritra had already stolen his very soul away.
"Thanks for coming back however you did it, but can you keep repeating this process?" Vritra asked, he could steal Drino's physique and nurture his Soul Wraiths with whatever remained of him.
Aside from the Dark Knight and Hellmancer, there were many others.
"Wha- No, do you think treasures to bring back a Demi God's body grow on trees?" Drino replied in irritation.
"Ah what a pity, I guess I will have to look for others later on." Vritra spoke in disappointment, but what he didn't know was that his very good friend Drino was bringing along many other Demi Gods.
'What is this guy even talking about?' Drino frowned unable to understand what Vritra was trying to do.
Drino observed this guy who looked exactly the same as before, he couldn't sense any energy fluctuations.
'Is he still at the 1st level? Has he grown or gotten weaker?' he narrowed his eyes but couldn't tell.
Vritra possessed the Lost skill which could even hide everything about him naturally.
Drino ignored the people's comments and just focused on Vritra, there was just a little over a minute left now.
Which was more than enough, still Drino felt it was such a pity, he wished this time could stretch so he could properly torture Vritra before getting teleported away.

'But why would he ask such strange questions? Wait, don't tell me he is trying to stall for time hahaha this puny bug, even two seconds would be enough for me to crush him.' Drino thought with confidence.
"Enough of this chit chat, it is time for you to get your punishment." Drino didn't want to waste any more time and just wanted to utilize this one minute properly.
Vritra nodded, a shadow flew from under his feet, as he ordered the Dark Knight to make sure this Drino guy doesn't escape.
Also Knight would protect the growing crowd, he couldn't let this guy hurt the Sin Point generators, right?
The two stared at one another for a moment, Drino had a big grin on his face, he looked around and saw Vritra's family.
It was good that they were here too, he would beat Vritra right in front of them.
As everyone in the crowd waited in anticipation, since this lizard guy looked even more powerful than the Raldy-
Wait where is Raldy? Was he still lying in the crater?
For now everyone forgot about him and waited with baited breath.
Drino tapped at the air, his body suddenly shooting forward at his fastest speed, he didn't hold back one bit.
BOOOM BOOOM
Explosive sounds rang out just from him moving forward, time seemed to have frozen as Drino laughed like a madman, his claw aiming for Vritra's head.
Of course, this strike wasn't meant to kill him, making Vritra's head explode won't kill him.
Vritra clenched his fist, as Drino flashed in front of him.
Without dodging, without using any energy or skills.
He swung his right arm, lightning cracked and the world seemed to have lost its light.
BOOOOOOOOM!! ❖❖❖

chapters.title: Chapter 769 A minute that just won't end!!
paragraphs: Drino laughed manically, how dare this ant try to engage in a direct fight.
'It seems he has completely forgotten about my strength.' Shaking his head, Drino hoped Vritra doesn't die from this strike.
His claws inched closer to Vritra's head, but a moment later he noticed something strange.
Why did it seem this puny ant's speed was even faster than his own?
As Vritra swung his fist, the space around it buzzed and electricity crackled.
Everything became quiet and darkness enveloped it all.
His punch moved forward with such unstoppable and terrifying force, that just the aftershock would have been enough to eradicate all the surrounding humans.
All over one hundred thousand of them.
CRACK
Drino's claws were the first to come in contact with the fist, but unlike the scene playing in his mind, the reality proved to be exactly opposite.
Vritra's punch continued to move forward without even a slight change and in front of such terrifying force, Drino's claws were the first to burst.
All his fingers twisted and exploded, then his palm and the rest of the hand.
The speed of the punch didn't decrease one bit as Drino's entire right arm exploded violently, blood splattering in all directions.
And then...
BOOOOOOOOOOM!!
The punch finally landed over Drino's chest, violent shockwaves travelled in all directions.
The armor burst apart, then the scales on Drino's body cracked and exploded, his body shot into the ground at unbelievable speed.
The ground cracked and a very large crater opened, a single punch, and the destruction caused surprised even Vritra.
After getting to the 3rd level of Demi God, he was yet to test his strength and just now he had only exerted his physical strength.
And the result was more than satisfying.
COUGH COUGH
Deep in the crater, Drino's twisted and mangled body lay in a pool of blood and scattered scales.
Just after taking a single punch, his state was so bad that if based on stats, he was now only at 20% health or maybe less.
Although his body began to heal, but Drino was shaking.
When did this human ant grow so much? Was he at the 4th level already?
Now that Drino looked again he noticed that Vritra too was at the 3rd level, so how was he so strong?
What was this bizarre difference between their strength? How did he even level up to 3 already?
Forget that, why was level 3 so different?
Drino's eyes had popped out earlier and his skull cracked open, not a single part of his body looked intact.
'I have to escape! I can't defeat him with just my strength!!' Drino understood that he had once again underestimated his opponent.
But... why the fuck was 1 minute not over yet?
He was scared and wanted to run away, 1 minute seemed short earlier but now, it just wouldn't end.
Vritra snapped and the blood in Drino's body began to boil over, and he was flung out of the deep crater.
His act of pretending to be dead to draw out time failed miserably.
But what was this new blood skill?
"Hmm You don't need this." Vritra mumbled as with a snap all the blood left Drino's body, turning him very thin and corpse-like.
"Now, let me steal your physique!" with a devilish smile on his face, Vritra grabbed his head and activated his unknown devouring skill.
RAGGGHHHHHHH
Drino screamed in pain as he felt the familiar sensation of having his physique stolen, Vritra had done this before.
But this time, he absolutely cannot let this happen.
Thankfully, even though he didn't believe it would happen but he had prepared some things, just in case Vritra wins.
With a signal, a tiny bead hidden in his belly exploded, and spatial energy spread in all directions.
Vritra was taken off guard as Drino's body became untouchable and he escaped from his grasp.
It was quite similar to his own fourth dimension, so Vritra also knew how to cancel it.
Without wasting any time, he locked onto Drino's location and broke the space around him, trapping him inside.
Drino who wanted to run away, found himself to be locked inside various walls.
The women who were standing not too far away were surprised at Drino's sudden appearance.
But they clearly remembered how he injured Vritra the last time, anger flared up in their hearts.
They all also flew towards the trapped Drino to attack, while Vritra again clutched Drino's head and began to absorb his physique.
CRACK CRACK
Drino's body continued to crack as the women surrounded him, they were just waiting for Vritra to be done and they would give him the most brutal death.
But Vritra was just halfway done when suddenly, the space buzzed and Drino just disappeared.
Even with his Null skill Vritra couldn't stop him, he could have followed Drino back.
But Vritra chose not to, what if Zihong arrived right after him leaving?
And wherever Drino had teleported, that place was too far, getting back would take some time.
'Tsk what a pity.' Vritra sighed, but he had still absorbed some of the energy.
{Sin Point Gained: Applauded +153,434}
{Sin Point Gained: Praised +153,222}
{Sin Point Gained: Baffled +153,332}
Vritra glanced at the Sin Points and a faint smile appeared on his face, the number of people had already increased by so much.
'Drino somehow revived and came right away to kill me, but since the gods should be busy for a while, I guess he took action on his own.'
Vritra thought, as he stood straight and raised his hand as a sign of victory.
The people screamed in excitement, they were feeling an adrenaline rush watching such a great battle.
Art Yate truly was a hero, their saviour.
'He will come again, maybe even bringing help?' Vritra thought, it seemed trouble was approaching.
There was still the matter of Zihong.
He really needed to get even stronger, and getting more Sin Points was one way to do it.
"Hubby, he is gone?" Yasmine asked, her hands were brimming with energy, she was ready to blast that piece of shit to pieces.
But he was gone?
"Yeah, he managed to escape. But don't worry, I am sure he will return back very soon." Vritra said, glancing over his wives who were full of killing intent.
They all looked quite cute, but right now, he can't let even them take the spotlight.
"We will soon be done with this, let me get some more Sin Points." Vritra said as they nodded and disappeared.
The public was already talking about them though, but not for long as Raldy finally jumped out of the hole.
"Hahaha I am back! Now get ready to handle my wrath, don't think you survived just by killing my servants!"
"Ah I almost forgot about this bastard, so he is still alive sigh Kill him Lord Art!"
Shouts rang out, and Vritra to create more drama, landed in front of Raldy and got a hold of his long hair.
Then with a sudden move, he pulled away Raldy's hair, leaving behind a bald head.
"P- Pffttt t- this bastard is bald? Hahahaha Look at that shiny bald head, yo Baldy, tell me who named you?" people began to laugh, it felt so satisfying.
'Alright Divine, now tell me about that truth you mentioned.' Vritra spoke in his mind.

I can't defeat him with just my strength!!' Drino understood that he had once again underestimated his opponent.
But... why the fuck was 1 minute not over yet?
He was scared and wanted to run away, 1 minute seemed short earlier but now, it just wouldn't end.
Vritra snapped and the blood in Drino's body began to boil over, and he was flung out of the deep crater.
His act of pretending to be dead to draw out time failed miserably.
But what was this new blood skill?
"Hmm You don't need this." Vritra mumbled as with a snap all the blood left Drino's body, turning him very thin and corpse-like.
"Now, let me steal your physique!" with a devilish smile on his face, Vritra grabbed his head and activated his unknown devouring skill.
RAGGGHHHHHHH
Drino screamed in pain as he felt the familiar sensation of having his physique stolen, Vritra had done this before.
But this time, he absolutely cannot let this happen.
Thankfully, even though he didn't believe it would happen but he had prepared some things, just in case Vritra wins.
With a signal, a tiny bead hidden in his belly exploded, and spatial energy spread in all directions.
Vritra was taken off guard as Drino's body became untouchable and he escaped from his grasp.
It was quite similar to his own fourth dimension, so Vritra also knew how to cancel it.
Without wasting any time, he locked onto Drino's location and broke the space around him, trapping him inside.
Drino who wanted to run away, found himself to be locked inside various walls.
The women who were standing not too far away were surprised at Drino's sudden appearance.
But they clearly remembered how he injured Vritra the last time, anger flared up in their hearts.
They all also flew towards the trapped Drino to attack, while Vritra again clutched Drino's head and began to absorb his physique.
CRACK CRACK
Drino's body continued to crack as the women surrounded him, they were just waiting for Vritra to be done and they would give him the most brutal death.
But Vritra was just halfway done when suddenly, the space buzzed and Drino just disappeared.
Even with his Null skill Vritra couldn't stop him, he could have followed Drino back.
But Vritra chose not to, what if Zihong arrived right after him leaving?
And wherever Drino had teleported, that place was too far, getting back would take some time.
'Tsk what a pity.' Vritra sighed, but he had still absorbed some of the energy.
{Sin Point Gained: Applauded +153,434}
{Sin Point Gained: Praised +153,222}
{Sin Point Gained: Baffled +153,332}
Vritra glanced at the Sin Points and a faint smile appeared on his face, the number of people had already increased by so much.
'Drino somehow revived and came right away to kill me, but since the gods should be busy for a while, I guess he took action on his own.'
Vritra thought, as he stood straight and raised his hand as a sign of victory.
The people screamed in excitement, they were feeling an adrenaline rush watching such a great battle.
Art Yate truly was a hero, their saviour.
'He will come again, maybe even bringing help?' Vritra thought, it seemed trouble was approaching.
There was still the matter of Zihong.
He really needed to get even stronger, and getting more Sin Points was one way to do it.
"Hubby, he is gone?" Yasmine asked, her hands were brimming with energy, she was ready to blast that piece of shit to pieces.
But he was gone?
"Yeah, he managed to escape.
But don't worry, I am sure he will return back very soon." Vritra said, glancing over his wives who were full of killing intent.
They all looked quite cute, but right now, he can't let even them take the spotlight.
"We will soon be done with this, let me get some more Sin Points." Vritra said as they nodded and disappeared.
The public was already talking about them though, but not for long as Raldy finally jumped out of the hole.
"Hahaha I am back!
Now get ready to handle my wrath, don't think you survived just by killing my servants!"
"Ah I almost forgot about this bastard, so he is still alive sigh Kill him Lord Art!"
Shouts rang out, and Vritra to create more drama, landed in front of Raldy and got a hold of his long hair.
Then with a sudden move, he pulled away Raldy's hair, leaving behind a bald head.
"P- Pffttt t- this bastard is bald?
Hahahaha Look at that shiny bald head, yo Baldy, tell me who named you?" people began to laugh, it felt so satisfying.
'Alright Divine, now tell me about that truth you mentioned.' Vritra spoke in his mind.

chapters.title: Chapter 770 The Truth of the World
paragraphs: 'Can you now tell me about that truth?' Vritra asked as he pulled away Raldy's hair, his bald head flashing in all directions.
"Yes, this is the biggest among the six truths, the truth of the world!" Divine said, his tone serious.
Vritra tried to think if he had heard anything about this truth of the world, it was hard to remember even the name unless he knows the truth itself.
Or his memory is protected by someone powerful, otherwise normal people don't even know of the existence of the six truths.
'Hmm I think I might have heard about it...' Vritra replied, still waiting to find more.
How would knowing about the world truth affect him so much? Now he was getting really curious.
"Then get ready to experience it." The Divine finally muttered his final words and then his body broke into strange symbols.
They travelled a vast distance, in an instant appearing in front of Vritra, then the symbols shot right into Vritra's head.
Coincidentally right at that moment, Raldy who had been humiliated in front of the public, was so enraged that he attacked Vritra with a little too much strength.
Shitless was enjoying acting superior so he got a little angry when everyone began to laugh at him and didn't hold back much strength.
BOOOOM
And unlike his expectations, Vritra didn't dodge, the punch struck him right in the chest blasting his body down into the ground.
The people were flabbergasted, they couldn't believe their eyes but then one person said it out loud:
"T- This bald bastard took advantage of Lord Art's earlier battle and sneak attacked!! How despicable, he truly is human trash!!"
"Ptui He is the worst of the worst, worse than a shit-eating pig, he deserves to be killed by drowning in poop!!"
Shitless looked at his hand and then at Vritra who had disappeared into the hole, when did he grow so strong?
While on the other hand, as soon as the symbols struck into Vritra's head, the entire world transformed for him.
Everything looked so strange.
Vritra felt as if his mind was about to explode, he saw the ground, the grass, the trees, the people around him, everything began to crumble.
Vritra looked at his own hands, his own body, and even that too was breaking apart.
His very breathing or the sound of his heartbeat, everything had transformed into something different.
Vritra's vision, his senses, the light, the air, it all seemed different.
And it was... strange-looking letters?
Was the world made of letters? Everything seemed to be made from those very words, nothing was an exception.
Vritra was so shocked that he couldn't understand anything, for a moment he forgot about himself, getting lost in the puzzle of those words that began to flow around messily.
Was this world not real? How is everything created from those words?
{Sin Point Gained: Confused +1}
{Sin Point Gained: Baffled +1}
{Sin Point Gained: Lost +1}
{Sin Point Gained: Bewildered +1}
Even the messages of Sin Points broke into strange words before disappearing, what was even happening?
Vritra's very thoughts were made of those same words, that actually didn't exist but were still there, it was all so confusing.
He lost the sense of his body, which had broken into the same letters.
Vritra's consciousness moved freely through this world of letters, the public, the ground, even his family, it all were nothing but letters.
'What are these letters? I thought everything is made of atoms, but they clearly don't look like it...' Vritra's mind was filled with so much information at this point.
He tried to not focus too much on everything, or he might lose his mind.
It was too much for the current him, even with his strength at the 3rd level Demi God, it was not enough.
The flames, the wood, the dust, it all was just letters, the future, the past, the flow of time and even fate.
It was just these strange-looking letters.
Vritra allowed his consciousness to drift closer to colourful letters which seemed to be water.
He let himself drown in it, the sensation he felt was completely different.
This was one of the world's truths, the only truth that even the gods aren't aware of, something even higher voices mostly don't know.
Something that was created by someone far out of all of their reach and strength.
The world, was it never real? Then what even was the point of doing anything?
Were their lives meaningless? The love he felt was just these letters? The feeling of sadness and happiness, it was all just these meaningless letters?
Why were they even created? The world, was it just someone's plaything? An experiment or entertainment?
The more Vritra allowed his consciousness to merge with these letters, the more lost he felt.
'Huh? What lost?'
Suddenly his consciousness was pulled out as he heard somethin-
'Who the hell is speaking?' Vritra's consciousness which was finally out of the misery of finding the truth looked around frantically.
He could sense strange letters flying around but couldn't tell who or what it was.
The final truth, the truth of the world was so vast and majestic that it could drown anyone, even the Divine luckily survived when he found out about it.
Vritra's consciousness which was about to drown forever, however was pulled by this strange sound.
'But how do I get out of here?' Vritra was confused, he tried his best to not focus on anything again.
Even a slight focus would make him drown, feel lost and make him merge with the surroundings, which would give him a strange death.
An unknown death that would make him forever lost, his body would be there but he-
'How the fuck do I get out of here?'
Vritra was losing his sanity, several times over he almost drowned into the very world, the letters that made up everything.
But he didn't know that the only way to get out of this, the only method in existence was nothing but acceptance!
'Acceptance? What does it even mean?' Vritra didn't know what voice it was he was hearing, but that seemed his only exit for now.
And for that, he needed to accept what his heart rejected, the truth of the world, the letters, the reality of it all.
Hoo...
Calming his breath or rather his consciousness, Vritra focused, and tried this method of acceptance.
So the world is not real, it is actually made of these letters, the truth of the world can make one lose faith in everything, lose their goals, and give up on everything.
But even if it's all fake, Vritra still wouldn't want to give anything up, neither his goals, nor his family, his women.
His wives mattered to him more than anything, so even if the world is just letters, he would want to return to them.
As Vritra began to accept, his consciousness was experiencing a strong pull, getting pulled back towards his body.
The letters began to arrange themselves, transforming back into the world which Vritra knew.
'If this world is fake, then I will just have to find the real thing and go there!' Vritra was filled with great determination, and the pull got stronger and stronger.
Until Vritra was thrust back into his body, he gasped for air, his eyes were blood red and heart thumping so wildly that it might pop out of his chest at any moment.
His mind was in extreme pain, despair, and every negative emotion to exist.
Vritra just thought about the fakeness of this world, the letters and suddenly felt as if his body was breaking apart again.
'Nooooo! I can't handle that again!' he quickly emptied his mind of all thoughts, gritting his teeth and forcefully stopped his mind from wandering.
He cannot yet handle exploring that truth yet.
His ears were buzzing with such loud noise, vision completely blurry, his mind seemed to be in the worst state.
'What the fuck was that? No no I can't think about it...' he rested inside the hole for a bit longer, blinking rapidly.
As his senses began to return, Vritra felt himself being held in soft arms.
And without even seeing he knew his wives must have surrounded him, then their worried voices sounded in his ears.
Diana, Yasmine, Maeve, Fiona, Vanessa, Teresa and Yennefer, all of them were repeatedly calling out to him.
"I... haa I am fine" after several seconds, he finally managed to mutter these few words.
Only then did the seven women feel at ease, then Vritra could finally see them, the beautiful women all had worried expressions on their faces.
And soon he was able to hear his wives and a strangely loud voice, it belonged to Shitless?
Even after this strange change, he was still carrying on with the drama.
He was talking to Zira, boasting and asking her to marry him.
Vritra was lying in Vanessa's arms, his head resting over the softness of her breasts, it felt so comfortable.
Her scent brought him comfort.
And instantly he began to crave her sweet hot milk, though it will have to wait a little.
Instead of jumping out of the hole, he just stayed there, letting Shitless continue with the drama.
Zira seemed almost on the verge of breaking, once that's done he would go out to get more Sin Points.
"Honey, what happened? Was it because of that Drino?" Vanessa asked.
"No mom, it was something different, I will explain once we have wrapped all this up." Vritra replied, his head was still hurting so bad.
From outside, Raldy's voice rang out: "So my dear Zira, are you now ready to marry me or do you want to stay with this deadbeat of a husband?"

chapters.title: Chapter 771 Abducted
paragraphs: A wisp of energy travelled through an extremely long distance, flashing back in an instant.
The seven Demi Gods who were ready to leave, all waited for their temporary leader to return.
They were floating in space with nothing but darkness around them and the distant blinking stars.
"Haa I hope he doesn't kill that Vritra guy, the trip would be cancelled and I wouldn't be able to spend more time with my dear Drino." Mole, the tree-like Demi God spoke.
"He was quite angry when he left, it wouldn't be shocking if he really killed that kid." Another Demi God with a shark-like head spoke, his teeth glowed like metals.
"Drino should be back at any moment now, let's hear how badly he hurt the-" just as another Demi God was speaking, they all sensed spatial fluctuation.
He is here!
And just as they expected, Demi God Drino appeared before them, but just not in the state they expected.
They all thought he would be very happy and laughing loudly, boasting how he beat up that kid.
But what came back was a broken mess, the skin was torn, bones broken, no blood in the body... it was a complete mess.
"Uh Is this Drino?" Mole worriedly asked as one of his branches scooped up the broken body, cradling it in his arms.
"I- It is indeed him, those clothes are the same at least. But what happened, wasn't he just going to crush a level 1 ant?" a Demi God with a rat-like face asked, fear clearly visible on his face.
The rat Demi God unconsciously released a feeling of dread into the air, making even the others shudder.
Mole and Sharky glared at him, making the Rat calm down.
"Let me tend to you." Mole tore a leaf from its branch releasing a strange moan as he did so, with a face that seemed flushed, he crushed the leaf that was full of vitality.
Then it was stuffed into the mouth of Drino who was barely conscious and couldn't speak.
Hooooo
As soon as the healing energy spread, Drino inhaled deeply, his body began to swell back, blood flowing through his veins.
They were in space but the Demi Gods had protective barriers around them.
They can move around even without it but it would be comfortable in the long run, not to mention Mole was releasing constant oxygen.
Though none of the Demi Gods wanted to inhale this special oxygen, though Drino had no choice.
"Hoo Hoo Ahhhh Where am I?!!" Drino flailed his arms around, appearing very frightened.
He could still see the image of that demon, when did he grow into something so terrifying?
"Hush It is me, your Mole, calm down. I am here with you, do you want me to heal you properly? Just say the word, I am good at very deep healing~" Mole muttered hugging Drino's rapidly healing body.
The other Demi Gods looked at this scene strangely, they respected Mole's strength but he was too strange.
It was just too disgusting.
Drino soon regained his senses, and was again shocked to find himself entangled in Mole's arms.
He pushed hard, Mole didn't resist and just let go, he wouldn't want to harm his favourite Drino, right?
Drino who still felt very weak fell limply, gasping for breath.
"What happened? Did someone intercept your teleportation just now?" a Demi God with a head that was made of bugs crawling questioned.
"I..." Drino got up as his body healed to some extent, then he hurriedly looked around.
Vritra possessed spatial powers too, he needed to make sure that guy had not teleported along.
Only after making sure did Drino finally heave a sigh of relief, then he looked at the seven curious Demi Gods.
'Should I tell them truthfully? But what if they refuse to go there with me afterwards? Sigh I shouldn't have used this teleportation...' Drino still felt chills thinking of Vritra's strength.
That guy had broken him with just one punch, a single punch, what sort of monster was he even?
"Uh So I... met..." Drino was still unsure.
Vritra couldn't come along with him for obvious reasons, but he sent a gift along with the broken Drino.
And right at this moment, just as the eight were distracted, Drino's shadow trembled.
Mole was the first to notice this change but it was too late.
Suddenly an imposing and dreadful Dark Knight rose from the shadow, endless darkness steaming out of its body.
It held a long sword, nearly the same height as itself, its armor appearing as if nothing existed in that part of space.
At first, the Dark Knight observed the eight and listened for any useful information, he would have stayed hidden for a little longer.
But it sensed that its location had been found out by someone, even Knight couldn't find who it was.
So, he instantly gave up on that and decided to attack. If it could at least bring one of the Demi Gods down with it, that would be worth it.
And which Demi God would be better than Drino who was already injured and the head of this team?
Dark Knight was not like Vritra, who was already at the peak of level three Demi God.
As a Titan, maybe only Mole would prove a little difficult to fight, but he could have defeated the other Demi Gods.
Though if he can utilize his Titan's abilities then even Mole would be nothing.
One of those skills was Titan Fall, which was extremely terrifying.
Dark Knight only possessed strength similar to Drino's old body, it cannot fight them all.
While they were all shocked, the heavy sword of the Dark Knight swung menacingly, aiming straight for Drino's head.
Killing a Demi God is not easy but not impossible either.
Dark Knight had already fulfilled its mission, anything it does now would just be a plus.
Drino was still too weak, he tried to dodge, but his weak body just stumbled and fell.
BOOM
In mid air, the direction of the sword changed and it crashed down, though the angle was a bit off.
The dark sword struck the lower neck of Drino, plunging deeper as newly formed blood spluttered and flesh was torn.
Bones which were just repairing were broken again, as the swing cut deeper and deeper.
By this time, the other Demi Gods, especially Mole had reacted, they launched attacks towards the Knight.
And Knight being fully aware, knew it would be impossible to defend against them.
Just as the sword had reached the mid part of Drino's chest, Knight lowered his body as all the energy in its body began to boil.
SELF DESTRUCTION!
The others understood what this strange creature wanted to do, and all their attacks turned meaningless.
What's the point of attacking him when his body was already going to destruct.
Even Mole frowned, the leaves on his body grew rapidly, he wanted to protect Drino who couldn't do much.
But Mole was too late.
Dark Knight's body continued to swell, the explosion might really obliterate Drino completely.
"I- Save me, H- HELPPPPPPPP" unable to hold on any longer, Drino finally let out a loud scream, his voice so frightened.
He really didn't want to die, that treacherous Vritra was so evil, even when he was running away he didn't give Drino a way out.
That evil human, but Drino could clearly sense death a second time and he was very unwilling to die just like that.
BOOOOOOO-
Just as Knight's body exploded, time seemed to pause, or rather the explosion was paused.
The Demi Gods were all shocked, they looked around in confusion, wondering who had done this.
Knight's exploding body had paused right there and then and no matter how much it struggled, Knight couldn't get free.
"What a pity, I was hoping you would charge after Drino like the hot-blooded young man you were, sigh..." a distant voice sounded and then a man flew towards them.
Softly landing beside the frightened Drino.
It was the level 4 Demi God, Zihong, seeing him made all the eight so happy.
Especially Drino! He was completely overjoyed, his saviour was here.
He thanked those administrators who had brought Zihong to him.
"Tsk so useless." Zihong just kicked Drino's broken body away, then looked at the exploding figure.
He knew Vritra could see and hear him.
"But since you sent a toy here, I will keep it for you. Take it if you want it." A twisted smile formed on his lips, he tore that piece of space and stored it away.
Zihong's current body didn't possess the ability of space, this was just basic with their level of strength.
Though, he did possess the ability of time, this was the body he had planted and prepared to use along with that fishing rod stolen by that thief Vritra.
There were many changes to his plans because of unforeseen circumstances, it even got delayed by so long.
But thankfully, a wisp of his consciousness was able to escape, then got nurtured inside the body of that dragon.
And only after growing strong enough did it finally get to this body, the level 4 Demi God.
It was still weaker than his true self but with the time ability, one of the rarest, he was still happy.
Now as long as he could get a few more things, he can continue with his plan.
Thinking about the plan, he looked towards the blinking stars, a strange but profound look in his eyes.
"Anyway, this Soul Wraith of yours, I will hold onto it, come and meet me or well, I will be coming to meet you soon." Zihong muttered before disappearing again.

sentences.text: A wisp of energy travelled through an extremely long distance, flashing back in an instant.
The seven Demi Gods who were ready to leave, all waited for their temporary leader to return.
They were floating in space with nothing but darkness around them and the distant blinking stars.
"Haa I hope he doesn't kill that Vritra guy, the trip would be cancelled and I wouldn't be able to spend more time with my dear Drino." Mole, the tree-like Demi God spoke.
"He was quite angry when he left, it wouldn't be shocking if he really killed that kid." Another Demi God with a shark-like head spoke, his teeth glowed like metals.
"Drino should be back at any moment now, let's hear how badly he hurt the-" just as another Demi God was speaking, they all sensed spatial fluctuation.
He is here!
And just as they expected, Demi God Drino appeared before them, but just not in the state they expected.
They all thought he would be very happy and laughing loudly, boasting how he beat up that kid.
But what came back was a broken mess, the skin was torn, bones broken, no blood in the body... it was a complete mess.
"Uh Is this Drino?" Mole worriedly asked as one of his branches scooped up the broken body, cradling it in his arms.
"I- It is indeed him, those clothes are the same at least.
But what happened, wasn't he just going to crush a level 1 ant?" a Demi God with a rat-like face asked, fear clearly visible on his face.
The rat Demi God unconsciously released a feeling of dread into the air, making even the others shudder.
Mole and Sharky glared at him, making the Rat calm down.
"Let me tend to you." Mole tore a leaf from its branch releasing a strange moan as he did so, with a face that seemed flushed, he crushed the leaf that was full of vitality.
Then it was stuffed into the mouth of Drino who was barely conscious and couldn't speak.
Hooooo
As soon as the healing energy spread, Drino inhaled deeply, his body began to swell back, blood flowing through his veins.
They were in space but the Demi Gods had protective barriers around them.
They can move around even without it but it would be comfortable in the long run, not to mention Mole was releasing constant oxygen.
Though none of the Demi Gods wanted to inhale this special oxygen, though Drino had no choice.
"Hoo Hoo Ahhhh Where am I?!!" Drino flailed his arms around, appearing very frightened.
He could still see the image of that demon, when did he grow into something so terrifying?
"Hush It is me, your Mole, calm down.
I am here with you, do you want me to heal you properly?
Just say the word, I am good at very deep healing~" Mole muttered hugging Drino's rapidly healing body.
The other Demi Gods looked at this scene strangely, they respected Mole's strength but he was too strange.
It was just too disgusting.
Drino soon regained his senses, and was again shocked to find himself entangled in Mole's arms.
He pushed hard, Mole didn't resist and just let go, he wouldn't want to harm his favourite Drino, right?
Drino who still felt very weak fell limply, gasping for breath.
"What happened?
Did someone intercept your teleportation just now?" a Demi God with a head that was made of bugs crawling questioned.
"I..." Drino got up as his body healed to some extent, then he hurriedly looked around.
Vritra possessed spatial powers too, he needed to make sure that guy had not teleported along.
Only after making sure did Drino finally heave a sigh of relief, then he looked at the seven curious Demi Gods.
'Should I tell them truthfully?
But what if they refuse to go there with me afterwards?
Sigh I shouldn't have used this teleportation...' Drino still felt chills thinking of Vritra's strength.
That guy had broken him with just one punch, a single punch, what sort of monster was he even?
"Uh So I... met..." Drino was still unsure.
Vritra couldn't come along with him for obvious reasons, but he sent a gift along with the broken Drino.
And right at this moment, just as the eight were distracted, Drino's shadow trembled.
Mole was the first to notice this change but it was too late.
Suddenly an imposing and dreadful Dark Knight rose from the shadow, endless darkness steaming out of its body.
It held a long sword, nearly the same height as itself, its armor appearing as if nothing existed in that part of space.
At first, the Dark Knight observed the eight and listened for any useful information, he would have stayed hidden for a little longer.
But it sensed that its location had been found out by someone, even Knight couldn't find who it was.
So, he instantly gave up on that and decided to attack.
If it could at least bring one of the Demi Gods down with it, that would be worth it.
And which Demi God would be better than Drino who was already injured and the head of this team?
Dark Knight was not like Vritra, who was already at the peak of level three Demi God.
As a Titan, maybe only Mole would prove a little difficult to fight, but he could have defeated the other Demi Gods.
Though if he can utilize his Titan's abilities then even Mole would be nothing.
One of those skills was Titan Fall, which was extremely terrifying.
Dark Knight only possessed strength similar to Drino's old body, it cannot fight them all.
While they were all shocked, the heavy sword of the Dark Knight swung menacingly, aiming straight for Drino's head.
Killing a Demi God is not easy but not impossible either.
Dark Knight had already fulfilled its mission, anything it does now would just be a plus.
Drino was still too weak, he tried to dodge, but his weak body just stumbled and fell.
BOOM
In mid air, the direction of the sword changed and it crashed down, though the angle was a bit off.
The dark sword struck the lower neck of Drino, plunging deeper as newly formed blood spluttered and flesh was torn.
Bones which were just repairing were broken again, as the swing cut deeper and deeper.
By this time, the other Demi Gods, especially Mole had reacted, they launched attacks towards the Knight.
And Knight being fully aware, knew it would be impossible to defend against them.
Just as the sword had reached the mid part of Drino's chest, Knight lowered his body as all the energy in its body began to boil.
SELF DESTRUCTION!
The others understood what this strange creature wanted to do, and all their attacks turned meaningless.
What's the point of attacking him when his body was already going to destruct.
Even Mole frowned, the leaves on his body grew rapidly, he wanted to protect Drino who couldn't do much.
But Mole was too late.
Dark Knight's body continued to swell, the explosion might really obliterate Drino completely.
"I- Save me, H- HELPPPPPPPP" unable to hold on any longer, Drino finally let out a loud scream, his voice so frightened.
He really didn't want to die, that treacherous Vritra was so evil, even when he was running away he didn't give Drino a way out.
That evil human, but Drino could clearly sense death a second time and he was very unwilling to die just like that.
BOOOOOOO-
Just as Knight's body exploded, time seemed to pause, or rather the explosion was paused.
The Demi Gods were all shocked, they looked around in confusion, wondering who had done this.
Knight's exploding body had paused right there and then and no matter how much it struggled, Knight couldn't get free.
"What a pity, I was hoping you would charge after Drino like the hot-blooded young man you were, sigh..." a distant voice sounded and then a man flew towards them.
Softly landing beside the frightened Drino.
It was the level 4 Demi God, Zihong, seeing him made all the eight so happy.
Especially Drino!
He was completely overjoyed, his saviour was here.
He thanked those administrators who had brought Zihong to him.
"Tsk so useless." Zihong just kicked Drino's broken body away, then looked at the exploding figure.
He knew Vritra could see and hear him.
"But since you sent a toy here, I will keep it for you.
Take it if you want it." A twisted smile formed on his lips, he tore that piece of space and stored it away.
Zihong's current body didn't possess the ability of space, this was just basic with their level of strength.
Though, he did possess the ability of time, this was the body he had planted and prepared to use along with that fishing rod stolen by that thief Vritra.
There were many changes to his plans because of unforeseen circumstances, it even got delayed by so long.
But thankfully, a wisp of his consciousness was able to escape, then got nurtured inside the body of that dragon.
And only after growing strong enough did it finally get to this body, the level 4 Demi God.
It was still weaker than his true self but with the time ability, one of the rarest, he was still happy.
Now as long as he could get a few more things, he can continue with his plan.
Thinking about the plan, he looked towards the blinking stars, a strange but profound look in his eyes.
"Anyway, this Soul Wraith of yours, I will hold onto it, come and meet me or well, I will be coming to meet you soon." Zihong muttered before disappearing again.

chapters.title: Chapter 772 All an Act
paragraphs: On the Zoratian planet, just while Shitless was dealing with Zira, Vritra suddenly frowned.
He had sent the Dark Knight to gather information and, if possible, also harm the enemies.
Now he knew that there were eight level 3 Demi Gods and even a level 4 Demi God.
But the end result was not good at all, Knight was captured, and no matter how many commands he gave.
Knight couldn't return, he was locked in a time lock, unable to do anything.
'Fuck!' his fists clenched unconsciously, eyes narrowing, this left a terrible feeling.
"What's wrong darling?" Fiona asked, clearly noticing the change.
Just now he seemed to be in a good mood but now that didn't seem to be the case.
"Sigh, Dark Knight has been captured, and it can't get free." Vritra answered, the women around were shocked.
{Sin Point Gained: Shocked +7}
{Sin Point Gained: Received Concern +7}
{Sin Point Gained: Called Out +152,456}
{Sin Point Gained: Worried +152,463}
"Is he in danger?" Teresa asked, she bit her lip, even after going through all that.
After returning they were once again surrounded by danger.
Why won't it ever end?
"I don't think so, killing a Soul Wraith is nearly impossible. For now, that guy has just locked Knight away." Vritra replied.
From the tone of that guy, he had a feeling that it was none other than Zihong.
But how was he at the 4th level? Didn't his body get locked on this planet?
Did he possess another body?
Whatever might be the case, it doesn't matter. What matters is, how is he going to defeat someone like that?
'Divine, can I defeat him...' Vritra asked in his mind out of habit but then realized that the Divine was already gone.
For a moment his thoughts drifted back to that world truth but he forcefully pulled himself away from it.
'Can I not talk to the Divine's other avatar?' he wondered.
Hoo...
Calming his mind, Vritra sat up, the drama outside was close to ending.
"So, do you agree to be with me?" Raldy asked, his voice booming across a large distance.
"Don't do it, woman, he is the trashiest pig, he is a bald rotten bastard who will kill you later."
"Don't leave your good husband for this trash, this Raldy is a piece of shit!"
The public shouted loudly, trying to make Zira stop from leaving her loving husband Onest.
"Madah, forget this fucka, I like this new fadah moe!" the fourth son of Zira spoke, pulling her arm.
He could already imagine with this new father, how unhinged he would be, he can kill whoever he wanted and not be punished.

"Mommy, Onest is a scaredy cat, he can't even protect you, he doesn't love you, he is only staying with you because of that contract. Once he finds a flaw, he will slit your throat in sleep and then hang your dead body." Another son shouted.
"Yes mom, we need a new dad, he is the best. Please marry Bald- COUGH I mean marry dad Raldy."
"Daddy, only you are qualified to marry my mother, and no one else, hmph how dare this trash even think of touching my mom!!"
The four were already calling Raldy their new father, they abandoned Onest immediately.
"M- My sons, it is me your lovely fadah Onest, don't you love me? Don't you want to sleep in your fadah's arms?" Onest asked, appearing heartbroken.
"Ptui As if I would sleep in the stinking arms of you shitty bastard, let me tell you, I never once considered you my father. Fuck off! Kekeke."
All four of them laughed and cursed, while the public ridiculed them and Raldy.
Everyone in the crowd felt so angry seeing the smug looks on their faces, how can there be such unfilial children in this world.
Sigh... the world has truly rotten, it would be better to beat such children the moment they leave their first house.
"SOB I- I can't believe you would do something like this... Zira, honey, you love me don't you, you won't abandon me right?" Onest asked, taking Zira's hand.
Shitless rolled his eyes, seeing him do all this overacting he almost wanted to tell them everything just to stop his acting.
"Sigh, I am sorry honey- Onest, but for our sons, I have to make this sacrifice." Zira is a smart woman, even if she was leaving Onest, she would make it seem as if she was being forced.
"Y- You won't hurt my children i- if I marry you, right?" Zira's eyes were full of calculation and greed, but she spoke pitifully.
The public felt pity for this woman, who was so powerless that she needed to sacrifice herself to protect her sons and husband.
They all looked angrily at Raldy.
"Yes of course, as long as you choose me, you will all be safe. I need you and only you." Raldy said hurriedly, he didn't want to drag this on any longer.
"F- Fine, Onest, we can no longer be together. SOB maybe in some other life, we can be husband and wife again, but for our children, for us, I have to do this." Zira muttered.
"..." Onest just stared at her wide-eyed, unable to speak anything.
The public kept asking her to stop while the four of her sons kept asking Zira to do it.
Zira took out the contract which was like a thick book, the only way for divorce was if she does it.
She took a deep breath and steadied her mind, after thinking of all possibilities she decided to make this choice.
Raldy is very strong and rich, he can even kill someone like Lord Art and face no consequences.
She had to take this opportunity, and elevate their lives.
Finally, she drew a drop of blood from her thumb then placed it at the corner and the contract began burning on its own.
"Sorry Onest, now we are no longer related." Zira muttered, as the entire contract burned away.
"R- Really? You aren't lying?" Onest asked, but he had no way to confirm.
What if she is lying to test me, he wondered.
Vritra knew it was finally his time to show up and get some more Sin Points.
He flew up and had a look of anger on his face, people around could see a blood stain near his chest.
"Y- You are still alive?" Raldy asked, he looked shocked.
Vritra ignored him and looked at Zira with a stern look and asked: "Did you really just divorce Onest and end all relations with him?"
"Y- Yes, I did." Zira answered, trying to act pitiful.
"That contract is null and void, you have absolutely nothing to do with him, right?" Vritra pressured and asked again.
Zira felt strange and uncomfortable, but he looked so handsome that for a moment she wondered if she should just marry this guy.
He was far more handsome than that Raldy.
"Yes." She nodded.
{Sin Point Gained: Watched +155,034}
{Sin Point Gained: Awed +155,032}
Vritra glanced at the barrage of Sin Points and didn't see any message that indicated that she was lying.
So their task was finally done, Onest was free.
'Hmm it is time to end, but it wouldn't hurt to get a few more Sin Points.' Vritra thought.
So without uttering a word, he flew down, clutched Raldy's neck and smashed his face into the ground.
The people were overjoyed as Vritra began to one-sidedly beat him up, they were so happy and kept cheering.
Vritra held Raldy's leg and then smashed him into the ground again and again.
This battle continued for a while, where Raldy could do nothing.
Zira looked on worriedly, she wouldn't want her future husband to die before marrying her.
Onest wasn't an option now, or maybe seeing how much he liked her, he would still accept her?
Soon Vritra noticed that the Sin Points he was receiving had gotten very low and dragging it any longer was pointless.
"W- Wait, young Lord Art, I have something to say!" Raldy spoke hurriedly and with great respect.
The crowd laughed in satisfaction, now that this dog was going to die, he suddenly became respectful?
No way Lord Art was going to spare him.
"What is it?" Vritra asked, his hand paused mid-air.
"A- Actually, none of it was real. It was just a bet with my younger brother and haha, Itch, come out you have won." Raldy spoke dryly.

"Hehe Big brother, I knew once you have shown a little of power and wealth, the women could even leave their husbands." Just then, the boy they all thought had died, walked out from the crowd with a big grin.
"Yeah, you are right, here is your 1 gold coin." Raldy tossed a gold coin to Itch who caught it and laughed loudly.
"W- What? This was all a bet? Y- You were betting on our lives, for a mere 1 gold coin?" Zira was the most shocked at this moment, she couldn't believe her eyes.
The crowd was stunned.
No way, this has to be a joke- No, not a joke, all that had to be serious, no?
"Yes, sorry miss Zira, I have no interest in you or your children. I am not even rich or strong, it was all an act." Raldy said, embarrassedly.
"W- What about those dragons then?" she asked, flustered.
"Ah those? It was a trick too, even this Lord Art is fake, kekeke." Shitless said, as he patted Vritra's shoulder but his body broke into dust.
The whole crowd was left speechless.

chapters.title: Chapter 773 The Regrets
paragraphs: "I- It was all a prank? You played around with our lives for a single gold coin?!!" Zira stumbled back, her face pale.
"Ah Haha yeah, don't mind it miss Zira, my big brother is a little stupid. Don't worry, I will punish him for you." Itch said, as he held Raldy's ear and dragged him away.
Within moments, the two flew away, not caring about any of them.
The public was also going crazy, all that was just a joke?
"L- Lord Art? What about those dragons then?" someone in the crowd asked.
"COUGH That must have been an illusion then, we were all caught in the illusion. Don't worry though, I will punish them properly."
Vritra lingered around a bit longer, getting as many Sin Points as possible.
But soon, only a few Sin Points were pouring, the emotional fluctuations of everyone in the crowd had stabilized.
There was no point in keeping them all here.
"Time to leave everyone, go back!" Vritra said, with a clap all the people who were from Yate Realm were teleported back.
The others who had come from nearby were teleported away.
Now only Vritra, his wives, Onest, Zira and her four kids remained.
'Hmm Where did Bullo go?' Vritra wondered as he looked around, he called out in his mind to try to chat with the Divine.
But it was useless.
Divine won't reply, so this avatar really can't talk or was there a reason for not talking now?
Zira was just standing there in a daze, her mind buzzing violently, she couldn't believe anything at this moment.
"L- Lord Art, am I dreaming?" Zira turned to look at Vritra, her vision was blurry.
She stumbled and her sons quickly stepped forward to help her.
"No, this is not a dream. Anyway you have now divorced your husband, whatever happens now is your own choice." Vritra replied with a shrug.
She turned to look at Onest, instantly her eyes were filled with tears as she spoke: "Honey, SOB p- please forgive me, I still love you and only you.
I never wanted to separate from you, if that bald bastard hadn't forced me, hadn't threatened me, I would never have divorced you.
I want to spend my entire life with you, let's marry again, and this time without any contract!"
Zira looked at him hopefully, then gestured at her kids.
"Daddy, I am sorrryyyy, I was so afraid of that bald demon, I thought he was going to kill you so I said all that."
"Yes Dad, we love only you and none else could take the place of my dad!"
"Fadah, my lovely fadah!! Please, I am ya son!"
All of them spoke hurriedly, the four sons fell to their knees and began to cry, apologizing for their mistakes.
"My lovely family, I never doubted you..." Onest spread his arms as he looked at the five of them, a calm loving smile on his face.
"My wife, my sons, I knew you would never backstab me-" while speaking, Onest suddenly covered his mouth.
PFFTT...
His shoulders were shaking as he tried his best to hold back his laugh, in the end, he couldn't hold it.
HAHAHAHAHAHA
He burst out with such loud laughter that startled the five, they stared at him in shock.
Was he so happy to have them back? Just as they thought, he is a fool and a simp, even if they throw shit at him, he would crawl back to them and lick their feet.
"You stupid bastards hahaha look at your expressions, you look so stupid haha oof I am gonna cry, this is too funny." Onest said, wiping the imaginary tears.
They had noticed that something was wrong, Onest wasn't acting like usual.
Wasn't he so much in love with Zira earlier? Didn't he show his love for his sons just earlier?
Didn't he appear broken when they were divorced?
What is happening? Did he go mad by the impact of that divorce and the betrayal.
