chapters.title: Chapter 774 Raka Zaka
paragraphs: Ava was standing in a big field, she was giving orders to the servants while humming to herself.
She was in such a great mood.
'It's been a while since husband and Art went out, when will they return?' Ava wondered, as she gazed into the distance.
"Madam, do we need to add these things to the menu?" one of the men asked as he handed her a page.
"Hmmm" Ava quickly read through the list, then pointed out a few things and replied: "Except these, I need everything on the menu!"
Yes, she was arranging the big party, to announce to the world the return of her son and her daughters-in-law.
And the great news of her son having a child.
She really was so happy, at one point she felt she had lost everything, she was just waiting for death.
The family was about to fall, the side family was eyeing the main position and the resources.
It was all in shambles, even her husband looked so depressed, getting pressure from all sides.
But just her son returning had changed everything, and she felt the happiest in the world.
Ava really cherished her son so much, he is really the best.
After falling into deep thoughts, she turned and busied herself with the preparations, it was going to be the biggest party the Yate Realm had ever seen.
'Hmm I wonder if Art has selected names for my grandkids, will it be a boy or a girl?' Ava thought, laughing softly to herself.
She needed to talk with her daughters-in-law, get to know them better.
All of a sudden their family had grown bigger, although she was a bit worried initially but she was sure Art can handle it.
Just then a few figures appeared in the sky, she looked over excitedly but then her smile disappeared.
"Huh? Who are they?" Ava frowned, looking at the two men who wore black and white clothes.
The guy in black was so black that he seemed as if he had been dipped into dark ink, none of his features were discernible.
While the white guy was so white that he looked like a white sheet of paper, both looked way too strange.
The guy in black was so black that he seemed as if he had been dipped into dark ink, none of his features were discernible.
While the white guy was so white that he looked like a white sheet of paper, both looked way too strange.
She frowned and soon other people began to notice them too, their presence was too eye-catching.
Ava didn't recognize them, she hadn't even sent any invitations yet, nor did Gunter know any such people.
They didn't even look human.
And Ava could feel there was trouble approaching, several guards quickly appeared, looking at the two figures.
But despite the surroundings and everyone gazing at them, the two were busy talking among themselves.
"Are you sure we are at the right place? I can't sense him." Raka the white figure spoke in a heavy voice.
"...Yea, the great finder had clearly sensed him here, I had even checked thrice." Zaka, the dark figure spoke in a rather feminine voice, scratching his head.
"What? You dumbass, don't tell me you made another mistake, we had even used the great teleportation treasure, you know how precious that is?" Raka shouted.
"U- Uh... SOB but... but I did my best, because my mom is dead, is that SOB why you always bully m- me?" Zaka began to cry, a flood of tears began to pour out of his eyes.
But it was black water, the sky darkened as dark rain began to pour down.
The rain fell to the ground and instantly, the plants lost their vitality, it was as if a great catastrophe was about to appear.

Raka rolled his eyes then consoled his big brother who was a little timid: "Hush it's alright, you know we only got each other. It is fine, we all make mistakes, it's no big deal. Didn't our father make a mistake as well?"
"Father did? What?" Zaka finally began to calm down as he used his brother's clothes to wipe his snot and tears.
"That's not important, anyway we are here to beat Vritra, you brought his poster right?" Raka asked, extending his hand.
"Oh uh I- I forgot..." Zaka's eyes welled up with tears again, as if he was about to cry.
"Hoo Don't worry it's fine, you at least brought the great finger, right? Give it to me." Raka asked calmly.
"Oh right, I put it in my pastel pink bunny bag!!" with a big smile, Zaka smiled.
"See, you aren't useless, take it out big brother." Raka also smiled, his big brother might act a little stupid sometimes but he is still very helpful-
"Oh that bag hmmm yea I have brought it!!" Zaka laughed like a kid and put his right arm into his mouth which was opened wide.
After a few seconds of rummaging, he pulled out a pink cute bag.
"Here it is brother- oh" Zaka suddenly paused, his eyes widening and he began to shake.
"Hmm, what's wrong big brother? Give it to me, we have to quickly find the great finder and locate Vritra, we need to complete our task." Raka asked, smiling gently.
"I- I brought the wrong bag, instead of pastel pink... I b- brought bubble gum pink." Zaka said, tears welling up in his eyes.

"You son of a bubblegum, really? Ughh why am I stuck with you? Damnit! First you cry if I don't hand those things to you and then you do what? Choose a different pink? Why the fuck do you even have so many pinks? You retarded big brother, even women aren't-" Raka paused his cursing when he saw his young brother cry.
"Uwaah you are bad, that truck was right, 1000 dogs died when you were born SOB SOB" Zaka cried.
"Hmph then how are you still alive?" Raka retorted angrily.
"You mean, I am a d- dog SOB?" Zaka asked.
"Are you asking or announcing?!" Raka shouted.
"Younger brother!!" Zaka raised his hand as if he was about to slap him, but paused.
The two brothers hugged as they remembered the words from their mother, how could they ever bear to fight?
"It is alright big brother, I will ask around for direction." Raka said, wiping his brother's face.
Then his expressions changed and he glanced around at the people standing not too far away.
All of them looking at them warily but didn't dare to utter a word, the presence of the two Demi Gods was crushing.
Raka and Zaka landed on the ground which had been turned completely dark by the tears from earlier.
Their gazes were filled with indifference as if all the people here were nothing more than bugs.
They can kill whoever and however many of them they want.
But they can't stay on this planet for long or the rules here would drain them and lock them up here.
Just like that famous Demi God that disappeared.
Many Demi Gods had made such mistakes, but most had been weak, only Zihong was the one who had such a high level.
So they had to finish the task and leave soon.
They can't waste too much time searching for that guy, and the best way of questioning was first scaring them a bit.
"Big brother, let me kill a few of them, then we will ask." The white figure said.
"Yay, go ahead, I will cheer for you!!" Zaka clapped and jumped up and down.
Raka scanned the crowd and decided to kill half of them before questioning.
The white figure pointed a finger forward, as a faint glow appeared at the fingertip, then a strong ray of light burst forth.
BOOOM!!
The startled bunch didn't even have the time to scream as the attack flashed before them, it moved at the speed of light.
Ava who was near the front of the group was in the range of the attack, her life flashed before her eyes as fear settled in her heart.
She didn't want to die, she wanted to spend more time with her family, but Ava was powerless to do anything.
An explosion that shook the entire Yate Realm took place, pieces of all the people in the group splattered in different directions.
"Ah haha Raka, you killed more than half haha you will receive penalty, say you are a bad boy haha" Zaka laughed, squinting his eyes.
"Tsk" Raka frowned, he didn't smell the scent of blood just now.
As the blinding light disappeared and the dust settled, Raka saw that everyone was still alive.
"Huh? What happened-" he raised his hand again but right then he felt a hand press over his shoulder.
"Hello friend, do you need something?" Raka was startled as a human with a smile on his face appeared beside him suddenly.
But there was no hostility, and he was even trying to help?
But their supreme leader had said not to trust anyone easily.
"Who are you? Why should I trust you?" Raka asked, frowning, while Zaka while laughing idiotically approached.

"I am Jin, and of course you can believe me, is that even a question? I swear over my brother Shitless, if I lie, let the god punish him with 101 electric tribulations!!" Vritra said as he took a step back and looked seriously at the two brothers.
"Oh!" Raka and Zaka looked at one another.
'He swore over his brother, so he isn't a liar.' The two thought, then Raka asked arrogantly.
"Hmph if you want to help us bug, then tell us where can we find Vritra Arclis, you better hurry up." Raka asked.
"Ah him? You should have said so earlier, finding him is a piece of cake. Let me tell you, so if you just go to the Divine Kage's building..." Vritra began to reply with honesty.

Why should I trust you?" Raka asked, frowning, while Zaka while laughing idiotically approached.
"I am Jin, and of course you can believe me, is that even a question?
I swear over my brother Shitless, if I lie, let the god punish him with 101 electric tribulations!!" Vritra said as he took a step back and looked seriously at the two brothers.
"Oh!" Raka and Zaka looked at one another.
'He swore over his brother, so he isn't a liar.' The two thought, then Raka asked arrogantly.
"Hmph if you want to help us bug, then tell us where can we find Vritra Arclis, you better hurry up." Raka asked.
"Ah him?
You should have said so earlier, finding him is a piece of cake.
Let me tell you, so if you just go to the Divine Kage's building..." Vritra began to reply with honesty.

chapters.title: Chapter 775 Brothers!!
paragraphs: "So if you just go to the Divine Kage organisation, you'll be able to find him, Vritra." Vritra spoke seriously.
Then he added: "You two look good and have such a nice brotherly relationship that almost made me emotional, I will treat you like my brothers so here is an advice..."
"Vritra is extremely cunning and a liar, no matter what you can't fall for his lies, he might say this and that but you can't fall for it."
"Hehehe Do you think we are kids? Why would we be fooled haha, right Raka?" Zaka laughed, covering his mouth with his palm.
"So wise, are you the older one?" Vritra asked with a tone of respect.
"Hehe I am, how did you find out?" Zaka looked shy as he turned and laughed strangely.
"Where is this Divine large group?" Raka interrupted, they can't waste too much time here after all.
"No need to be so tense, here let me give you a map." Vritra smiled faintly and took out a map from his inventory, then he marked the territory of Divine Kage.

"Right here, Vritra has many clones that he uses to fool people. He even acts so arrogant as if they are sent by the gods themselves, and he had stolen-" Vritra paused, looked left and right and added.

"Psst it's a secret, they had even stolen the god's punishment from the righteous organisation Golden Moon. They will treat you like fools, but no matter what you can't fall for their tricks." Vritra said firmly.
"Hmph we aren't so easy to fool, we brothers are the strongest under our supreme leader!!" Raka spoke proudly.
"Whoa, the people of your group have such high intelligence? Who is your supreme leader?" Vritra asked, turning to Zaka instead of Raka.
"Hehe Supreme Master had ordered us not to tell anyone his name or the fact that we are from the Nine Pact even if it's you, we don't say it." he muttered.
Vritra was taken aback, Nine Pacts? Wasn't that the organisation of the Zoratian planet? How come such an organisation exists outside too?
He looked at the two intelligent beings, their strength was at the level of 4th Demi Gods, which is why Vritra didn't engage in a direct battle.
He wasn't sure if he could take them on, with each increase in level the difference only increases further.
'How am I going to deal with people? There are so many high-level Demi Gods outside sigh...' Vritra fell into deep thoughts.
Even before, he had fought against strong enemies, somehow he had ways to fight people far stronger than himself.
But right now, there wasn't much.
At least with that fishing rod he wouldn't die unless the opponent has some special means, if only Divine was here to help.
The vast outside was too dangerous, he then glanced at his Sin Points which had gone even higher after all the drama earlier.
The number was so big, yet so small, with 100 million he could only upgrade one of his skills.
'But I wonder which one I should upgrade.' for now he put the matter to the back of his head and looked back at the two brothers.
So these two weren't with Drino? He decided to ask just to confirm.
"Do you two know about a lizard named Drino?" Vritra questioned, acting all casual.
"Lizard? We don't know any lizards hehe but I like eating lizards, is it your pet can I eat its tail?" Zaka laughed, sticking his tongue out.
He looked idiotic, but still his strength was undeniable.
"No, he is a friend of Vritra, for now he had gone out but he is very powerful and kills anyone who wants to kill Vritra." Vritra said, making up some nonsense.
"Oh right back to the main topic, brothers, succeed and kill them all!! Don't fall for their tricks." Vritra reminded again.
"Thank you, since you treated us with such sincerity we will help you once in the future, tell me if you need anything." Raka said.
"Hehe then I will help you too, call me big brother hehe I got another younger brother, so happy!!" Zaka clapped his hands, smiling ear to ear.
"Haa I am happy too, are you two lords?" Vritra asked, looking curious.
"Haha No we are Demi Gods, that is something far higher than a lord, but this planet doesn't seem to have any." Raka replied, he didn't seem as stern as before, treating Vritra like a friend.
"Whoa, Demi Gods? You two must be very strong." He spoke, then after thinking for a moment he asked: "If it's possible can you give me the corpse of a level 1 Demi God?"
"Hmm? Level 1?" The two brothers looked at one another.
"Easy peasy, I can kill them with my pinky hehe this pinky no no left hand's one!" Zaka said.
Raka didn't ask anything about this weird request, he just nodded, they can get it easily.
Quite a few Demi Gods die after all.
Vritra smiled as he watched the two brothers finally leaving this place, as for the corpse, he would need it for a small plan later on.
The ten players he had met in that game were also Demi Gods but he cannot bring their corpses unfortunately and he cannot leave this place for now.
So making his enemies work for him, what would be better than that?
"Art, who were they?" Ava approached him and asked, at first she was worried that the two had come here to cause trouble.
But were they Art's friends? The three were talking in such a friendly manner.
"Just two dudes doing cosplay, nothing much, anyway, how much have you progressed in preparation?" He asked and looked around.
"I am done selecting most things, oh right is it okay to reveal to the world that I am going to be a grandma?" Ava asked with hopeful eyes.
"Of course, it is fine." Vritra nodded, smiling. This new mother of his was rather cute, she was quite nice.
"Son, there is no problem with Onest now right?" Gunter asked, approaching the two.
"..." Vritra looked back and saw Onest and Shitless fighting as usual.
"Yeah, he is more than fine." Vritra replied, then the three chatted about planning related to the event.
Although Ava had been busy all this time, there were still so many things to do.
"Husband, take care of all the invitations-" Ava said and paused then looked at Vritra and asked: "Is it okay to send it to Ford family?"
"Yes you can, the annoying woman there is gone, and those people had learned to behave." Vritra replied, he had no further problems with them.
Soon after discussing the matters with them, he walked towards Onest and Shitless.
"You baldy, stop laughing!!" Onest shouted in irritation.
"Pffttt hahaha your lovely Zira is crying out there, aren't you going to embrace and console her? What about your sons, their daddy doesn't care about them?" Monk Shitless laughed, hugging his belly.
"Whoa is that a hair I see on your head? Oh wait that's not hair, it is hair-sized brain!!" Onest retorted

chapters.title: Chapter 776 The Quarrel
paragraphs: Onest and Shitless continued to fight, passing wild comments to each other.
"Oh is that a thief I see? No, it is the fadah of four sons, hug them tight at night, your poor kids seemed to love you a lot."
Shitless shouted when Onest commented about his hair.
"Stop!" Vritra said, feeling that the two were about to engage in a fist fight.
The two finally quieted down upon seeing Vritra approach, they huffed and wouldn't look straight at each other.
"Quickly, shake hands." Vritra said, it isn't good for them to always fight.
Shitless and Onest glared at each other but they didn't refute and extended their hands towards one another.
Onest extended his right hand while Shitless extended his left.
"Pfft" Shitless laughed.
"This Baldy!" while Onest cursed.
"Do it!" Vritra interrupted, so the two extended their right hands and shook them.
But Onest's face grimaced as he almost felt as if his bones were about to break, he screamed and almost knelt.
"Shitless! Stop that, are you trying to break his arm?" Vritra frowned, when did the two's relationship get so bad?
Shitless was already a level 3 Demi God so how could Onest match his strength?
"Do it again and next time, I will be shaking hands with you." Vritra scolded and finally Shitless pouted and loosened his grip.
The two shook hands peacefully, although they were still passing death glares.
"Good, now hug, and say you won't fight again." Vritra folded his arms over his chest and held back his laugh, speaking completely serious.
"Uh... Is it really necessary?" Onest asked.
"Yeah, how can I hug this smelly mugger?" Shitless complained, making Vritra roll his eyes.
"Do it!" Vritra said firmly.
Sighing, the two leaned forward a bit and put their hands on each other's shoulders, barely touching.
"Hmm good, now you two may kiss." Vritra added.
Shitless and Onest sighed and nodded, looking at one another before freezing in shock and looking back.
Vritra laughed seeing the two's reaction, it was truly funny.
"What's wrong? Weren't you two in that sort of relationship? I remember you tangling around back on that apocalyptic planet, no?" Vritra asked, as he leaned against a wall.
Even though he was chatting here, his mind was busy with something else.
He was also keeping watch over the two brothers, Raka and Zaka, fighting the two would be very troublesome.
They are both at 4th level, Vritra wasn't really sure how he can deal with them.
"Of course not, I only like women- sigh after that marriage, I am not even sure about that." Onest sighed, who would have thought his very first marriage would turn out like that.
Vritra was so lucky in that regard.
Even though his first marriage was also a sort of scam but he got a powerful, helpful, beautiful dragon waifu.
While Onest got what? A scheming wife with four grown shitty sons, what sort of shit luck is that?
Onest couldn't help but feel a bit jealous, if only he got just 10% of Vritra's luck, he would be set for life.
"It is okay, not everyone is as lucky as me or Zengis." Vritra patted Onest's shoulder and walked away.
But that consolation felt like a direct bullet to his heart, even Zengis, a stone got a good loyal girl, while he...
A legendary, proud, handsome thief... got scammed into getting four sons?
Even Shitless felt pity towards this guy.
"It's okay, I won't make fun of you." Shitless said, patting Onest's shoulder.
Onest nodded gratefully, at least he finally understood-
"I won't make fun of you for three seconds. Three two one!! Haha you deadbeat fadah, your wife is waiting~"
"Stop right there you bastard, I am going to slay you!!"
And so, the two began to fight again.
Vritra just sighed, it was impossible to stop the two from fighting.
"Wifey" he turned and saw Yasmine, who was talking with Yennefer.
Seeing Vritra approach, Yasmine's expressions changed instantly as she spoke in a teasing tone:
"Oh daddy here to check up on me?"
"Yeah, gotta make sure you two are okay." Vritra said seriously, as Yasmine giggled lightly.
"About those old dragon maids, are they here yet?" he continued to ask.
Yasmine nodded, she gestured towards a building and spoke: "We didn't need to get ten maids, just two or three would have been fine."
"No, that is the bare minimum. You also need better food now, hmm now that you are a Demi God, I don't think the food of this planet will be sufficient." Vritra pondered.
"..." Yennefer standing there listened silently, when she has a child, she would be just as joyous.
Just thinking of that made her sigh, she can only wait for that day.
It seemed Vritra had thought of all the things, from the diet to some exercises and whatnot.
Only once their discussion ended did Yennefer finally speak, she decided to bring up the sensation she felt earlier.
She wasn't sure if it was real or not, but it would be bad if it was some hidden enemy or something.
"Husband, earlier when we were returning, when my fingers brushed against the air..." she explained briefly, how her fingers seemed to draw the night itself.
Or was it darkness?
It was a strange sensation in any case.
"I see... I don't think there was any enemy around at that time, could it be related to your elemental physique?" Vritra pondered.
Still, he decided to check things again, he cannot let enemies roam around freely.
There are already Raka and Zaka, what if there are more? Now more Demi Gods are pouring down, if Vritra hadn't arrived in time.
Most people in the Yate family would have died, even Ava wouldn't have survived.
He felt quite angry at the two brothers, but instead of tricking them if he had just started fighting.
Forget about saving others, Vritra wasn't sure he could've survived against them.
"I... don't know, I will also try to find out more." Yennefer replied with a thoughtful look.
"Dear, I was thinking that instead of usual drinks, we add a new drink to the menu. It is something I created..." just then Diana walked towards them.
All the women had busied themselves with various tasks, helping out Ava.
Ava was also chatting with each of them, getting to know them more.
Thankfully, everything was going well.
"Yeah, that would be good." Vritra nodded, as he patted the goddess's head.
After talking with them for a bit longer, Vritra walked away as he looked around, searching for something.
"Where is Bullo?"
He called out to Shitless, and asked about Bullo but Shitless didn't know either.
Was it really Divine or did the real Divine lie to him? Hoo he really cannot tell anything.
Then he decided to revisit the place where the fight earlier had taken place, to make sure what Yennefer had experienced.
With a thought he teleported.
"Everyone is gone..." after looking around Vritra didn't see anyone, not even Zira.
[Null Activated.]
Without wasting any time he activated the Null skill and found himself transported into a separate world.
It was the familiar space where a stream flowed and on the other side, a mess of countless threads were present.

chapters.title: Chapter 777 The Master Plan
paragraphs: "Hehe he was such a good guy, he even gave us a map." Zaka laughed idiotically, covering his mouth like a girl.
"Yeah, for a moment I felt like exchanging you with him as my brother, he is clearly more helpful." Raka replied, following the map carefully.
He could not let his elder brother handle it.
"Hmm those Divine Kage should be around here..."
The two paused after travelling a large distance within moments, gazing at the mountain which had several cave openings.
Although from outside it looked primitive, they could tell the caves from inside were quite luxurious.
"Keke Raka let me play with them." Zaka spoke, biting on his fingers so hard that bones cracked.
He was very excited, this mission given by their supreme leader, they have to complete it at any cost.
"Wait, let me send an important message first." Raka said, just to make sure his excited brother stays in place, he held his hand.
Then taking out a bead from a pouch hanging over his waist, Raka lightly pinched it and waited.
"What is it?" soon a voice came from the other side.
"We need a level 1 Demi God's corpse urgently." Raka said, glancing at his brother.
"...Why would you need that corpse for? Is it very important?" the other side asked doubtfully.
"Yes, this is very important for our mission, deliver it within an hour." Without waiting, Raka cut the connection and put the bead away.
Getting the body of a Demi God of just level 1 wouldn't be difficult, the question is how they will send it over here.
But that's for others to worry about, this mission is important, their supreme leader had to help that great lawyer and earn his favour.
So, Raka was sure those people surely will do their best to fulfil this request.
He didn't tell back that they had forgotten to bring the great finder or even an image of Vritra.
But thanks to that good person they will soon find their target.
"Let's go now-" Raka turned and was shocked to see that he was holding onto a severed arm, his brother had already approached the cave.
"Hehe would you like to p- play with me?" Zaka asked, shaking his body excitedly.
The Divine Kage had been in quite the uproar already, they had no time to play with such crazy people.
Because that demon Vritra had returned, all the Divine Kage had gathered and they were making plans on how to take him out.
It wouldn't be easy but with the god's help maybe there is still a chance.
Not to mention, they already knew what Vritra had done to the gods, they surely hate him.
Number 66 had been late because of a mission and was only returning to the cave, when he saw that crazy guy walking sneakily inside.
"Strange entity detected! Threat: low." He spoke in a robot-like voice and sent a notification to the other Divine Kage.

These people will definitely try to trick them if they say they are enemies.
Raka cursed Zaka, that is why he didn't want to release his strength first.
But it was still not late, so using his ultra brilliant mind, Raka replied: "Vritra is a very close friend of ours, we are here to help him kill his enemies, is he here?"
"..." not just Number 1 but also others who had sensed the power of the duo were starting to sweat now.

'Did Vritra call them to kill the Divine Kage or maybe other strong enemies?' Number 1 thought and a plan quickly formed in his mind.

Nor his exact location, except his name they know nothing.
So what was stopping him from using the two stupid brothers? He would use Vritra's friends against him and kill him.
The brothers' stupidity and the leader's oversmartness was exactly the reason this battle began.
"Heh So Vritra really is here!!" Raka's eyes widened, so that guy really had not lied.
Everything he had said was right, even that these people will try to trick them. Thankfully, they had masterfully played a trick.

chapters.title: Chapter 778 The Instigator
paragraphs: Vritra, using the Null, went to check the location where Yennefer had sensed something strange.
But there really was no enemy, he couldn't exactly see what she had felt, and he couldn't get much information.
"Haa I just hope it isn't anything dangerous, anyway I wonder if those guys have already started." He mumbled, and in the next moment his figure faded.
Before returning home, he decided to go and check out the base of the Divine Kage.
With spatial travel, he was able to arrive there in an instant.
And right away, he heard the loud explosive sound along with the laughter of the two brothers.
"Kekeke I- I knew this bastard was lying to us, Raka l- let me play with them first." Zaka spoke, as he inhaled and then shot out a torrent of black liquid from his mouth.
"No no, you will kill them all, we need to just beat him up- uh well forget it, we can just say we have tortured him enough!" Raka replied.
The two brothers began to clap, each sound more explosive than the other.
The fight was yet to break out and Number 1 was still hoping they could join forces.
'Why are they getting so excited? Weren't they Vritra's friends? Or did they catch my lie?' Number 1 panicked for a moment.
But if these two brothers really attack, they would use all the explosive power they have.
Coupled with the world rules, maybe they can still survive.
Vritra disappeared from his original position and reappeared in the midst of the group of Divine Kage.
His appearance and clothes had changed completely, he looked like one of them.
While the other Divine Kage were still hesitating, he was the first to shout out loud:
"Yes I am Vritra, let's go kill an enemy of ours, my friends!" the loud voice rang out amidst the thundering clapping.
All of them were shocked and instantly all gazes were drawn to him.
"Huh? Who is this ugly guy? Wait why does it look like me- mmmpphhh?" the person Vritra had transformed into was so baffled.
He was right here so who was the one who had just shouted?
But right before he could speak, a shadow shot out from the ground and engulfed him.
It was the ability of Hellmancer, none even managed to see anything.
Just a faint shadow flashed.
But before anyone could raise their doubts or the two brothers could attack, Vritra walked forward and stopped before them.
"What are you standing there dazedly, friends? We need to hurry up and kill the enemy!" he spoke excitedly, fire burning in his eyes.
'W- What the fuck is he doing? Did he get too much into the act? Damnit, you two are not actually friends!!' everyone wanted to scream this at the same time.
But they could mutter nothing, if the two brothers find out then the fight will be inevitable.
The Divine Kage was created in a way that as long as one Divine Kage is alive, the rest can be resurrected again and again.
That is why even though many had been killed by Vritra, most are still alive, except the recently killed ones.
As it still takes time and energy.
"Oh friend, how have you been?" Raka's lips curled up, these people really have taken the bait.
But he wasn't sure if this was the real Vritra or not, in any case, if they just kill everyone then the matter will be finished.
"Pfft What's the need for such greetings between us?" Vritra put his arm over Raka's shoulder as the souls of all the Divine Kage almost moved out of their bodies.
Who was this guy? Why was he being so chummy?
'Who the hell asked him to act? Damnit, at least don't bring us down with yourself!!' Number 1 glared at Vritra's back, feeling chills constantly.
"Oh right, so where is this enemy we need to kill?" Raka asked, his expression unreadable.
"Pffttt keke this is so fun, keke" Zaka was barely holding back his laugh, he was enjoying it too much.
Vritra frowned, he took a step back and then raised his right hand, delivering a hard slap against Raka's cheek.
SLAP
There was pin-drop silence, the legs of all the Divine Kage trembled as most almost fell.
When did they get such a madman among themselves? This bastard was a damn traitor, what sort of act even is that?
"..." Raka was equally sure, at first he wasn't sure if this guy was Vritra or not but now, it didn't matter anymore.
Since all of these ants were going to die.
At this point even Zaka stopped laughing, he looked at his brother's face then back at Vritra.
"You bastard, how dare you ask me that? We have only one enemy!! Let's go kill him right away-" Vritra continued to speak in the same rude tone.
But before he could finish, a punch landed over his chest squarely, making his body burst into a bloody mist.
'H- He is dead!! That fucking bastard dragged us down!! We are done for...' the blood mist dissipated in the air, and everyone was feeling chills.
Before there really was a chance of survival but now there was no choice but to fight.
"Everyone! God's Punishment!!"
At this command, all the Divine Kage numbered 50 or above took out black glass spheres, and without a thought they broke them.
The ones from 11 to 20 had two God's Punishments each and the ones from 1 to 10 had three God's Punishments along with other treasures.
Instantly, the sky was covered with dark clouds and the ground began to crack.
All the energy gathered as the top ones among Divine Kage used every treasure in their possession for defence and offence.
Several layers of boundary appeared around the group, all sorts of attacks were launched towards the two brothers.
But the strongest were of course the over seventy God's Punishments.
'I never thought I would be using this now...' Number 1 took out a cube which seemed like a simple glyph.
But as the strongest Divine Kage, this was the treasure bestowed only to him and none other.
It was a one-time use cube that could not only protect them but also release deadly attacks.
Without any hesitation, he crushed it and instantly a large glass palace rose around the Divine Kage members.
It looked ethereal with a divine presence, as if its defences were unshakeable and there was a tower at the top of the palace.
It buzzed with lightning, the loud sound thundering across the sky.
All the men protected within the palace looked at it with shining eyes, they had heard about it but it was the first time that this thing was used.
Number 2 had always boasted about this thing, so this moment made all of them feel excited.
Raka and Zaka could have killed the bunch within moments but it wouldn't be satisfying.
They were especially ordered to make Vritra feel as much pain as possible, to make him suffer and destroy his will before that.
And what better way would there be than first giving him hope and then breaking it violently.
"Hmm Not bad, you guys are well prepared, did someone tell you we would be attacking? Or do you get attacked often?" Raka asked, scratching his cheek.
That guy didn't slap hard, after all an insect's attack is nothing for Demi Gods like them.
But his cheek strangely felt itchy.
"Pfffttt y- You got slapped by an ant hehe I am going to tell everyone and even Supreme Leader hehe" Zaka laughed stupidly, covering his mouth.
"Damnit, don't you dare or I will burn all your pink purses!" Raka threatened.
"..." Number 1 and the others were speechless, in front of such deadly attacks these two guys were quarrelling among themselves?
Were they really not afraid of anything?
No, even if they are Demi Saints but these are the gods' punishments, there is no way they can survive from so many.
This was the first time that they needed to use so many at once.
As the energy gathered in the sky from all the God's Punishments used, it transformed into a gigantic black finger, bursting with deadly energy.
This was far more terrifying than what Vritra had experienced, that attack wasn't even one tenth of this.
SLAP
Raka slapped Zaka's head and shouted: "We will settle that later, we have something important to do first!"
Finally the two turned to look at the dangerous attack in the sky, the dark energy finger formed quickly.
And then it began to descend towards them, the space buzzed violently and seemed on the verge of cracking.
The sound was so loud that it could make one go deaf, everything was consumed by darkness, the finger was so enormous that it seemed to have covered the whole sky.
Finally, Raka and Zaka showed serious expressions, they looked a bit fearful and looked around as if trying to find a way out.
"Haha We got them! There is no way they can survive this attack!" Number 5 laughed, pulling his two ponytails.
Finally all the men relaxed, this was the reaction they wanted to see, finally these two rude bastards would be dealt with.
As the deadly finger came crashing down at the two brothers, they helplessly created several barriers but all of them cracked upon impact.
And as the finger finally landed over them, everything was engulfed in madness, a sound so loud that all the trees within several hundred kilometres were destroyed.
The ground, space, everything was destroyed.

And then it began to descend towards them, the space buzzed violently and seemed on the verge of cracking.
The sound was so loud that it could make one go deaf, everything was consumed by darkness, the finger was so enormous that it seemed to have covered the whole sky.
Finally, Raka and Zaka showed serious expressions, they looked a bit fearful and looked around as if trying to find a way out.
"Haha We got them!
There is no way they can survive this attack!" Number 5 laughed, pulling his two ponytails.
Finally all the men relaxed, this was the reaction they wanted to see, finally these two rude bastards would be dealt with.
As the deadly finger came crashing down at the two brothers, they helplessly created several barriers but all of them cracked upon impact.
And as the finger finally landed over them, everything was engulfed in madness, a sound so loud that all the trees within several hundred kilometres were destroyed.
The ground, space, everything was destroyed.

chapters.title: Chapter 779 Number 0
paragraphs: Some distance away from the destroyed space, blood mist converged into the figure of a person.
Vritra, just to make it more realistic, had taken the direct attack from Raka, and it was certainly a little painful.
Then using his blood manipulation, his death was as natural as it could be.
Erasing his presence using the Lost skill, Vritra watched the battle from a distance.
With this, the entire Divine Kage would be wiped out, he borrowed the power of the two brothers.
Although Vritra's strength had grown, it was better to be cautious, who knows if they got more treasures from the gods.
'And these two brothers will be gone for a while, sigh more enemies will be coming soon.' Vritra sighed, he really needed to increase his strength.
Maybe enter more games, but where has the Divine gone? Before, Bullo was just around, but he hadn't seen it recently.
For now he focused on watching the battle, as the enormous finger landed, it seemed as if everything had been obliterated.
Seeing that attack brought back unpleasant memories, Vritra almost wanted to go ahead and kill them all.
But he held back.
'That palace, it's impressive.' He thought, even after that attack the palace was perfectly fine.
The people inside were laughing and already celebrating their victory, while the two brothers were completely engulfed.
It took some time for the explosive energy to dissipate, and the dust to settle, soon everything was calm.
The cheers of the Divine Kage stopped abruptly, as the figures of the two men came into view.
Raka and Zaka were unscathed, not even their clothes were affected.
"How is that possible? A- All those gods' punishments, it had no effect on them? J- Just how strong are they?" someone muttered in bafflement.
This was just too shocking.
"Hahaha Are you done? Is that all you got?" Raka laughed, looking at them all with a look of contempt.
"Hehehe they are weak, it will be fun!" Zaka clapped and took out a pink cloth from his mouth and wrapped it around his eyes.
"I will hunt them without seeing hehe" he added.
Raka rolled his eyes, and spoke: "Everyone knows you can see just good enough without using your eyes, who are you fooling?"
"Hmph they didn't know." Zaka put away his favourite cloth while huffing angrily, his brother is such a bad guy.
"Y- You... don't be so confident just yet, this palace, there is no way you can survive its full power!!" Number 1 shouted and added:
"Use all of your energy and channel it into the palace!!"
Though internally, he wished if only that guy was awake, they might have had a chance at survival.
But there are no ifs in battles, it is what it is, and seeing the difference in strength, Number 1 was already aware of the result.
Instantly, all the Divine Kage released all the energy from their bodies into the palace.
The lightning cracking at the tower above suddenly thickened, becoming so terrifying that even the space seemed to crack.
"Oh s- so frightening, Raka protect me!" Zaka, while acting frightened, hid behind his brother.
The two brothers laughed like mad men, floating forward, the ground had been obliterated earlier so there was a deep pit under them.
A thick bolt of lightning shot towards the two brothers, as if it could destroy the world itself, it was bursting with destructive energy.
But Raka and Zaka just disappeared, they were no longer holding back as they could feel that the world rules were already starting to act up.
They could still stay here for some more time, but it would be bad if they got sealed here.
As the laughter of Raka and Zaka disappeared, the two brothers appeared on both sides of the palace, easily dodging the lightning attacks that destroyed the ground wherever they fell.
Raka pulled his right hand back and then launched a punch containing terrifying energy.
While Zaka leaned forward and bit into the palace.
At first, the Divine Kage members looked on with confident expressions but soon the palace began to crack.
And within moments, it shattered, and all of the Divine Kage froze.
The outcome was inevitable and clear now, their energies had been drained away by the palace which didn't even last a few seconds.
They were like sitting ducks on a chopping board, ready to be slaughtered.
Explosive sounds rang out as the entire palace got destroyed, crumbling into nothingness.
Then the two brothers, like devils, charged towards the large group, not allowing anyone to leave.
Without using any ability, just using their physical strength, Raka and Zaka began to tear them all apart.
Zaka was straight away biting everyone and ripping them apart, it was such a bloody scene.
All the Divine Kage screamed in terror, Vritra just watched this scene from afar.
He didn't like this organisation from the beginning, they were always going to be on opposite sides.
And it was them who almost killed him in that war, so watching them was neither joyous nor sad, it was just right.
Instead of killing them all instantly, Raka and Zaka gave them prolonged deaths, with extreme pain.
It took them over 30 minutes to kill all of the Divine Kage from Number 1 to the last one, all were annihilated brutally.
Only then did the two brothers relax.
"Oh we ended up killing them all, I wonder which one was Vritra, they were all too weak." Raka mumbled, licking the blood off his palm.
"Hehe Whoever it was, now that playtime is over, can I eat them?" Zaka asked innocently.
"Sigh don't take too long, get it over with, also don't get yourself dirty with all that." Raka said as he flew up and looked around.
Zaka's mouth opened grotesquely, then his tongue shot out and he dragged the pieces of corpses into his mouth one by one.
Though the speed was extremely fast so he was done with his eating in a couple of minutes.
Finally, the two brothers left.
Their task on this planet was done, they had fulfilled their supreme leader's order and could go back now.
Only after the two were gone, Vritra scanned the place and after confirming there was no problem, he disappeared.
At least he was done with this problem.
Deep inside the cave where the Divine Kage were earlier present, although the cave had been destroyed earlier.
Under the ground, a coffin suddenly buzzed, despite the destruction, it didn't crack.
A few hours after everyone had left...
A groan sounded from inside, then the lid of the coffin was forcefully pushed open, throwing the stones and debris around.
Finally a corpse-like man with a thin and rotting body sat up, his eyeballs had fallen inside the coffin somewhere.
Using his hands, he searched and soon found them, then putting the eyeballs back into his eye sockets, he blinked and was finally able to see.
"Grrr..." when he tried to speak, only a rough groan sounded.
This was the Divine Kage Number 0, which was planted for the exact scenario when the entire group of 100 Divine Kage is killed.
As long as Number 0 is alive, all of them could be summoned back.
His body had deteriorated after the battle with a dangerous being back in the day so the only way to survive was like this.
He could only wake up when extremely necessary.
"T- they... all died?" finally, after trying for a while, he was able to speak.
There was no presence around his body, even if Vritra and the two brothers were around, they wouldn't have been able to sense him.
It was as if he was nothing more than a useless stone lying on the side, no one would look at it or pay any attention.
As the mummy-like creature began to stand up, his bones cracked and skin got torn further.
He inhaled and felt the faint mana in the air, blood finally began to move in his veins, and sensations returned.
Number 0 extended his bony hand and created water using a few drops of regenerated mana, and finally after so long, water touched his dried-up tongue and throat.
"Hoo How long has it been? Five hundred years? Or maybe more?" he spoke, as hair grew on his bald head.
His complexion changed and once again he began to seem alive, though the injuries left in that war a long time ago didn't heal.
He could stay out like this only for a short time, but that would be enough.
"These... guys lasted longer than I expected, did a Demi God finally appear here?" he wondered and flew out.
After looking around, he saw the destruction and an area which was still painted red by the blood.
"Judging from the aura, the attackers were at 4th level?!" he exclaimed in shock, wondering when this planet had progressed so much.
Before he went into hibernation, the heroes had failed at one of the games and got killed.
But since they had passed the trials, the planet was not destroyed, instead new players must have been called.
Number 0 felt really curious about the current situation of this planet, but before that he had to resurrect everyone.
And also needed to take care of those dangerous Demi Gods.
Of course his own strength is nothing, he is currently weaker than even Number 100.
"Sigh so much w- work ughh that damn brute, the wounds he left still hurt so much..." Number 0 cursed then raised his hands towards the sky.
Strange black chains materialised as the sky turned dark, and slowly all the 100 of the Divine Kage began to come back to life.

chapters.title: Chapter 780 The Itch
paragraphs: Using teleportation, Vritra returned to the Yate Realm, everyone was still busy with the preparations.
Completely unaware of the danger they had just survived.
On one side, Onest and Shitless were working with Gunter, the older man seemed to be sharing his various life experiences with the two youngsters.
While on the other hand, his wives were with Ava, their relationship had grown so much in such a short time.
Although only Fiona was younger than her, since they were all her daughters-in-law, Ava didn't feel strange treating them as if they were younger than her.
Thankfully, everything is fine here.
Vritra walked towards a seat and opened his status panel, it had been so long since he upgraded any of his skills.
He quickly ran his gaze over all the upgradable ones.
There were Book of Dimensions, Nether Eye, Blood Lock, Forbidden, Suck! Suck! Suck!, Nuclear Fist, Cry Baby, Titan Fall, Elegy Parasite, Lost, Shift, Intra Shuffle and Atomic.
He cannot upgrade the dust manipulation for now as it needed 500 million points, just seeing that number made him sigh.
To gather so many Sin Points, he would need to gather over a million people.
For now, he focused back on the skills.
'Hmm I need something that can help me fight stronger enemies...'
Book of Dimensions is good, but there is a high chance the opponent will still be able to escape.
Nether Eye wouldn't be as useful for direct combat.
Blood Lock and Forbidden are both great skills, so Vritra put them aside for now and continued.
Suck! Suck! Suck! is good, but can't be directly used in a fight.
Nuclear Fist is great too, but it can't be used constantly or maybe it will get even better with the upgrade.
Then comes the remaining and among them, Cry Baby and Titan Fall seemed the most suitable but had their own conditions.
Shift is powerful too... as for Atomic, it is mostly defensive.
"So among Blood Lock, Forbidden, Titan Fall and Shift, which will help me fight those stronger than me?" Vritra wondered.
As before, Blood Lock could only be used once he gets at least a drop of the opponent's blood, and then he would need to stall for some time.
Titan Fall is very risky, he knows nothing about it and the last time when it was used, the experience was not good to say the least.
So that only left Forbidden and Shift, both are great skills, so Vritra pondered which would be more useful in battle.
'Now that I don't have stats shown like before, what changes will Shift bring?' he wondered.
And Forbidden was already able to forbid five different things on the same or different people, will the number increase this time?
After long contemplation, he made his choice and used 100 million Sin Points right away, firm in his choice.
[Upgrading Forbidden...]
Right at that moment, far away into the universe, inside a room that was full of Vritra's images and belongings.
A beautiful woman who was lying on the bed, her chin resting over her palms, feet raised back as she lay with her back facing the ceiling.
There was a screen before her from which she was observing Vritra, a small smile on her face.
When she saw him tricking Raka and Zaka and using them to wipe the entire Divine Kage, she couldn't help but giggle lightly.
But then she shook her head, there are too many flies buzzing around her man, it would be better to crush them before they get problematic.
But she can't interfere herself, if her family was to get even a slight clue, it would only cause trouble for Vritra.
Evelyn sat back up, tapping over her soft rosy cheek with her finger and pondered.
'Why is Divine taking so long, it is almost time to start the next games.' She thought, Evelyn wanted Vritra to grow stronger as soon as possible.
So she can meet him properly, despite being a higher being and with all her strength, there were still too many restrictions.
Not to mention that pig from the Garissa family, her self-proclaimed fiancé who keeps bothering her.
Sighing, she shook her head and threw unnecessary things out of her mind, and refocused her gaze on Vritra.
As Vritra made his choice for the upgradation of the next skill, a beautiful smile blossomed on her face.
"Hehe I knew it!" she felt so happy, despite all this time apart from him, she can still perfectly understand him.
It made her feel closer to him, as Evelyn quickly took out a ring that she had finished not long ago.
"My love, this is my gift for you, hope this helps you out." She muttered and extended her arm, as the ring got pulled into a tiny crack in space.
Although she can't go there personally or even send anyone to help Vritra out, Evelyn was doing everything to help him.
To make him strong.
And that is the best way to help.
Then she leaned forward, watching closely each change in his expression, waiting to see how he responds to her gift.
Several messages flashed in Vritra's eyes, as the Forbidden skill began to upgrade.
The time and space around him felt as if they had frozen, everything seemed to have lost its colour.
The rules of the world were locked away for a moment.
And in the next moment, a big magical circle unfurled beneath Vritra's feet, expanding to dozens of feet.
It was filled with strange symbols, some looking like flowing time.
And around the big circle were five smaller circles, constantly revolving around it, the smaller circles too filled with strange unrecognizable symbols.
Vritra stared at it all in bafflement, this upgrade had taken a lot of Sin Points but the changes seemed quite satisfying.
He waited for the process to complete, sensing that the Forbidden skill must have gone through some great changes.
After a few minutes, everything returned to normal, calmness once again descending and time resumed.
Everyone just continued doing what they were doing, not noticing any changes at all.
Scratching his cheek, Vritra opened the status panel to check the skill but just then, he sensed two figures appearing in the Yate Realm.
'They are here...' closing the status panel, Vritra just continued to look around, showing no change in his expressions.
"Hey my friend!" Raka called out from the distance, raising his hand with a friendly smile.
The people around were once again shocked to see the two black and white people, they were looking very strange.
"Oh Raka, Zaka it is you! How did it go?" Vritra smiled back as he walked towards them.
"We are done with our task here and about to leave, btw we have killed Vritra already." Raka spoke.
"Hehe I- It was very fun, I even had a meal before returning..." Zaka replied while licking his lips, black saliva falling onto his clothes.
"Oh I see, congratulations, anyone who had tried to kill him had died, I am surprised that you were able to do it." Vritra said in amazement.
"Brother Jin, I have not forgotten about helping you, just give me a minute." Raka said and stepped to the side as he took out a bead.
"W- What are you all doing here hehe?" Zaka looked at the decorated place and asked, his gaze was strange.
As if he was imagining eating humans.
"Just a little celebration for something, anyway you are so smart, it must be hard to go around with your brother right?" Vritra asked as he glanced at Raka.
"Yea... he is d- dumb, I have to do e- everything myself, but it's fine hehe he is my younger brother." Zaka replied.
Vritra saw that Raka was constantly scratching his left cheek.
"What's wrong with him? Why is he scratching his cheek like that?" he questioned.
"Oh Hehehe he got slapped by Vritra, he must be e- embarrassed, I am going to make fun of h- him." Zaka replied with giggles as he quickly covered his mouth.
"Ah That's not good, you shouldn't laugh at your younger brother like that. Also here, this is a medicine that can help him, if the itch increases give it to him." Vritra said before adding.
"Don't tell him I gave it, you can take the credit for it, he will respect you more then."
While speaking he handed over a medicine, it was a red lotion in a small bottle, with a strong medicinal fragrance.
"O- Oh this looks special, can I r- really take it? Thank you hehe" without waiting for an answer, he stuffed the small bottle into his mouth and laughed happily.
Now he would show his brother who is greater among them.

"Oh right, if the itch doesn't increase and you don't get the chance to use that potion, you can use this to slap his face again. The itch will come and you can show off." Vritra handed another small bottle while Zaka quickly hid it in his mouth.
It was so absurd, first he gave the solution for a problem Raka might suffer and now if Raka somehow doesn't suffer that problem, he is giving the problem itself.
But Zaka found nothing strange about it, instead he was happy.
Feeling that this guy is such a good friend, not only did he give a medicine to remove the itch.
He also gave a medicine in case his brother doesn't get that itchy feeling, then he can give him the medicine.
"Y- You are so smart!" Zaka said with wide eyes, he could have never thought of this.
Now, he will truly become the older sibling.
"What are you two talking about?" just then Raka returned.

Muuuuh!

THUMP

Then it walked towards Vritra.
'Divine...' Vritra sighed internally, feeling relieved but also a bit anxious.
Did something happen?

There was no one around.
"Divine?" Vritra called out, looking doubtfully at Bullo.
Right then, the figure of Bullo transformed into a bug before turning into a human-like silhouette, though barely any features could be made out.
"Yes, it is yours truly, Divine." He replied, hands behind his back, head raised, and body shining with an ethereal white glow.
He looked like the incarnation of some god, magical and all-powerful, regal and respectful.
Vritra stared at this figure for a few moments in surprise. He could clearly see the smile on his face and the proud look.

His body was instantly teleported back.

"S Stop, this is no testing, you are clearly grinning, at least try to pretend...!" Divine's words were cut off midway as he got teleported again.

But that could wait until next time.
Getting serious, he asked, "Is there some danger brewing again?"

He calmed down after a moment and waited.
"This time I just went out for some fresh air and to see how things are going outside."
"So the real danger is that team led by Drino, then there is also Nine Pacts, and a few more organizations who were contacted by that lawyer then..." and Divine continued on.

paragraphs: "The team led by Drino, then Nine Pacts, and a few more organizations who were contacted by that lawyer Petophil. The gods will also try to kill you once they are out, and they will be free very soon."

And using her original powers of controlling fate and creation to try to create ultimate techniques that could be used for various things.
Fiona observed her for a few minutes but couldn't understand exactly what she was trying to do.
After that incident in the last game when Teresa almost died, the relation between the two had become much better.
They had become good friends, and Fiona finally accepted her as family.
She raised her own hand as blood red flames danced over her fingers, it was the powerful Undying Mythic Halo.
With just this, her strength was definitely very high.
Before, when she had just gotten it, Fiona couldn't even use a little of its power.
But now, she could utilize it better, of course using it to the max was still not possible.
Just like the other women, she also wanted to grow stronger and face the dangers ahead with her darling.

Like a curtain of light or maybe darkness.
Trying to find more, she pressed forward, sensing the strange element she had never felt before.
But just as she pressed forward, her hand passed through the curtain of light, falling into complete darkness.
Yennefer was startled and couldn't balance herself in time, stumbling forward and completely disappearing into the darkness.
The space and light returned to how they were a moment ago.
Everyone's gaze turned to the vacant seat, as they all stared at it in silence, shock, and confusion.
"Where is Yenni?" Vritra returned right then, having missed the scene where she passed through the light and disappeared.

"S She just disappeared into the light..." Fiona spoke as she rose to her feet, her finger pointing forward.
"Yes, Yennefer just p passed entered the darkness!!" Teresa spoke, she too had seen that scene just now.
"Darkness?" Vritra frowned, and before he could ask anything further, Maeve stepped forward.
Extending her hand, she seemed to be pinching the air but her hand actually disappeared into the darkness.
And after a few moments of searching, she seemed to grasp something and finally managed to pull out the panicked empress.
Yennefer's body was covered by darkness which was slowly disappearing, it almost seemed as if she had stayed there a little longer, she might have become darkness herself.
"Yenni, what happened?" Vritra took her hand, feeling the soft cold skin against his own, filled with worry.
"I... don't know." Yenni inhaled and shuddered, that was a bit terrifying, just now she really felt as if she was about to merge with darkness and disappear for eternity.
"Thank you." She looked at the demoness and thanked her. As big enemies as they were in the beginning, the two were best friends now.
So Maeve didn't really mind all that, she also worriedly waited to find out what had happened.
When did she get the darkness element?

"I think this might be related to your physique, it was not as simple as we previously thought, just controlling those few elements like air, fire, and water. Now that your strength has increased by leaps and bounds, unconsciously, you might be unlocking or tapping into the hidden potential of your physique. I guess it can control far more elements." Vritra spoke after pondering, it didn't seem to be any enemy's attack.
After all, Divine had already told him about it.
So only this option remained.
The increase in strength of his wives was quite sudden, and they might still not be able to properly control their abilities.
The abilities they originally possessed and the ones they got recently.
"Are you okay?" Ava asked, as she touched Yennefer's forehead instinctively.
Yennefer finally relaxed, how could she get sick as a demi god? She nodded and decided to be more careful going forward.
There was Maeve nearby this time, what if she accidentally entered some other element and nobody could get her out?
Would she really disappear completely forever?
Yennefer didn't even want to think about that.
"I am okay." She replied. Vritra pulled her gently and made her sit.
Maybe after this event, they should first understand their abilities, it would also help them better later on.

chapters.title: Chapter 785 A strange way to ask favors
paragraphs: After the small incident, they all calmed down and proceeded carefully while enjoying the moment.
Gunter soon took the stage and announced to everyone.
The return of his son, Art Yates, which was no longer big news since after the recent incident with Raldy and Onest, everyone knew of his return.
Then he told the world that he was going to be a grandfather and his daughter in law, Yasmine, was going to become a mother.
At first the Fords were shocked, but then even more shocked upon seeing the other women.
Only Rich wasn't surprised, he was already aware of it and had even arranged for that grand wedding.
Sir Giant and Shen looked at one another, for a moment they wondered if they should talk with Vritra.
But seeing Teresa, who was happy and not the least bit bothered, they just sat there.
Though someone else from the family couldn't sit calmly.
With his hand tightly gripped by Tiny's arms, tears of agony and envy flowed down Jean's cheeks.
Why? Why was he stuck with this... this hoe while that Art gets all the good things in the world?
Glancing from left to right, each of the women was extremely beautiful, their charms off the charts.
Jean was already feeling down, knowing someone as beautiful and awesome as Teresa had married him.
But seeing this, his body began to convulse and foam formed at the corner of his mouth, his pupils rolled back and he fell to the ground.
Shaking violently.
It wasn't until his loving wife Tiny took out a stained smelly sock from one of her lover no, servant's belongings and stuffed it into Jean's mouth.
That Jean finally woke up and spat out the sock, cursing loudly.
He didn't want to see the stained sock.
Since they were creating a commotion, both Tiny and Jean along with Tiny's servants were respectfully thrown out of there.
And so, the event continued normally.
Once Vritra and the others had climbed off the stage, Sir Giant and Shen, who was hiding his face, quickly walked towards Teresa.
"Uh C Can we talk to her?" Sir Giant halted and asked, looking at Vritra nervously.
"Haha. You are acting as if I would cut you in two just for talking to her, sure go ahead." Vritra chuckled and continued to walk.
'Who knows, you really might do it.' Sir Giant patted his chest, calming his heart.
This kid was too unpredictable and terrifying, thankfully they had managed to live only thanks to Teresa.

"COUGH. So uh Teresa, did you know Art, he has several wives? Are you really okay with it or... do you have to force yourself to stay with him?" Sir Giant asked in a low voice, while faintly glancing back.
Vritra, who had already walked far away with the others, could of course hear each word but he chose not to do anything.
Neither was he curious about Teresa's answer, he already knew what she would say.
Vritra instead began to chat with the guests who were good friends with Gunter and Ava.
"It's not like that, I knew it from the start and even if husband says he doesn't want me anymore, I would still cling to him, so why would my husband need to force me?" Teresa replied firmly.
Her confident tone and attitude surprised the two quite a lot, back then she was so meek.
"Aunty!" Rich also came, smiling, he was very happy that she was now living such a great life.
If only his sister hadn't gone astray, she might not be living as she was now.
Teresa smiled, appearing so much calmer and more mature compared to before.
After talking for a few minutes and asking them about things back at the Ford Realm.
Teresa patted Rich's shoulder then walked away, heading towards her family.
Rich was faintly smiling but then his smile froze as he noticed something.
"S She just touched me?"
Sir Giant and Shen were also equally shocked, Teresa seemed perfectly fine, so had she finally managed to control her abilities?
This was great news, now they wouldn't have to worry about her.
Her marrying Vritra, although unplanned, was the greatest thing.
Since almost all the evil organizations had been wiped out, there was almost no crime on the continent.
Vritra chatted with a few people but soon found this task exhausting, he left Ava and Gunter to it and disappeared from the venue.
Outside the party area, he was floating in the air, gazing up at the night sky.
'Three weeks...' Extending his hand, the dark goop transformed into a long sword.
Goop, he was using it after such a long time, it had devoured so many of Drino's treasures, so its current strength was quite high.
But in the future, he would need to upgrade it further.
At the thought of fighting, the dark sword trembled lightly, excited to slay enemies.
Since there was time, Vritra decided to just rest for now, though he also wasn't going to waste it completely.
While resting, he could also earn some sin points, maybe he could upgrade another skill before the enemies strike.
'The dust manipulation has already risen to Level 8, or also called SS, and to upgrade it further I would need 500 million sin points, sigh...'
This was without a doubt one of his strongest abilities, something that had stayed with him from the beginning.
And now with the addition of blood manipulation, the two seemed to have merged, so he didn't need to upgrade them separately.
But at SSS Level, it would definitely become extremely terrifying, maybe even crossing levels to fight stronger demi gods would be possible.
Vritra pondered, now that there was no power stronger than his own on this planet, he could easily earn sin points.
Getting 100 million in three weeks wouldn't be hard, but 500 million would be difficult.
'I guess I will just try and see if I can get 500 million.' He finally decided.
Soon after, a sweet fragrance drifted close and the sound of cloth fluttering echoed.
"Honey." Vanessa called out, pausing beside her son and looking at him with adoring eyes.
In his black outfit, he had this devil like charm to him, she just couldn't take her eyes off him.
Vritra ended his thought process and looked at his mother with a smile, then looked back and saw that the rest of his wives had arrived.
"As you saw earlier, the Divine is back and he said we have three weeks to enjoy this peace, after that the enemies will finally arrive." Vritra shortened the explanation, speaking directly.
"Oh." Maeve, who had just landed beside him, let out a surprised sound.
Her tail moved from left to right, though others at the party couldn't see it.
'Hadn't we just returned from that dangerous game, only a three week vacation?' the demoness wondered and pouted, she wanted more time with her master.
She wasn't even able to use that new crocodile costume she had bought as a surprise.
Yennefer smacked Maeve's head lightly, shaking her head, with just one look she could tell that something indecent was going through this fox's mind.
"And what will their strength level be?" turning to face Vritra, the empress asked.
"Anything under the gods, from Level 3 to 10, I doubt they would send anything under Level 3." Vritra replied calmly.
All his wives were surprised upon hearing this, even one level makes such a difference.
How could they even face Level 10 demi gods? Isn't this just impossible difficulty?
"So, you have a plan?" the goddess asked, her brain wasn't as sharp as Teresa or Yasmine but neither was she as dumb as Maeve.
In terms of intelligence, Diana considered herself above average, not to mention her talent when it came to pills and potions.
But she could not see any way they could fight back, except...
"Do we need to run away?" Maeve asked, completing Diana's thoughts.
"Hmm?" the goddess looked at Maeve, maybe this fox wasn't as dumb as she pretended after all.

"No, not exactly. We will be entering the games, of course it won't be like last time. We can't afford to waste that much time, anyway Divine had made some arrangements." Vritra shrugged his shoulders, that guy hadn't told him anything.
"For three weeks we can relax and earn some sin points, that's all we can do. Oh right, we also need to practice our skills." He added.
"Hmm. Why don't we just combine the two, let the people see our mock battles as we practice, you can gain a lot of sin points." Fiona suggested, getting a gentle pat on her head in response.
The redhead smiled, enjoying the caress.
"Yeah, this can work." He took out a communication glyph and contacted Onest.
"Yes?" Onest, who was busy breaking up a couple with his advanced techniques, paused and responded.
"Ask Rich if he can create a very big stage..." Vritra explained the objective briefly and then cut the communication.
Onest on the other side nodded in understanding and soon located Rich.

"Did you get it? If you bring this glyph close to your wife and it turns red then it means she is cheating on you and another man's scent is present on her body." Onest quickly explained and walked towards Shitless.
After explaining the work to the monk, the two quickly kidnapped Rich.
And then explained the task to him, asking for his help, though Rich was quite baffled.
His people kidnapped first and then asked for help, why are people around Vritra so strange? Especially his bald monk, isn't he supposed to be good?

chapters.title: Chapter 786 The God's Arena
paragraphs: Lightning crackled and then the space buzzed as the weak looking man crushed a glyph.
Instantly a door opened in the space in front of him.
Number 0 looked around for a few moments, the first thing he did after waking up was reviving all the members of Divine Kage.
But since his strength had deteriorated, he just initiated the process, which would take at least a few days.
"If I was at my full strength, I would have resurrected them all in an hour or two." Number Zero sighed, cursing the person responsible for putting him in such a situation.
But it could also be said that just now he had survived solely because he was injured.

It made her heart beat faster, doing it in the open was a different sort of thrill.
