His image exuded a heavy presence and powerfulness, truly taking everyone's breath away.
Ignoring the crowd and Uranus, Vritra looked at his wives, one by one.
Taking in the beautiful sight, yet again feeling lucky to have them.
From Yasmine to Teresa, all of them looked absolutely gorgeous.
After imprinting the images of all his wives deep into his mind, he spoke:
"Let's take it easy at the start, I will fight you all one by one. Your matches against each other can be held after that. And lastly, we will close it off with a final grand match."
"Sounds perfect." Yennefer agreed, she would also get to see others' strength if they fought against Vritra first.
Although they were a family and cared for each other, all the women had a fire burning in their eyes.
They all wanted to defeat each other, for various reasons.

sentences.text: A brand new day brought along excitement and anticipation.
The cities were bustling with crowds, yet houses and shops seemed empty.
Large crowds of people were quickly rushing towards the massive God's Arena.
There were two gates for entering, on opposite sides, and inside the gates, there were beautiful glass like stairs that led up to the island.
The security was very high, there were thousands of wooden statues present from the gates to the island.
At first sight most would think they were just for decorations, but only the strong could tell.
That all these statues were Lord Ranked, if they were unleashed then the entire continent could be destroyed within a minute.
Thousands upon thousands of people were rushing towards the island, most postponing all their work.
Various people were going there for different reasons, some wanted to simply enjoy the event.
Some wanted to expand their businesses and use this event to make huge profits.
While some wished to use this event to find their life partners, surely with so many people, they could find someone suitable.
There were also a few like Onest who were there instead to break couples.
People were allowed to enter the arena only after proper checking.
There were also some people who were afraid to go just yet and wanted to first make sure that the audience wouldn't be harmed.
Still, the number of people was more than Vritra had expected, though he wasn't underprepared.
There were more than enough seats in the arena.
Rich, Shitless, Onest, and a lot of others had gotten to work to take care of various small matters.
Maeve had also called all the demons or the information workers who worked in her organization.
It was a bit like that competition Vritra had set up before to kill criminals and earn sin points.
By eight in the morning, most people who planned to come had already entered the God's Arena.
They were even more amazed upon entering, everything looked so royal, they quickly took their seats.
The arena was enormous, and hundreds of thousands of people were seated there.
Gunter and Ava had taken their seats too, they got a special area to watch the battles along with a few others like Rich and close friends.
Vritra and his wives were yet to enter, but the excitement was already bubbling over.
The loud chatter with so many people present could drive people mad but with the various special barriers.
The place remained perfectly quiet and comfortable.
Soon, from the centre of the arena, a smaller round stage rose into the sky.
People instantly quieted down, seeing that the event was finally starting.
The small stage rose to a great height before finally stopping, then out of nowhere.
The silhouette of a person appeared on top of it, wearing a red outfit, as if he was painted in blood.
Wearing a magician like red hat, he pressed it harder against his head while gazing at the large crowd.
Who would have thought that one day he could succeed to such a level?
It was his dream to announce in a large arena.
Finally, something impossible was coming true, all thanks to Rich.
Taking in the excitement and curiosity, he took a deep breath.
"Hello my friends, this is Uranus, the famous host who will be hosting this very very special event.
This is going to be grander than anything we have ever witnessed, hoo my legs are shaking.
The fights will, unlike ever before, be extremely explosive, so those with weak hearts, make sure to keep all your openings closed."
Uranus shouted, building up the excitement.
After announcing, he waited to hear the loud shouts of the crowd, it was such a euphoric feeling.
Yes, Uranus was the same announcer who had once announced at the guard recruitment back when Vritra became Daddy V for the first time.
Though in this event, the character who made all the audience and the announcer very angry wouldn't be appearing.
"Anyone who tries to create problems here will be beheaded, by uh by that Baldy!!
He kills even if you breathe loudly!" Uranus pointed towards the special seats.
Monk Shitless who was just about to sit down was baffled at the sudden attention.
Instantly all eyes turned towards him and the kids began to cry, while the men and women began to curse him.
"Doesn't he look familiar?
I feel I have seen that face somewhere." A man muttered loudly.
"That monk... hmm wait!!
Isn't he that monk who blasted several temples, running amok in the streets with his bull!" someone finally remembered.
"Right, he is the evil bald monk!
Shouldn't he be arrested?
At least the gods were fair, giving him divine punishment in advance with a face lik-"
Hearing the thousands of comments, Shitless exploded in anger.
He wasn't the same helpless monk who hid under seats back then, he had become a demi god now.
"Who dares say anything about my face!!"
They even said it's a divine punishment, he isn't that bad looking, right?
"Pfft.
It's alright, don't mind their words.
You would be the stupid idiotic one if you took the crowd's words to heart.
Just hear from one ear and let it leave from another-"
"Huh?
Wait who is that beside him?
He doesn't look bad." Someone in the public commented.
And Onest raised his head high, puffing his chest out in pride while patting Shitless's shoulder.
"Who cares about looks, it's all secondary.
You can't keep crying about what you don't have.
Actually, I have been keeping a low profile all this time."
Onest was just basking in the praise.
"Hahaha.
Handsome?
What is handsomeness going to do about it?
Brothers let me tell you all something..."
A young man said as everyone quieted down to listen to him.
"His wife left him for another man, I even heard she had three kids with a completely different man.
What handsome, he is a cuck hahaha.
His kids were older than him."
The crowd burst out laughing, many had seen that event or heard about it.
At first they felt pity for him but now, they all were laughing openly.
"These fuckers!!
I am going to wipe them all out!!" Onest's eyes turned blood red, ready to annihilate everyone.
But Shitless held his shoulder and didn't let him go, before muttering in the same tone:
"Pfft.
It's alright, don't mind their words.
You would be the stupid idiotic one if you took the crowd's words to heart.
Just hear from one ear and let it leave from another."
Shitless laughed hard while continuing:
"Who cares about any of it, it's all secondary.
You can't keep crying about what you don't have.
Actually, why don't you continue keeping a low profile even in the future?
Mr.
Three Sons!!"
Having finally gotten his revenge, Shitless gracefully settled in his seat, gazing arrogantly at the crowd.
He might be a monk, but not one who had learned the art of forgiving.
"Anyway, I have heard the host of this battle is the Yate Family!!
Thank you for allowing us to enjoy all this without any requirements or fees." Uranus spoke as everyone clapped and looked towards Gunter and Ava.
"Now, finally, we are going to invite the participants of this battle!!"
The crowd roared madly, the lighting, the sound effects, everything was so perfect.
"Here they come!!
Prettier than anyone, more powerful than anyone, let's welcome them."
Just as Uranus spoke, seven figures appeared in the sky.
For a moment, none could clearly see their dazzling appearances, but then the arena quieted down as everyone looked at those women.
Forget the men, even women were staring at them in amazement.
They looked unbelievably beautiful, each dressed in such pretty clothes, that blocked all the lascivious gazes before they could even properly see them.
This was of course an invention from Teresa, who didn't like the stares of those disgusting men.
So nearly all the men in the arena couldn't see them clearly, still their hearts were beating rapidly.
"Now, let's introduce the final participant, their opponent!!
The Art Yates himself, the protector of the planet!!" Uranus shouted, his voice thundering all over the place.
For a moment, light disappeared from everywhere, startling all the people.
There was pin drop silence, as a silhouette appeared between the seven women.
Despite the darkness, everyone could still make out his figure.
His black outfit fluttered in the wind, he held a long black sword in his right hand, standing domineeringly in the air.
As the light returned, everyone was finally able to see the eight people floating at the centre of the arena.
Dressed in completely black clothes fluttering softly, and the long sword in his hand.
He looked so handsome yet carried a devil like presence, completely taking away the attention of nearly all the women in the arena.
Vanessa, Yasmine and the others were no exceptions, they also stole a few glances at him.
His image exuded a heavy presence and powerfulness, truly taking everyone's breath away.
Ignoring the crowd and Uranus, Vritra looked at his wives, one by one.
Taking in the beautiful sight, yet again feeling lucky to have them.
From Yasmine to Teresa, all of them looked absolutely gorgeous.
After imprinting the images of all his wives deep into his mind, he spoke:
"Let's take it easy at the start, I will fight you all one by one.
Your matches against each other can be held after that.
And lastly, we will close it off with a final grand match."
"Sounds perfect." Yennefer agreed, she would also get to see others' strength if they fought against Vritra first.
Although they were a family and cared for each other, all the women had a fire burning in their eyes.
They all wanted to defeat each other, for various reasons.

chapters.title: Chapter 791 The Undying Phoenix
paragraphs: "Without any delay, let's begin the first match, marking the beginning of the God's Battles!!" Uranus's explosive voice rang all over.
He didn't mind exaggerating things a bit to make it more dramatic.
"Who is gonna win? Lord Art or the Phoenix Empress? Hold tightly to your seats, as this fight will blow you away!!"
All the women had disappeared from above the arena, Vritra and Fiona slowly landed on the tiled floor, which was also covered by all sorts of protections.
The stage where Uranus was standing moved out of the arena, as he too became part of the audience, excitedly looking forward to the fight.
Of course, he kept making comments here and there, keeping the audience invested.
"Darling, here I come." Fiona smiled faintly, then her face took on a serious expression.
Vritra nodded and kept his left hand behind his back while holding the long black sword in his right hand, speaking:
"I will go a little easy on you, I will only be using my right hand."
"Alright!" Fiona didn't reject it, she didn't feel insulted, fully aware of the difference between their strengths.
Since her husband was kind enough to give her a handicap, she would take full advantage of it.
"Hmm. This battle might teach you many things." Vritra muttered, inhaling a deep breath as he stood motionless.
There was a brief silence as everyone watched with baited breath, people sliding a bit forward on their seats.
They had heard quite a lot about both of them, they were very curious to know who would win and how strong they really were.
"Great Lord Art is allowing the Phoenix Empress Fiona to make the first move! But for those who are starting to think she might be weak, you are completely wrong-"
Just as Uranus was speaking, Fiona made her move.
Flame wings burst behind her back, her speed reaching the max as blood red flames condensed over her fists.
Her fingers turned into deadly claws, her body flashed to Vritra's left, slashing at his shoulder with immense strength.
The temperature inside the arena rose to an extreme level, even a Lord Rank human would have melted.
And Fiona wasn't even using half her strength yet.
The corners of Vritra's mouth curled up slightly, his body remained completely still.
Like lightning, his left hand moved while holding a black dagger, stopping only after the dagger pressed against Fiona's throat.
Her momentum broke, the flames disappeared and she froze, eyes wide open, claws stopping a few centimetres away from him.
"The Phoenix Empress isn't weak, she is very- huh? Lost? W What happened?"
Uranus was completely bewildered, staring in shock at the two figures which weren't moving at all.
Keeping in consideration the weak audience, Teresa had created a special treasure which slowed down time, making crucial moments visible for them all.
So even though Vritra and the others would be moving extremely fast, they could still enjoy the battle.
And if they happened to miss the highlights, they could see them again on the screens placed around the arena.
And people finally saw what exactly had happened.
Vritra used his left hand, this... they were all confused, didn't he say he wouldn't use his left hand?
Isn't this clearly cheating?
{Sin Points Gained: Doubted +633,211}
{Sin Points Gained: Doubted +633,203}
{Sin Points Gained: Shocked +633,203}
Vritra watched the large number of messages, and he had clearly achieved his goal.
This was going to be so much fun.
He chuckled lightly and pulled back the dagger, looking at the baffled Fiona with a smile.
"Lesson first, don't trust anything the enemy says in a fight." Vritra said, taking a step back.
Fiona: "..."
Vritra really felt like laughing loudly seeing her expression, he could clearly tell what was going through her mind.
'Since when did you become my enemy? Aren't you my husband? Isn't this just for sin points and training?' she thought, then calmed herself.
Soon she understood that he must have done it for the sin points, still she couldn't help but pout.
"Haha, I am just joking, shall we start the battle for real this time?" he spoke, breaking the bafflement of the crowd.
Oh, so it was just a joke, they almost thought the fight was really over.
"Whoa, just the start is so shocking, I don't know what to expect throughout the battles. The real battle starts now!"
The public quieted down again, and this time, explosive sounds filled the whole arena.
Fiona didn't just mindlessly charge forward this time, creating large firebirds made from the Undying Mythic Halo.
The two large birds looking similar to phoenixes roared as blood red flames covered a vast space of the arena.
The Undying Flame would keep burning unless she cancelled it herself or the surroundings were completely out of energy.
Vritra didn't move, and unsurprisingly his whole body was consumed by red flames.

"Oh no, Lord Art is surrounded by those deadly flames, let me tell you all how dangerous those flames are. Once someone touches them, they would die without even leaving behind ashes!!" Uranus screamed.
Then wouldn't Lord Art's life be in danger? Everyone tensed up, waiting for him to counterattack or get rid of it.
"Hmm not bad, but it cannot burn what it can't touch." Vritra mumbled, his entire body was covered by the flames but he didn't seem the least bit bothered.
Using the Atomic skills which made countless atoms move at extreme speed around him and using the Null to stack a large space around the Atomic forcefield.
The space and atoms were burning quickly, needing Vritra to continuously repeat the process.
A Mythic Halo which is at the top in terms of destruction, cannot be taken lightly.
Vritra wasn't going to use all his strength or skills, this was just the beginning and it would burn out the sin points.
'Getting rid of these flames will be difficult.' Vritra thought as he finally began to move.
Passing through the sea of blood red flames, he flashed before Fiona, slashing with the long sword.
BOOOOM!!
A powerful wave of energy burst forth, blasting the flames backward but still unable to make them disappear.
Instead, the energy was getting devoured by the flames quickly.
"Oh, Lord Art finally makes his move!! But it seems dealing with those flames won't be easy!" Uranus commented while holding a mic.
The two flame birds screeched and smashed towards Vritra.
Vritra raised his right hand, pointing the tip of the sword at the two birds.
His blade moved very slowly yet faster than the two birds, slashing open space itself like cutting butter.
Then using Dust Manipulation, which was already at the SS Level, he created two even larger birds.
KRRRRIIEEEEEEEE
Screeching in madness, the dust birds smashed into the two flame birds creating mutual destruction but also pushing them close to the fissure in space.
Without waiting, Fiona's body completely covered by the red flames seemed to disappear amidst the sea of flames.
[Book of Dimension Activated!]
Vritra also wanted to test how his skills would fare against his wives, and understand better how to deal with various situations.
The surroundings changed, instead of the arena the two were suddenly standing in a large space with absolutely nothing around.
It was completely void, as Vritra wondered if the red flames could still remain effective.
For a moment the sea of flames seemed to tremble but then it raged on even more powerfully.
It began to devour and burn the rules of the small space Vritra had created, as cracks began to form all over.
Vritra quickly discarded the page of the dimensional book, and with this experiment he also understood one more thing.
If he tried to teleport out of the flames burning around the Atomic forcefield, he might burn for real.
Fiona gave him no time to ponder, as she muttered...
"Undying Prison."
The sea of flames suddenly closed in, not giving any space to escape and suddenly forming a large sphere, trapping Vritra inside.
'Oh!' Vritra was surprised, Fiona merging with the Undying Flame along with her Phoenix Empress Physique had skyrocketed her strength.
"Undying Chains of Annihilation!"
Just as the words left her mouth, terrifying chains made of condensed Undying blood red flames, almost turning solid, rose up.
CLANG CLANG
"Shatter!"
Fiona's body emerged inside the prison as she made a hand gesture, the chains brutally wrapped around Vritra's body and pierced into his skin.
"W What am I even watching?!! What level of combat is this? Not even Lords can survive something like that!! Can Lord Art survive this? Or will the Phoenix Empress win so quickly?"
The hearts of all the people outside were thumping rapidly, this was too thrilling, it was like they themselves were fighting.
And had been thrown into that destructive prison with no way out.
"Undying Forbid, Space!"
As soon as Fiona spoke, space itself began to burn, creating a completely separate realm within the prison.
Anyone who tried to teleport out would be burned within moments.
She had created this skill after observing Vritra and his Forbid technique, although it was completely different but the final result was the same.
"Impressive." Vritra mumbled, the space he had created around the Atomic forcefield quickly got devoured by the flames.
As the chains rapidly closed in on his body, making explosive sounds, so terrifying as if cities were exploding.
Most people trapped within that prison would have their hearts palpitate, there really seemed to be no way out.
If Drino was trapped here, he would have been killed by Fiona within a few minutes.
Despite the advantage, Fiona didn't get overconfident, nor did she already start enjoying her victory.
She added with a solemn look:
"Undying, Body Severance!"

chapters.title: Chapter 792 The First Battle
paragraphs: "Undying, Body Severance!"
As soon as Fiona finished speaking, the blood red flames like a sharp blade cut through Vritra's body.
Instead of harming him, in an instant it separated his body and soul, creating an untouchable space between the two.
Vritra, who was just observing, was quite impressed. She had mixed many skills together to create her current abilities.
And he was sure she too wasn't going all out yet.
"Nice, executing them this perfectly, I don't think you have even tried these before, have you?" he asked.
Fiona's flame body, which was visible inside the prison, spoke unhurriedly: "Yes, this is the first time I am trying them in reality, though mentally I have done them countless times."
Vritra, who could see his body separated by the flames, hummed lightly.
Although to the two of them they had paused, for others the fight was still pretty fast.
They were still just watching the moves the two in the arena had made, unable to hear anything they said.
Fiona made no further moves as she waited to see how Vritra would get out of all this.
Just like Vritra, she too was learning. Fiona had no doubt that Vritra could find a way out, and that's exactly what she wanted so she could prepare better next time.
Vritra's soul body, which was also surrounded by the flames, raised his right hand, snapping his fingers.
WHOOSH
The next moment, a colourless flame burst out of his soul body, like a wild beast, ravaging and eating away at the Undying Mythic Halo.
Even if the blood red flames could burn almost anything and keep burning for eternity, Nihil Anima was only second to the Mythic Halo of Creation.
When it came to destructive power, it was even able to subdue the demonic Veyll Mythic Halo.
How could a Rank 4 Mythic Halo defeat it?
Seeing the scene, Fiona hurriedly abandoned the prison and moved out, as the entire prison got destroyed within moments.
Vritra's soul body got pulled back into his physical body, as he stepped out completely unscathed.
After the initial test, it was time to do some flashy tricks to get more sin points from the public.
{Sin Points Gained: Awed +646,539}
{Sin Points Gained: Cheered On +263,204}
{Sin Points Gained: Loved +102,133}
The response so far was pretty great, at this rate, he could earn enough points.
After a brief glance at the sin points, he rushed forward, slashing the long black sword towards Fiona.
Fiona too advanced, she created a flame sword, striking back.
CLANG
Deadly waves travelled in all directions, the floor barely cracked but got restored quickly.
Though most of the shockwaves got devoured by the protective barriers and the people outside only felt faint waves of air.
Still, it made their clothes flutter, making the fight feel far more real.
BOOOM
CLANG THUD
The two began to battle rapidly, this was not mostly for show, nor were they using any special abilities for now.
Teresa, standing outside, carefully observed the battle.
She wasn't a fighter, although she now had no problem hurting others, she was still the one with the least experience among them all.

Waves of sin points flooded in, Vritra and Fiona kept everyone on edge.

In a room away from the crowd.

"Hmm we can think of something else later, for now you can rest." Vritra looked back at his other wives and asked:
"So who would like to go first?"
"Me!" Yasmine was the first to step forward.

"Yes, it is fine, don't worry." She replied, then leaning forward slightly, she smiled and spoke coyly:
"Of course, you can go a little easy on me, I need more energy for later tonight."
Vritra rolled his eyes, her fighting experience was higher than Fiona's, and her strength should be very high as well.

Her eyes sparkled, staring as the second fight began.

"Oh oh, heh that's my love." Evelyn praised as if he could hear her speak.

"What is it?" She asked in annoyance, almost wanting to kill whoever was disturbing her.
It was a maid at Level 10 Demi God rank, shaking fearfully upon sensing Evelyn's bad mood.
"Y You have been called into the Cloud Palace." The maid spoke, her face turning pale.
Being able to work for this powerful family of the higher beings was her fortune, it might even open her path to godhood.
She had heard the stories of several people who after becoming servants here were able to become gods.
One such example was PetoPhil's father, who was a servant here before.
"Why? Is that pig here again?" Evelyn asked, her anger rising.

"N No, he isn't. It might be related to the recently punished gods and the Asura Race and the Divine." The maid spoke uncertainly, with her low authority here, how could she know such important matters?
For the higher beings, Demi Gods or even gods were just minor entities, slaves who could be replaced at any time.
They were too proud and arrogant.
And as one of the top families among all higher beings, Evelyn's family members were even more arrogant.
If others ever found out about Vritra, she could clearly imagine their reactions, she was sure they would never allow this relationship.
But it was alright, once Vritra had grown to that extent, the two could fight together and be free.
Despite all her efforts, it would still take some time before he could finally reach such a high strength level.
"Haa. Tell them that I will be there in a few minutes." Evelyn replied, if it was related to Divine and those gods then it might also affect Vritra.

But she would watch it later on.
She took off the coat she was wearing over her dress, which she had taken from Vritra.
After hiding everything present in the room and looking over herself, she made sure that nothing was wrong.

"Sigh. My daughter, you are finally here. It is your grandfather, he made some unconventional bets and lost in a gambling game, bringing trouble home." Sighing loudly, he summarised it briefly.
"Again? Can't you keep that old man tied up or locked somewhere? What exactly happened? What trouble?" The frown on Evelyn's beautiful face deepened.

chapters.title: Chapter 793 The Problematic Grandpa
paragraphs: "Uh so he went to the Asura Race to meet his old friend and got tricked into that gambling game and as always he ended up losing." After a pause, he added: "Losing our family's right to enter the Guardian's Tomb Realm."
"What?! Is he mad?" Evelyn felt so angry, forgetting for a moment that that old man was her grandfather, cursing him internally.
Does he not know how important that realm is?
It was exactly the place where she found that Metamorphosis.
Its importance was even higher than the family heirlooms, how could that wastrel just go and gamble it away?
"So, what's the situation now?" Evelyn asked while massaging her temples.
"I am planning to go and have a chat with that drunkard, so come along with me." Fader spoke, straightening up slightly.
"Why, shouldn't your strength be enough for this sort of talk?" Evelyn asked, she just wanted to return to her room and continue watching the battle.
Avoiding this useless drama altogether.
"No, you know that witch, the Heart Demon. If she starts to take action, then instead of solving the situation, things would only get worse." Fader replied in a tense voice.
"Sigh." Evelyn knew that now going was inevitable, of course she knew the Heart Demon.
Who was a weak witch but with a very strong curse placed upon herself, that made the men around her lose their minds.
After countless years, she turned this curse into her weapon and had become a high ranked member among the Asuras.
To deal with her, Evelyn's presence would be necessary or her father might yet again fall for another trick.
"Fine, is that the only problem?" Evelyn asked, staring at her father.
"No, those ten gods you wanted me to punish, they have served more than enough time and now it's time to release them." Fader spoke, his tone rather calm.
"Already? Can't you keep them inside any longer?" Evelyn asked, she had already told Divine that she would keep the gods locked for around three or so more weeks.
It would become troublesome for Vritra if they were already released.

"No, even if we are the rule enforcers, it wouldn't be good if we bent the rules too much. But why are you so concerned about those ten?" Leaning forward, he stared at her as if trying to uncover some big secret.
To be honest, as the head of the powerful Vespera Family, he wasn't stupid nor incompetent.
He had long ago noticed that Evelyn had been doing something secretly, but he just didn't want to probe into her matters.
Fader believed she was an intelligent woman and she would do everything correctly.
He was sure that after him she would become the perfect family head, maybe during her time the family would grow even more powerful.
As for making her marry Armin Garissa, there was a small reason behind it.
Fader was well aware why the Garissa Family wanted Evelyn to marry Armin, so that slowly they could take over their family.
But it wouldn't come to that, just like the Garissas, he too had his own plans.
"I just didn't like the sight of them." Evelyn replied with a shrug, not showing any emotions.
There was no way she would get nervous over something like that.

"I see, well then let's first deal with the Asura Race, as for those bugs, those ten can wait a little longer." Fader said as he stood up, his bandaged body seeming as if it might collapse at any moment.
But his body carried such a strong presence, he walked out of the Cloud Palace, and Evelyn followed behind him after a long sigh.
'I guess I won't be able to see the fight for today anymore.'
Back on the Zoratian Planet, the battle between Yasmine and Vritra continued for several hours.
Using her explosive powers, she fought equally fiercely.
Since she didn't possess any treasure like the Mythic Halo, people wondered if she would not be as strong as Fiona.
But they were wrong, her strength was equally terrifying.
She didn't even use any flashy moves, instead fighting purely in close range.
It was a little surprising even for Vritra, his physique was one of his greatest advantages, so fighting at close range should have put her at a disadvantage.
But it seemed he had worried for nothing earlier, whether it be her speed or strength, it was all extremely impressive.
She didn't even use her dragon transformation yet, keeping the public in suspense.
Uranus continued to do his job, hyping people up even more.
Every now and then, people saw Rich who was busy watching the battle but also selling some sort of potions.
Of course, not personally selling them, but just observing the sales and feedback carefully.
Only when the battle was about to end did Vritra and Yasmine use their half dragonic transformations.
And the audience went completely mad, cheering until their throats started hurting.
The battle only got more dangerous after that, from the strong gusts of wind alone, they could tell how deadly it had become.
The arena was covered by flames, sounds of punches rang out continuously, and the space itself was constantly shaking.
For most people who were seeing something like that for the first time, they were feeling an intense adrenaline rush and almost wanted to rush into the arena themselves.
And fight alongside them.

"Hoo! That was a great no, the greatest battle, it seems that is all we will be seeing for today. It's a pity but tomorrow we will be seeing a lot more than that. So, don't forget to come back here on time or you will miss a once in a lifetime situation." Uranus spoke, his voice thundering with excitement.
Quite a few people who had come there to train themselves were also very happy as they got to see and learn a lot.
Vritra and the women had already disappeared, but most of the people were still seated there, still reeling from the shocking scenes.
Some people even decided not to go home and just stay in their seats, they wouldn't want to miss even a second of such fights.
After the battle, Vritra arrived back at his home in the Yate Realm.
"Art, Yasmine, Fiona, are you all sure you are fine? That battle seemed very dangerous." Ava asked worriedly.
Especially worried since Yasmine was pregnant, although she was just in the initial phase of her pregnancy, she still had to be more careful.
"We are fine, that was nothing, not even a proper warm up." Yasmine replied, and Fiona nodded in agreement.

"Yes, that battle was mostly for show. It will only be getting more... violent later on, don't worry though, we won't hurt each other, we all know how to control our strength." Vritra added, stretching his arms casually.
He looked towards the back and saw Shitless who was seated over Bullo, and Onest who was walking beside Bullo.
The two seemed to have made up and were discussing deep topics like life and destiny.
Vritra just shook his head and ignored the two for now, at times they were the worst enemies while at other times they looked like brothers.
"Son, that fight, what level are you at?" Gunter asked, just like most people, he too was very amazed by the battle.
During most of it, his fists were clenched and his heart was beating rapidly, it was truly a sight to behold.
"Hmm. A demi god." Vritra replied, there was no harm in telling them and no benefit in hiding it.
"A demi god? Oh, looks like that's way above the Lord Rank, impressive. Can you beat a thousand Lords if they attack you at once?" he continued to ask excitedly.
This was the first time he had heard of such a rank.
"Of course, that is easy. Even if there are a million Lords, that would be no problem. The difference between the two is abysmal." Vritra replied calmly.
"Oh then-" Gunter wanted to know even more, but got pushed back slightly by his wife.
"The dinner is already prepared, you don't have any other matter to attend to right?" Ava asked after giving her husband a look.
Gunter fell silent, giving a pitiful look and sighing dramatically, feeling pity for himself.
Such questions could wait, her son hadn't even eaten anything, of course that should be the priority.
"Yea, let's go eat first." Yennefer spoke, laughing lightly at the exchange between Ava and Gunter.
The others nodded, for now they were free.
Vritra wasn't planning to just spend these three weeks of peace in the arena.
He also wanted to spend more time with his wives, travel around different places, and simply relax before the next games started.
While chatting, the group entered the palace, soon reaching the dining room.
The servants quickly arranged the food.
For Yasmine, the dragon maids made special meals and took care of everything personally.
Vritra had made sure that these maids wouldn't even think of harming Yasmine or being parasitised or controlled by anyone.
Like a curious child, Gunter continued to ask questions, though he would immediately quiet down whenever Ava gave him a warning look.
"Husband, how many points did you get or are you not going to check until later?" Yennefer asked, enjoying the delicious food.
"Of course, he won't check yet." Yasmine replied, having spent a long time with him, she knew very well how much he liked creating suspense for himself.
"Oh right, that woman... hmm what was her name again? Did she come again?" Diana asked, no matter how hard she tried, she couldn't remember the name.
The others too had somehow forgotten about that and couldn't remember the name either.

Both body and soul, but at the last moment, the prison suddenly broke and the chains shattered.

"What are you doing, father?"
